policy.zh: 逐游戏适度展开核心操作、目标与独特机制；不重复类型分类，不套用通用科研能力说明。原始游戏身份、研究改编范围和详细外链保持独立。
policy.en: Moderately expand each game’s actions, goals and distinctive mechanics. Avoid repeating genre labels or generic research-capability copy. Preserve exact identities, adaptation scope and separate detail links.

records.zh: 每次移动会让全部数字方块向同一方向滑动，数值相同的方块相碰后合并成更大的数字。玩家要为下一次移动保留空位，安排合并顺序，避免棋盘被无法继续组合的方块塞满。
records.en: Slide the whole board in one direction to combine equal-numbered tiles into larger values. Keep spaces available and arrange useful pairs ahead of time, since each move changes several tiles and a crowded board can leave no workable continuation.

records.zh: 玩家扮演辩护律师成步堂龙一，在调查中走访现场、收集证据，再到法庭追问证人。需要把证词与手中证据相互对照，指出矛盾，逐步还原案件经过并为委托人辩护。
records.en: As Phoenix Wright, investigate crime scenes and collect evidence before questioning witnesses in court. Compare their accounts with the evidence you hold, identify contradictions and use each discovery to reconstruct the case and defend your client.

records.zh: 采摘红、绿、蓝三种浆果，也可把果丛重新种成其他颜色。某种浆果占比越高，生长就越快；所有玩家都更偏爱红果，但投入种植也意味着暂时放弃采摘。
records.en: Harvest red, green and blue berries, or replant patches in another color. Each color grows faster as its share increases; everyone prefers red berries, but time spent establishing a productive crop is time away from harvesting it.

Three resource types counter one another, and visible collection routes can reveal clues about a coming choice. Repeated meetings allow each player to adjust after earlier outcomes.

evidence.locator: Official substrate configuration: module docstring and game rules

records.zh: 在多人场地中移动并收集资源，背包中各类资源的比例决定猎鹿博弈中的选择；交互光束会触发两人间的收益结算。选择兔子提供较稳妥的收益，选择鹿则需要对方配合，才能取得更高的共同回报。其他玩家的背包并不直接可见。
records.en: Move through a multiplayer arena and collect resources whose inventory proportions determine a Stag-Hunt strategy. An interaction beam triggers a two-player payoff; the hare offers a safer return, while the higher stag reward requires the partner to coordinate. Other players’ inventories are hidden.

evidence.locator: Official substrate configuration: module docstring and game rules

records.zh: 两名玩家在场地中收集资源，背包中各类资源的比例决定猎鹿博弈中的选择，并用交互光束结算收益。选择兔子提供较稳妥的收益，选择鹿则需要对方配合，才能取得更高的共同回报。双方会反复相遇，可根据此前的交互调整下一次选择。
records.en: Two players collect resources whose inventory proportions determine their Stag-Hunt strategies, then trigger encounters with an interaction beam. The hare offers a safer return, while the higher stag reward requires the partner to coordinate. Repeated meetings allow each player to adjust after earlier outcomes.

evidence.locator: Official substrate configuration: module docstring and game rules

records.zh: 用涂刷或抛洒油漆占领资源墙，颜色保持一段时间并干燥后，墙面会持续产生收益。玩家从迷宫外围进入资源密集区域，逐渐接触他人的领地边界。
records.en: Claim resource walls with a brush or thrown paint; walls begin producing rewards after the color remains undisturbed long enough to dry. Players enter from outside a dense resource maze and gradually encounter neighboring claims.

evidence.locator: Official substrate configuration: module docstring and game rules
Base module docstring: wall claiming, drying, rewards and permanent destruction

records.zh: 用涂刷或抛洒油漆占领资源墙，颜色保持一段时间并干燥后，墙面会持续产生收益。起始房间形成天然分区，拆墙可以入侵邻区，却也会永久损失可产生收益的墙面。
records.en: Claim resource walls with a brush or thrown paint; walls begin producing rewards after the color remains undisturbed long enough to dry. Separate rooms create natural partitions; breaking through into another room permanently removes potentially profitable walls.

evidence.locator: Official substrate configuration: module docstring and game rules
Base module docstring: wall claiming, drying, rewards and permanent destruction

records.zh: 玩家先选择共享收益的小组，再让拥有互补工种的成员采集资源、加工并制作物品。各人的生产能力与所得相互关联，需要协调分工及资源流向，才能把采集结果变成共同收益。
records.en: Choose a group whose members share rewards, then gather resources and craft items using complementary occupations. Coordinate who collects and who produces, since each member's available work and the movement of resources affect what the group can achieve together.

records.zh: 玩家从城镇发展起步，采集资源、建造设施，并通过时代推进解锁后续发展。经济建设要持续支撑军队生产，同时指挥部队扩张与交战，在发展速度和军事投入之间取得平衡。
records.en: Gather resources, build up a settlement and advance through historical ages to develop your civilization. Keep the economy supporting military production while commanding armies across the map, balancing further growth against the forces needed to defeat your opponents.

records.zh: 玩家调配村民采集四类资源，建造城镇、生产军队并研究升级。地图侦察与兵种配合决定出兵方式，经济需要不断支撑前线，因此发展基地和争夺战场往往要同时进行。
records.en: Assign villagers to four resources, construct a town and produce armies while researching upgrades. Scout the map and combine unit types to contest important ground, keeping production running so that expansion and battlefield losses do not exhaust the economy.

records.zh: 两名玩家在 13×7 网格上轮流行动，围绕基地展开对抗。推进时需要考虑对方下一轮的回应；对局既可通过摧毁敌方基地结束，也可走向规则允许的外交终局。
records.en: Two players take turns contesting a 13×7 grid around their bases. Choose moves with the opponent's response in mind, pursuing destruction of the opposing base or a diplomatic ending when the rules allow that alternative route to conclude play.

records.zh: 玩家通过私下交谈建立关系，再在公开陈述和投票中争取支持，以免遭到淘汰。随着人员减少，联盟与对手立场也会变化，最终阶段还需要争取足够的支持来赢得对局。
records.en: Use private conversations to build relationships, then make public statements and seek support during elimination votes. Staying in the game is only part of the objective: changing alliances and other players' positions also shape your chances of winning the final stage.

records.zh: 玩家探索世界、采集并合成物品，通过完成具有前置依赖的步骤推进主线。支线与探索也会占用行动，需要判断当前缺少什么资源、哪些任务尚未解锁，再安排下一段旅程。
records.en: Explore, craft and complete side quests while advancing a main quest with prerequisite dependencies. Check which resources or earlier objectives are still missing before moving on, balancing useful exploration against the sequence of tasks needed to keep the main story progressing.

records.zh: 玩家把药水用于石头，观察颜色、形状等属性如何变化，并据此推断当前隐藏的转换规则。后续操作要利用这些发现选择药水与石头的组合，避免只凭外观重复尝试。
records.en: Apply potions to stones and observe how their properties change to infer the current transformation rules. Use those discoveries to select later stone-and-potion combinations, checking whether a new result supports your understanding before committing to another sequence of transformations.

records.zh: 队员需要同步采矿、在规定时间内交接资源，再把材料用于共同建造和战斗。采集、传递与使用彼此相接，一个环节的延误会影响其他成员，因此行动节奏和分工需要相互配合。
records.en: Coordinate mining, timed resource handoffs, shared construction and combat. Materials must pass from collection to teammates and then into use, so the timing of one player's work affects the others and requires the team to keep these activities aligned.

records.zh: 玩家按文字指令在场景中寻找物体，移动到合适位置后进行取放、清洁、加热或冷却。完成目标既要求把物品送对地方，也可能要求先改变其状态，因此需要安排操作顺序。
records.en: Follow instructions to locate objects, navigate to them and carry out actions such as placing, cleaning, heating or cooling. Arrange these operations to leave each object in both the destination and the state required by the task.

records.zh: 双方先像国际象棋皇后一样移动一个亚马逊，再从新位置射箭，把一格永久封住。移动与封路共同改变棋盘，玩家要保留自己的活动空间，并逐步让对手失去全部合法行动。
records.en: Move an amazon like a chess queen, then shoot an arrow from its new position to block a square. Each turn changes the available routes, so preserve room for your own pieces while enclosing the opponent until they have no legal move.

records.zh: 船员一边完成各处任务，一边根据行动和讨论寻找伪装者；伪装者则利用破坏、击杀与伪装阻止船员。会议中的解释、质询和投票会决定谁被驱逐，也会改变下一阶段的信任关系。
records.en: Crewmates complete tasks and investigate suspicious behavior, while impostors sabotage the team and conceal their actions. Meetings turn observations into accusations and votes, so explaining where you were and judging competing accounts matters alongside movement and work around the map.

records.zh: 玩家选择弹射方向与力度，让不同特性的鸟撞击建筑和其中的猪。结构的支撑、倒塌与碰撞可以形成连锁破坏；这里关联的 Science Birds 是对这一玩法的研究实现。
records.en: Choose a launch angle and strength, using birds with different properties to strike structures and the pigs inside them. Read the supports and resulting collisions to create useful collapses; the associated Science Birds implementation represents a research adaptation of this play loop.

records.zh: 双方在 4×3 棋盘上移动狮、象、长颈鹿和小鸡，吃下的棋子可以重新打入棋盘。目标是吃掉对方狮子，或满足狮子入阵条件；小棋盘使一步移动与重新打入都直接影响攻防。
records.en: Move lions, elephants, giraffes and chicks on a 4×3 board, with captured pieces available to drop back into play. Win by capturing the opposing lion or satisfying its advance condition, weighing immediate threats against the new attacks a dropped piece can create.

records.zh: 控制角色跑跳、收集金币并避开沿途敌人，穿过高低错落的平台。寻找强化道具后，可以跳上原先难以抵达的位置或打开受阻路线，再利用新获得的通行能力继续探索。
records.en: Run and jump between platforms, collecting coins while avoiding enemies along the route. Find power-ups that let you reach higher areas or pass previously blocked paths, then revisit how those changes affect the way forward through the adventure.

records.zh: 玩家与小队搜集武器和装备，利用各角色技能选择转移、交火与支援的时机。安全区域不断收缩，需要兼顾当前位置、队友行动和敌方威胁，争取让队伍在连续遭遇中存活。
records.en: Loot weapons and equipment with a squad, using each character's abilities to move, fight and support teammates. As the playable area contracts, weigh position and enemy pressure against the squad's needs, choosing when to engage and when to relocate together.

records.zh: 双方分别控制四条鱼，在对战中选择攻击目标并使用技能，设法取得战斗优势。第二阶段另加入隐藏身份猜测，玩家除了观察交战结果，还要依据已见行动判断对方鱼的身份。
records.en: Each side controls four fish and chooses attacks and skills during combat. A second stage adds hidden-identity guessing, so observed actions and their outcomes also become clues for deciding which fish the opponent has, alongside decisions about how to fight them.

records.zh: 玩家带着自选装备进入战区，搜集物资并在交火风险与战利品价值之间作取舍。找到并成功抵达撤离点后，才能保留带出的物品，因此撤离路线与离开的时机同样属于目标的一部分。
records.en: Enter a combat zone with your equipment, search for valuables and decide which fights are worth the risk. A successful extraction preserves what you carry out, making route selection and the timing of departure central to securing the loot.

records.zh: 各队的目标是让全部成员穿过交叉路口，到达对侧指定位置。多名成员共用通行区域，需要安排谁先通过、谁暂时等待，让每名队员都能找到抵达目标的路线。
records.en: Guide every member of a team across the intersection to the targets on the opposite side. Coordinate who moves and who waits in the shared passage, keeping routes available until the whole team has reached its destinations.

records.zh: 玩家扮演艾吉奥，在君士坦丁堡攀爬、潜行或交战，寻找推动调查的钥匙。探索城市与执行任务相互穿插，取得线索后还会进入阿泰尔相关记忆，把不同经历连接起来。
records.en: As Ezio, explore Constantinople through climbing, stealth and combat while tracking down keys. Move between investigation and action as new leads emerge, with memories connected to Altaïr providing another strand of the story as you advance through the city.

records.zh: 玩家通过倾斜迷宫改变小球的运动方向，让它沿通道滚向出口。小球的惯性会延续到下一段路，必须在转角前减速并修正位置，避免一次幅度过大的调整破坏后续路线。
records.en: Tilt the maze to roll a ball through its passages toward the exit. Momentum carries across each adjustment, so controlling speed before corners and correcting the approach determines whether the ball stays on the intended route.

records.zh: 玩家通过方向、开火等输入游玩 Atari 2600 的不同作品，分别完成清敌、收集、竞速或对弈目标。各游戏沿用自己的计分、生命和结束规则，具体操作与胜负条件需按作品区分。
records.en: Play individual Atari 2600 titles using directional controls, firing and other game-specific inputs. Objectives range from clearing enemies and collecting objects to racing or competing on a board, with each title retaining its own scoring, lives and ending conditions.

evidence.locator: ALE collection scope; game-specific controls, objectives and scoring

records.zh: 玩家左右移动飞船，射击从空中接近的飞碟，保护画面两侧的建筑。敌机会向建筑投弹，需要在击落目标的同时兼顾两边防线，阻止轰炸持续破坏城市。
records.en: Move the defending ship from side to side and shoot approaching flying saucers. The attackers drop bombs toward two buildings on opposite sides of the screen, so movement between the two sides is part of keeping both buildings protected.

records.zh: 玩家在飞船迷宫中移动，清除散落各处的异形卵，同时避开追逐自己的三只异形。遇险时可用喷火器逼退敌人，收集脉冲强化后则能暂时反击，趁机穿过受阻通道。
records.en: Move through a maze inside a spaceship, destroying scattered alien eggs while avoiding three pursuing aliens. A flamethrower can drive enemies away in tight situations, while a pulsar power-up temporarily lets you kill them and move through otherwise dangerous passages.

records.zh: 玩家沿二维网格的路径移动，设法走遍需要覆盖的区域，同时避开在网格上活动的敌人。部分时机会让追逐者暂时变成小鸡，此时可以反过来捕捉它们，改变原本的追逃关系。
records.en: Travel along the paths of a two-dimensional grid and cover the required areas while avoiding enemies moving through the same network. At certain points the pursuers turn into chickens, creating a temporary opportunity to catch the enemies that were pursuing you.

records.zh: 玩家操纵地面载具左右移动，瞄准上方母舰不断释放的小型无人机。击毁来袭敌人可以得分，但还要及时避开它们的攻击，在有限的横向活动范围内持续寻找安全射击位置。
records.en: Move a vehicle horizontally beneath an enemy mothership and shoot the smaller drones it repeatedly deploys. Destroying attackers earns points, but their return fire also forces you to reposition, balancing shots at overhead targets with keeping a safe position below.

records.zh: 玩家控制阿斯泰利克斯在不同横行之间移动，接取从画面横向经过的奖励物品。竖琴混在这些物品中，碰到便会损失生命，因此需要辨认目标、选择行列，并及时避开危险物。
records.en: Guide Asterix between rows and across the screen to collect passing reward objects. Lyres travel among the useful items and cost a life when collected, so choosing a row and moving across it must account for both pickups and dangerous objects.

records.zh: 玩家通过转向和推进驾驶飞船，在小行星群中开火，将岩石逐步击碎。清除当前所有小行星后进入下一关，还要应对偶尔出现的飞碟，避免飞船在移动和射击时与危险目标碰撞。
records.en: Rotate and thrust a spaceship through an asteroid field, firing to break up the rocks. Clearing every asteroid advances to another wave, while occasional flying saucers add another threat that must be handled alongside movement through the remaining debris.

records.zh: 玩家使用三座防御炮台拦截逐渐逼近的敌机，保护水下城市的七处设施。所有设施被摧毁便会失败；守住敌人一波进攻并积累足够分数后，可以重建设施，继续维持防线。
records.en: Use three defense posts to intercept enemies descending toward an underwater city. Losing all seven installations ends the game, while surviving a wave and scoring enough points can rebuild installations, making the defense depend on both interception and keeping the city intact.

records.zh: 玩家驾驶逃跑汽车穿行于城市迷宫，抢劫银行后摆脱随之出现的警车。可以投放炸药摧毁追兵，但也要避开自己留下的炸药；燃料耗尽会损失生命，进入新城市才能补充油箱。
records.en: Drive a getaway car through maze-like streets and rob banks while police cars pursue you. Dropped dynamite can destroy pursuers but also endangers your own car; running out of fuel costs a life, and entering a new city replenishes the tank.

records.zh: 玩家读取屏幕显示的基础算术题，再用摇杆逐项选择要提交的数值答案。题目给出待计算的数值，玩家先求出结果，再滚动答案选项，停在对应数字上提交。
records.en: Read the arithmetic problem shown on screen and use the joystick to scroll to a numerical answer. Calculate the result from the displayed values, scroll through the possible answers and stop at the matching number to submit your choice.

records.zh: 玩家从坦克内的第一人称视角驾驶和射击，寻找并摧毁周围的敌方载具。雷达会显示附近敌人的方位，需要结合前方视野调整朝向；受到攻击会损失坦克，得分可带来额外生命。
records.en: Drive and fire a tank from a first-person viewpoint, locating and destroying enemy vehicles. A radar shows threats around you beyond the forward view, so turning and aiming depend on both displays; sufficiently high scores can provide additional lives.

records.zh: 玩家的飞船保持向前行进，只能在离散轨道之间左右切换。需要击毁迎面的敌舰，同时避开敌方攻击和太空残骸；闪避时可用的位置受轨道限制，射击与换道必须相互配合。
records.en: Your spaceship moves forward at a constant speed while you steer sideways between fixed lanes. Shoot approaching enemy ships and dodge their attacks and space debris, using the limited lane positions to keep firing opportunities open without moving into another hazard.

records.zh: 玩家在布满机器人的迷宫中移动和射击，清除敌人并寻找可通过的路线。迷宫墙壁本身也致命；部分模式还会出现无法击败的 Evil Otto，但默认模式不含该敌人。
records.en: Move through robot-filled mazes and shoot enemies while keeping clear of the walls, which are themselves lethal. Some modes also introduce Evil Otto, an indestructible pursuer that must be avoided; he is absent from the default mode described by ALE.

records.zh: 玩家控制投球，争取在十局比赛中击倒尽可能多的球瓶。每局最多有两次尝试，第一球全倒记为全中，第二球补齐记为补中；投球结果会影响整场累计得分。
records.en: Control your rolls to knock down pins across a ten-frame bowling game. Each frame allows two attempts: clearing every pin on the first roll gives a strike, while clearing the remainder on the second gives a spare and changes the score.

records.zh: 玩家在拳台中移动和出拳，设法打中对手，同时调整距离以避免自己被连续命中。每次有效击打都会得分，达到一百分可直接击倒对方，因此既要寻找出拳机会，也要保持有利位置。
records.en: Move around the boxing ring and throw punches to land hits on your opponent. Successful strikes add points, and reaching one hundred points knocks the opponent out, so controlling distance and creating repeated openings are central to winning the bout.

records.zh: 玩家左右移动底部挡板，将小球反弹到上方砖墙，逐块击碎砖块。小球从底部落出会消耗生命；若打通墙面通道，球还可能进入砖墙上方连续反弹，快速清除剩余砖块。
records.en: Move the bottom paddle to keep a ball rebounding into the brick wall above. Missing the ball costs a life; opening a passage through the wall can send it behind the bricks, where repeated rebounds clear blocks without another paddle hit.

records.zh: 玩家横向移动枪口，射击在画面中横向经过的目标。弹药数量有限，需要减少落空；小鸡若未及时击中，还会偷走子弹，因此射击次序也会影响后续可用的弹药。
records.en: Move the gun horizontally and shoot targets as they pass across the screen. Ammunition is limited, and chickens can steal bullets if left unhit, so choosing which targets to shoot first affects both the score and the shots still available.

records.zh: 玩家操控底部角色射击蜈蚣、蜘蛛和跳蚤，阻止它们不断接近。被这些敌人咬中会暂时麻痹并失去一根魔杖，魔杖耗尽后结束游戏；积累足够分数则能补充魔杖，延长生存。
records.en: Shoot centipedes, spiders and fleas as they approach the player area. A bite temporarily paralyzes the character and costs a magic wand; losing every wand ends the game, while sufficiently high scores grant replacements and allow the defense to continue.

records.zh: 玩家驾驶直升机巡逻并击落敌机，保护地面正在移动的卡车车队。画面底部的小地图会显示战场情况，需要结合局部视野寻找来袭目标，在空战和车队防护之间及时转移位置。
records.en: Pilot a helicopter and shoot down enemy aircraft to protect truck convoys on the ground. The minimap at the bottom of the screen helps locate threats outside the immediate view, guiding where to fly next while keeping the convoy defended.

records.zh: 玩家交替控制攀爬动作，沿大楼外墙向屋顶前进，避开突然关闭的窗户和坠落物。受到这些障碍伤害会跌落并损失生命；到顶后还要抓住直升机，才能前往下一栋大楼。
records.en: Climb the outside of buildings while avoiding closing windows and falling objects. Being struck makes the climber fall and lose a life; at the roof, catching a helicopter advances to the next building, rewarding a quick ascent with little damage.

records.zh: 玩家左右移动并射击一波波恶魔，躲开它们的反击。每次被击中都会失去一座备用掩体，无伤度过一波则能补充掩体；储备耗尽后再中弹便会结束游戏。
records.en: Move sideways and shoot successive waves of demons while dodging return fire. A hit destroys a reserve bunker, whereas surviving an entire wave without damage adds one; once the reserve is exhausted, another hit ends the defense and the game.

records.zh: 玩家进行二对二篮球比赛，在每次获得球权时先选择进攻或防守战术，再操作队员执行。跑位、传球和投篮需要围绕选定战术配合，既要创造得分机会，也要阻止对方完成进攻。
records.en: Play two-on-two basketball by selecting a play at the start of each possession and then executing it on court. Movement, passing and shooting must work together to create scoring chances, while defensive possessions require stopping the opposing pair from scoring.

records.zh: 玩家扮演特工，乘电梯或走楼梯逐层下行，进入红门房间取得秘密文件，并射击阻挡的敌方特工。抵达地面后撤离并进入下一关；这里收录的是基于街机作品制作的未发行原型。
records.en: Descend a building using elevators and stairs, entering red-door rooms to retrieve secret documents and shooting hostile agents along the way. Reaching ground level enables escape and the next stage; this Atari version is an unreleased prototype based on the arcade game.
records.reason: 保留 ALE 对未发行 Atari 2600 原型的版本说明。

records.zh: 玩家驾驶赛车在昼夜变化中持续超车，争取在当天结束前完成规定数量。首日需要超越二百辆车，此后每天三百辆；若当天未达到配额，耐力赛就会结束。
records.en: Drive through changing days and nights, overtaking enough cars before each day ends. The first day requires passing two hundred cars and later days require three hundred; failing the daily quota ends the endurance race regardless of earlier progress.

records.zh: 玩家控制钓线在鱼群中下钩，设法钓起比对手更多的太阳鱼。双方争夺同一片水域里的渔获，需要把钓线送到鱼活动的位置，并把握收线时机，持续增加己方捕获数量。
records.en: Control a fishing line to catch sunfish while competing against another angler. The objective is to bring in more fish than the opponent, placing the line where fish are moving and timing retrieval to keep increasing your share of the catch.

records.zh: 玩家引导小鸡向画面上方移动，依次穿过多条繁忙车道，避开来往车辆。每成功穿越整条道路一次便获得一分，因此需要观察各车道空隙，连续完成安全过街来提高总分。
records.en: Guide a chicken upward across successive lanes of busy traffic without being hit. Each successful crossing to the top of the screen earns one point, so the objective is to find gaps between vehicles and complete as many full crossings as possible.

records.zh: 玩家控制 Frostbite Bailey 在北极河流的浮冰间来回跳跃，把白色冰块变成蓝色。每次改变冰块颜色都会为岸边冰屋添上一块材料，需要在移动冰面上选择落点，并避开周围危险。
records.en: Hop back and forth across an Arctic river on moving ice floes, changing their color from white to blue. Each color change adds a block to the igloo, so choosing safe landings advances construction while the surrounding hazards threaten the builder.

records.zh: 玩家控制持铲农夫，在地面与地洞附近行动，保护仅有的三根胡萝卜。地鼠会挖掘通道偷取作物，需要及时用铲子处理地洞和来袭地鼠，避免它从防线的空隙接近菜地。
records.en: Control a shovel-wielding farmer protecting a crop of three carrots from a gopher. Respond to its tunnels and approaches with the shovel, filling holes beneath the garden and striking the animal as it emerges near the crop.

evidence.locator: Original game instruction manual: How to Play / Controls

records.zh: 玩家驾驶小型飞船在太阳系中移动，进入星球后切换到侧面视角的地形。飞行会受到重力影响，需要控制朝向和推力接近地面目标，并在攻击时避免飞船坠落或撞上地形。
records.en: Pilot a small spacecraft around a solar system and enter planets to explore their side-view landscapes. Gravity affects the ship, so rotating and applying thrust must keep it clear of terrain while positioning it to attack targets on the surface.

records.zh: 玩家利用旋翼背包深入矿井寻找受困矿工，可用炸药炸开墙壁、激光清除害虫，并借助木筏越过熔岩。行动消耗有限能量，必须在耗尽前完成救援，否则会损失生命。
records.en: Fly into mine shafts with a propeller backpack to rescue trapped miners. Dynamite opens walls, a laser removes vermin and a raft crosses lava, but power is limited, so reaching the miner before it runs out is essential to survival.

records.zh: 玩家根据炮口角度、发射速度和水塔距离，把人体炮弹送入水塔。不同模式允许调节的参数不同，部分值由电脑指定；需要先读清当前设定，再判断飞行弧线能否落入目标。
records.en: Send a human projectile from a cannon into a water tower, accounting for launch angle, speed and distance. Which variables you can adjust depends on the selected mode; read the current settings and judge whether the resulting flight arc will reach the target.

evidence.locator: Original game instruction manual: How to Play / Controls

records.zh: 玩家操控冰球队员移动、传球和射门，在三分钟内争取比对手取得更多进球。射门有多种角度可选，也能借助球场侧边反弹传球，利用队员位置寻找通往对方球门的路线。
records.en: Move hockey players, pass the puck and shoot to outscore the opponent within three minutes. Shots allow multiple angles toward the opposing goal, and the rink's sides can be used for rebound passes that create a better route to a scoring position.

records.zh: 玩家驾驶邦德的多用途载具，控制前后移动、跃起和下潜来完成不同阶段任务。武器可向画面下方投掷炸弹，也可向上方进行固定角度射击，需要按目标位置选择行动和攻击方向。
records.en: Control Bond's multipurpose craft through a sequence of missions, moving forward or back and jumping or diving when needed. Attack by lobbing bombs downward or firing a fixed-angle shot upward, choosing movement and weapon direction to suit the target's position.

records.zh: 玩家带领 JOURNEY 乐队的五名成员穿过后台人群与障碍，在倒计时结束前抵达逃生车辆。追逐的歌迷、摄影师和推广人员还会威胁演出收入，需要在赶路时保护随身现金。
records.en: Guide all five JOURNEY band members through backstage crowds and obstacles to reach the escape vehicle before time runs out. Groupies, photographers and promoters also threaten the concert cash, so navigating the route means protecting money as well as arriving in time.

records.zh: 玩家控制袋鼠妈妈向上攀登，爬梯、收集奖励水果，并挥拳击退阻拦的猴子。目标是穿过各层障碍救出幼崽；行进时既要判断跳跃和攀爬位置，也要及时处理身边敌人。
records.en: Control Mother Kangaroo as she climbs ladders and works through obstacles to rescue her baby. Pick up bonus fruit and punch monkeys along the route, combining upward movement with close-range attacks so enemies do not interrupt the climb to the child.

records.zh: 玩家接住不断翻落的彩色方块，再选择位置把它们放入下方槽位。目标是让三个或更多同色块排成连线，放置次序会改变后续可用空间，需要在接取新块时兼顾已有排列。
records.en: Catch tumbling colored tiles and choose where to drop them into the bins below. Form lines of three or more matching tiles, arranging each placement around the existing pattern while keeping enough room and attention available to handle the next falling pieces.

records.zh: 玩家穿过多个动作场景，寻找并进入野兽的黑色城堡，救出莉莎公主并消灭野兽。城堡的位置会随每次日出改变，前进途中不仅要应对敌人，也要重新确定通往最终目标的路线。
records.en: Work through action scenes to locate and enter the Beast's Black Fortress, rescue Princess Lyssa and destroy the Beast. The fortress changes location with each sunrise on Krull, so reaching it requires finding the destination again as the adventure progresses.

records.zh: 玩家操控武术高手在邪恶巫师的寺庙中前进，以近身攻击击退沿途敌人。目标是一路突破阻拦救出维多利亚公主，需要在狭窄行进路线中掌握与敌人的距离和出手时机。
records.en: Fight through the Evil Wizard's temple as a kung-fu master, using close-range attacks against enemies along the way. The goal is to rescue Princess Victoria, advancing through opposition while choosing when to approach, strike and continue toward the next part of the route.

records.zh: 玩家在相互连接的遗迹房间间跳跃和攀爬，寻找宝物以及帮助通行的钥匙、工具。危险生物和机关会阻挡路线，需要先判断落脚点与可达通道，再把收集到的物品用于继续探索。
records.en: Jump and climb through a maze of chambers in Montezuma's fortress, collecting treasure and useful tools. Deadly creatures and traps interrupt the routes between rooms, so each crossing requires judging safe footholds and which collected items can help you proceed or escape.

records.zh: 玩家在迷宫中沿通道移动，吃掉画面上的全部豆子，同时避开追逐的幽灵。能量豆可让追逃关系暂时逆转，为清除危险区域创造机会；路线安排需要兼顾剩余豆子和幽灵位置。
records.en: Move through a maze and collect every pellet while avoiding the ghosts that share its corridors. Power pellets temporarily reverse the chase, opening an opportunity to clear dangerous passages; choosing a route depends on both remaining pellets and nearby ghost positions.

records.zh: 玩家在海底守护发现的宝藏，射击并抵御不断靠近的鲨鱼和章鱼。氧气供应也会持续限制停留时间，需要一边处理攻击一边留意氧气，避免只顾保护财宝却失去生存条件。
records.en: Defend treasure on the seabed against a shark and an octopus while watching your oxygen supply. The objective requires handling the approaching attackers without neglecting the air needed to remain underwater, keeping both the treasure and the diver protected.

records.zh: 双方轮流在棋盘上放置黑白棋子，通过夹住对方的一列或一行棋子将其翻为己色。终局以己方棋子数量较多为目标，每次落子都可能改变多枚棋子的归属，进而影响下一步可选位置。
records.en: Take turns placing black or white discs on the board, bracketing opposing discs to flip them to your color. The aim is to finish with more discs than the opponent, with each placement potentially changing several discs and the moves available afterward.

records.zh: 玩家移动飞船并射击成波鸟形敌机，同时躲开它们投下的炸弹。前面的敌群清除后，继续接近并射击外星驾驶员；需要在连续进攻中维持安全位置，才能到达最后目标。
records.en: Move and fire at waves of bird-like enemy craft while avoiding the bombs they drop. The objective is ultimately to reach and shoot the alien pilot, surviving the preceding waves long enough to bring the final target into your firing path.

records.zh: 玩家控制哈里在丛林中奔跑、跳跃和摆荡，绕开陷坑等危险并寻找散布的宝藏。全程只有二十分钟和三条生命，必须在时间或生命耗尽前完成收集，穿越路线会影响可取得的宝物数量。
records.en: Run, jump and swing through a jungle as Pitfall Harry, avoiding hazards while gathering treasure. You have twenty minutes and three lives to collect everything; the game ends when the treasures are recovered, the time expires or the remaining lives are lost.

records.zh: 玩家控制右侧球拍上下移动，将飞来的小球反弹到电脑控制的左侧场地。需要防止球越过己方底线，同时设法让回球穿过对方防守；双方围绕连续回合中的落点变化争取得分。
records.en: Move the right-hand paddle up and down to return a ball against the computer-controlled paddle on the left. Keep it from passing your own goal while directing returns past the opponent, sustaining rallies until one side misses and concedes a point.

records.zh: 玩家控制母猪沿绳索上下移动，射箭击破狼的气球，阻止它们接近幼崽。狼会投掷石块，安全落地后也会绕到身后攻击；不同场景中还要拦截向上漂浮的狼，选择合适射击时机。
records.en: Move Mother Pig up and down a rope and shoot arrows at the wolves' balloons to protect her piglets. Dodge thrown stones and stop wolves reaching dangerous positions; later scenes reverse their travel as they float upward and must again be intercepted.

records.zh: 玩家扮演侦探皮埃尔，驾车或步行穿过城市街道、公园和秘密通道，寻找帮派线索。需要收集散落的证据与赃物，并在各案件的时限内完成调查，单行道和死路会影响路线选择。
records.en: Explore city streets, parks and secret passages as detective Pierre Touche, searching for a criminal gang. Gather scattered evidence and stolen goods to complete each case before its deadline, navigating one-way streets and dead ends while deciding where to investigate next.

records.zh: 玩家控制 Q*bert 在金字塔的方块之间逐格跳跃，把全部方块变成指定的目标颜色。敌人也会在这些落脚点附近活动，需要在补齐剩余颜色时避开它们，防止前进路线被封住。
records.en: Hop from cube to cube on a pyramid, changing each one to the required destination color. Creatures move around the same structure, so completing the remaining color changes requires choosing landings that avoid enemies while still reaching every cube that needs attention.

records.zh: 玩家驾驶战机沿河流前进，左右移动并发射导弹击毁敌方目标。撞上河岸或敌人会损失飞机，燃料耗尽也会失败；经过油库能够补充燃料，因此射击和补给路线需要同时考虑。
records.en: Fly a jet along a river, steering sideways and firing missiles at enemy targets. Colliding with the banks or enemies loses a jet, and fuel also runs out; flying over depots refills the tank, making refueling part of the route through the defenses.

records.zh: 玩家控制走鹃奔跑与跳跃，沿途吃种子得分，并甩开紧追的郊狼。卡车、地雷、悬崖和落石都会造成危险，郊狼也会使用火箭和大炮，需要不断根据前方障碍调整移动时机。
records.en: Run and jump as Road Runner, eating seeds along the road while staying ahead of Wile E. Coyote. Trucks, mines, cliffs and falling rocks threaten the route, and the coyote adds rockets and cannon attacks that require timely changes of movement.

records.zh: 玩家驾驶机器人坦克射击敌方中队，同时躲避火箭。中弹可能导致画面出现干扰或仪表报告损伤；摧毁一个中队可补充备用坦克，需要在视野受损时继续作战，直到清除敌军或己方耗尽。
records.en: Drive a robot tank against enemy squadrons while avoiding rocket fire. Hits may scramble the view or damage systems shown on the control panel, while defeating a squadron grants a reserve tank; combat continues until the enemy force or your tanks are exhausted.

records.zh: 玩家驾驶潜艇向各方向移动、发射鱼雷，救回潜水员并清除鲨鱼和敌潜艇。氧气会持续减少，必须及时上浮补充；未接满六名潜水员就上浮还会损失一人，需要权衡救援与返航。
records.en: Move a submarine in all directions, fire torpedoes and retrieve divers while avoiding sharks and enemy subs. Oxygen steadily drains and forces surfacing; returning with fewer than six divers also loses one, so rescue attempts must leave enough air for the trip upward.

records.zh: 玩家左右转向控制滑雪者下坡，穿过每组旗杆之间的门，并避开树木。目标是尽快完成整条赛道，漏过一个旗门会追加五秒；路线既要经过全部旗门，也要控制碰撞带来的停顿。
records.en: Steer a skier downhill through the space between each pair of gate poles while avoiding trees. Finish in the shortest total time, accounting for the five-second penalty added for each missed gate and the interruption caused by hitting an obstacle.

records.zh: 玩家驾驶飞船在星区之间跃迁，消灭 Zylon 敌军并保卫联邦星球。燃料耗尽会损失生命，需要前往联邦星球补给；最终争取抵达 Solaris，同时避免所有飞船在沿途战斗中被摧毁。
records.en: Warp a spaceship between sectors, destroy Zylon forces and defend Federation planets. Fuel must be replenished at friendly planets before it runs out; the journey ends when you reach Solaris or lose every ship, linking navigation, combat and refueling across the sectors.

records.zh: 玩家左右移动地面的激光炮台，射击不断向地球下降的外星方阵。既要及时清除敌人，也要躲避它们的反击；生命耗尽或入侵者抵达地面都会结束游戏，防线会随敌群逼近而收紧。
records.en: Move a ground-based laser cannon sideways and shoot the alien formations before they descend to Earth. Avoid their return fire while reducing the approaching force; the game ends if all lives are lost or the invaders reach the ground despite your defense.

records.zh: 玩家操纵武器射击来袭飞碟和外星生物，阻止入侵者继续推进。攻击过程中还会受到炸弹威胁，需要在瞄准目标时及时闪避，避免因持续追击同一敌人而留在危险位置。
records.en: Shoot the incoming alien saucers and creatures to stop their invasion. Bombs threaten the player during the attack, so movement and aiming work together as you track the approaching attackers and evade the incoming hazards.

records.zh: 玩家控制不断移动并留下轨迹的角色，利用自己的路线封住对手的去路。已有轨迹和场地边界都会限制空间，需要在围困对方时为自己保留出口，避免先撞上任何障碍。
records.en: Steer a continuously moving trail to surround the opponent and cut off their available space. Existing trails and the arena boundaries also block your own route, so every attempt to trap the other player must leave room to turn and survive.

records.zh: 玩家控制橙色球员，与电脑控制的蓝色球员接发球和对打，争取赢下一局局比赛。至少赢得六局且领先两局才获胜；六比六之后继续比赛，直到一方拉开两局差距。
records.en: Control the orange player against a computer-controlled blue opponent, moving into position and returning shots to win games. A match requires at least six games and a two-game lead; at six-all, play continues until one player opens that two-game margin.

records.zh: 玩家驾驶飞机转向和射击，击落从周围接近的敌方飞行器。随着关卡推进，对手会从较早时代的飞机变成技术更先进的敌人，需要持续调整飞行路线，在包围中寻找射击与脱离的空间。
records.en: Pilot an aircraft and fire at enemies approaching from around the screen. As stages advance, opposing aircraft represent progressively later technologies, bringing different enemy waves into each stage as you maneuver to find firing opportunities around them.

records.zh: 玩家在陵墓迷宫中穿过通道寻找宝藏，利用射击清除挡路的守卫。得分来自探索所得和消灭敌人，需要判断通道的连通关系，在进入新区域时留意怪物位置，避免被困在危险路段。
records.en: Navigate the corridors of a tomb maze, collecting treasure and shooting its guardians. Both recovered valuables and eliminated enemies contribute to the objective, while the branching passages require choosing where to move next without becoming caught among threats in the route.

records.zh: 玩家驾驶越野车沿道路前进，收集旗标和奖励，同时对付占据路线的对手车辆。跳跃既能越过危险，也可用于消灭敌车，需要结合道路走向和车辆位置选择落点，避免在收集时撞车。
records.en: Drive a baja buggy along the roads, collecting flags and prizes while dealing with opposing vehicles. Jumps can help avoid danger or eliminate another car, so landing positions must account for the road ahead as well as the objects you want to collect.

evidence.locator: Original game instruction manual: How to Play / Controls

records.zh: 玩家进入地牢中的各个房间，射击怪物并带走房内宝藏。需要在房间入口、敌人和宝物之间选择移动路线，清除阻挡后继续探索其他房间，争取取得整座地牢的财物。
records.en: Enter the chambers of a dungeon, shoot the monsters inside and recover each room's treasure. Movement must connect entrances, targets and valuables without leaving the character surrounded, allowing you to clear one chamber and continue toward the treasures still waiting elsewhere.

records.zh: 玩家操作弹球台，让小球在台面上反弹并命中不同目标，持续累积分数。需要尽量防止球从台面失落，在有限操作机会中影响它的运动，使一次发球能够维持更久并触发更多得分。
records.en: Operate a pinball table to keep the ball moving and send it into scoring targets. The objective is to prolong each ball's time in play while accumulating points, using the available controls to influence rebounds before the ball is lost from the table.

records.zh: 玩家在迷宫中移动，利用激光武器寻找并消灭怪物，最终迎战巫师。雷达扫描能帮助判断敌人方位，需要结合通道布局选择射击位置，避免只盯着前方而忽略从其他方向靠近的威胁。
records.en: Move through a maze and use a laser to fight monsters and the Wizard. The radar scanner helps locate enemies beyond the immediate line of sight, so successful movement combines reading that display with choosing corridors that give a useful firing position.

records.zh: 玩家攻击敌方护盾，逐步打通通往 Qotile 的射击路径。真正摧毁目标需要使用强力的 Zorlon Cannon，因此要先处理挡路护盾，再把握炮击位置与时机，完成从破防到终结的连续行动。
records.en: Attack the enemy shield to open a path to the Qotile behind it. Destroying that target requires a blast from the Zorlon Cannon, so breaching the barrier is only the first step before positioning the decisive shot through the opening you created.

records.zh: 玩家驾驶斜视角战机穿越敌方防线，射击沿途设施和敌机，阻止机器人 Zaxxon 的军队。飞行时还要结合斜视角画面判断障碍位置，调整航线，在安全穿越防线的同时寻找射击机会。
records.en: Pilot a fighter through enemy defenses and shoot hostile aircraft and installations to stop Zaxxon's forces. The angled view also requires judging the ship's position relative to obstacles, combining a safe flight path with opportunities to fire at targets along the route.

records.zh: 玩家可以把棋子复制到邻格，或跳到两格外的空位；落点附近的敌子会转为己方颜色。每步既改变数量也改变分布，需要比较扩张收益与留下空隙的风险，终局以棋子数争胜。
records.en: Clone a piece into a neighboring square or jump to a square two spaces away, converting nearby opponents when you land. Each move changes both numbers and position, so compare immediate gains with the openings left behind while building the final majority.

records.zh: 玩家提名任务队伍、讨论并投票决定是否出发，随后由队员秘密选择任务结果。善方要取得足够任务成功，同时掩护梅林；恶方既可破坏任务，也可在终局尝试找出并刺杀梅林。
records.en: Propose mission teams, debate their membership and vote before team members secretly resolve the mission. Good players need successful missions while concealing Merlin's identity; evil players can sabotage those efforts and retain a final opportunity to identify and assassinate Merlin.

records.zh: 玩家在网格中推动物体和文字，把“主体—关系—属性”的词块重新排列成规则。新的句子会改变哪些东西可推动、可穿越或能够获胜，需要利用这些变化打开原先走不通的路线。
records.en: Push objects and word tiles around a grid, rearranging subject–relation–property statements into working rules. Those rules alter how objects behave and what counts as winning, so changing a sentence can open a route that ordinary movement alone could not solve.

records.zh: 玩家既移动角色，也推动组成句子的文字，改变场景里正在生效的规则。物体属性与获胜条件可以随词序变化，解题常要先重写规则，再利用改变后的环境走向目标。
records.en: Move your character and push the words that define the current rules of the room. Rearranging those statements changes object properties or victory conditions, so solving a level can require rewriting how the environment works before following the resulting path to the goal.

records.zh: 角色按指令寻找指定物体，通过拾取钥匙、开门和摆放物品完成目标。部分任务把多个子目标连在一起，需要分清目标对象与执行先后，避免完成单个操作后遗漏指令中的其他要求。
records.en: Follow instructions to find objects, pick up keys, open doors or place items where requested. Some levels connect several objectives, making the identity of each object and the order of interactions part of completing the instruction.

records.zh: 双方按骰点移动棋子，在推进途中阻挡对方，或把落单的敌子击回起点。玩家要根据每次掷骰重新选择行动，在保护棋子与加快进度之间取舍，率先把全部己方棋子移出棋盘。
records.en: Use dice rolls to move your pieces, block opposing routes and send exposed enemy pieces back. Reconsider the available moves after each roll, balancing safe formations against faster progress as you race to bear off every piece before your opponent does.

records.zh: 玩家通过文字命令探索场景，寻找卷轴并学会不同法术，再把法术用于物品和环境。推进取决于发现咒语之间的相互作用，常需要带着新获得的魔法回看先前遇到的谜题。
records.en: Explore through text commands, find scrolls and learn spells that can be applied to objects and the environment. Work out how magical effects interact, returning to earlier obstacles with new possibilities as you combine inventory clues and spell use to advance.

records.zh: 玩家先为冷僻问题编写看似可信的解释，再从真实答案与其他人的虚构选项中作出选择。既要让自己的说法足够有说服力，也要辨认别人刻意制造的可信细节，避免被假答案误导。
records.en: Write a plausible explanation for an obscure question, then choose among the real answer and other players' inventions. Try to make your own entry convincing while judging which details in the competing answers are informative and which were written to mislead you.

records.zh: 两名玩家各自选择行动，只有行动相互协调时才能得到共同收益，但双方偏好的协调结果不同。需要判断对方更可能选择哪一边，在坚持个人偏好与避免无法配合之间作出选择。
records.en: Both players benefit from coordinating their actions, but each prefers a different coordinated outcome. Choose with the other player's likely decision in mind, weighing the outcome you want most against the possibility that insisting on it will prevent coordination altogether.

records.zh: 双方先把舰船布置在各自隐藏的网格上，再轮流报出坐标攻击。根据命中或落空反馈缩小搜索范围，推断尚未暴露的舰船位置，争取先击沉对方全部舰船。
records.en: Place ships on a hidden grid, then take turns attacking coordinates on the opponent's board. Use hit and miss feedback to narrow the search and follow promising lines, trying to sink the entire opposing fleet before your own ships are found.

records.zh: 玩家把木块、轮轴和机械部件组合成载具或装置，运行物理仿真，观察它能否越过障碍、运送物品或摧毁目标。根据运动与结构表现修改搭建和控制方式，再次测试，让设计逐步符合当前关卡要求。
records.en: Assemble wooden blocks, axles and mechanical parts into a vehicle or device, then run the physics simulation to test it against obstacles, transport goals or destruction targets. Revise the structure and controls from what happens, repeating the build-and-test cycle until the design fits the level.

records.zh: 玩家经营金属与能源供应，建造生产设施和防御，再实时调动陆海空部队争夺战场。前线扩张需要后方持续供给，部队调遣也要配合基地建设，避免经济停滞或防线出现缺口。
records.en: Manage metal and energy production, build factories and defenses, and command land, sea and air forces in real time. Coordinate the supply behind the front with attacks and protection, keeping expansion from leaving either the economy or an important position exposed.

records.zh: 玩家以棍术、法术和变身迎战妖怪与首领，观察动作后选择进攻、躲避与能力使用的时机。探索沿途场景并发展技能，可以改变后续战斗的应对方式，再用新的组合挑战更强敌人。
records.en: Fight creatures and bosses using staff techniques, spells and transformations, watching their movements to time attacks and evasions. Explore the surroundings and develop combat skills between encounters, adapting the combination of tools you use when a new opponent demands a different approach.

records.zh: 玩家根据当前手牌选择继续要牌或停牌，目标是在不超过 21 点的前提下取得更有利的点数。每次补牌都可能改善手牌，也可能立刻超点，需要在继续追求分数与保留现状之间取舍。
records.en: Choose whether to take another card or stand on the hand you have, aiming for a favorable total without exceeding 21. Each extra card offers improvement but also the risk of busting, making the decision to stop as important as the draw.

records.zh: 玩家选择武器和技能不同的角色，与队友一起交战，并按模式争夺据点或收集目标资源。不同角色通过火力、移动与支援互相配合，在交战中推进当前地图目标。
records.en: Choose a character with distinct weapons and abilities, then fight alongside teammates to contest locations or collect objective resources. Coordinate support and engagements around the current mode's goal, deciding when a fight helps the team and when it draws attention away from progress.

records.zh: 两名玩家分别选择动作序列，共同争取有收益的终局。双方选择是否兼容决定能否成功，规则区分 S 结果与回报更高的 G 结果，使两人的联合选择成为对局核心。
records.en: Two players choose their own action sequences to reach a rewarded ending together. The selections must be compatible, with the rules distinguishing an S outcome from the higher G payoff and making the combined sequence central to the result.

records.zh: 玩家在俯视场景中探索、放置炸弹并击败怪物，从中取得物品与新能力。炸弹既用于战斗也影响通路，获得能力后可进入先前受阻的区域，把探索和升级不断连接起来。
records.en: Explore overhead areas, plant bombs and defeat monsters to obtain items and abilities. Bomb placement affects both combat and access, while new capabilities open previously blocked areas, creating a loop of encounters, discoveries and returning to routes that were once inaccessible.

records.zh: 小方块持续向前移动，玩家只能把握弹跳时机，越过尖刺、平台间隙和其他障碍。每次起跳都会影响接下来的落点，需要观察前方组合，让连续跳跃保持在安全路线之内。
records.en: A small block keeps moving forward while you time its jumps over spikes and gaps. Watch how each obstacle leads into the next, placing takeoffs and landings so that a successful jump also leaves enough room to handle the following section.

records.zh: 左右移动底部挡板，让反弹的小球持续击打顶部砖墙，尽量清除砖块。每次回球都要重新判断落点并调整挡板，避免小球从底部落出；此处对应的是浏览器实现。
records.en: Move the paddle left and right to keep a ball bouncing into the brick wall above. Reposition for each return and work toward clearing the bricks without letting the ball escape below the paddle; this entry concerns the browser implementation.

records.zh: 双方先通过叫牌确定定约，再由同伴配合争取所需牌墩。出牌时要结合花色、将牌与已经出现的牌推断分布，既安排己方赢墩顺序，也设法阻止对方完成定约。
records.en: Bid to establish a contract, then work with your partner to take the required number of tricks. Use suit, trump and previously played cards to judge the remaining distribution, arranging your winners while trying to stop the other side from completing its contract.

records.zh: 玩家要穿过 N×N 网格，寻找位于远端的稀疏奖励终点。途中多数行动没有即时奖励，连续选择必须组合成能够抵达终点的完整路线。
records.en: Traverse an N×N grid to reach a sparsely rewarded destination. Most intermediate moves provide little immediate confirmation, and progress depends on selecting a connected sequence that takes the player all the way to the rewarding end.

records.zh: 玩家从突击、支援、医疗和狙击干员中选择角色，利用技能与队友共享敌情并相互掩护。行动围绕合作任务或队伍对抗的目标展开，既要处理前方威胁，也要照顾队友位置和支援需求。
records.en: Choose an assault, support, medic or sniper operator and coordinate abilities, information and protection with teammates. Pursue the objective in cooperative missions or team combat, attending to the squad's positions and support needs alongside the threats immediately in front of you.

records.zh: 玩家交换相邻糖果，把同色糖果连在一起消除，并利用后续掉落触发连锁。关卡限制与目标决定组合的价值，消除后的新布局又提供下一轮交换机会。
records.en: Swap neighboring candies to create matching lines and trigger cascades as the board changes. Complete the level's objective within its limits, arranging matches so that the falling pieces create further useful combinations.

records.zh: 控制 Callisto 在太空关卡中跳跃，并借助喷气背包穿过难以直接跨越的地形。玩家要在移动中避开障碍、修正落点，找到通往出口的路线，让跳跃与空中调整相互衔接。
records.en: Guide Callisto through space-themed stages using jumps and a jetpack to cross the terrain. Avoid obstacles while correcting the approach to each landing, linking ground movement with airborne adjustments as you work out a safe route toward the exit.

records.zh: 多数玩家知道秘密词，每人用一个词给出线索；不知道答案的变色龙必须听取线索并伪装成知情者。其他人据此判断谁在混淆视听，而变色龙还可以尝试从交流中猜出秘密词。
records.en: Most players know a secret word and contribute one-word clues; the uninformed Chameleon must listen and blend in. Judge which clues suggest real knowledge without revealing too much, while the Chameleon tries to infer the answer from the discussion.

records.zh: 双方利用王、后、车、象、马和兵的不同走法，安排进攻并保护己方国王。目标是让对方国王受到无法解除的将军；交换棋子、控制通路与避免己方被将死需要一起考虑。
records.en: Use the distinct moves of kings, queens, rooks, bishops, knights and pawns to attack while protecting your own king. Aim for checkmate, balancing exchanges and control of the board against the immediate threats that could leave your king without a legal escape.

records.zh: 恐龙持续向前奔跑，玩家通过跳跃和躲避越过仙人掌与飞鸟，争取延长行程。速度上升后反应时间缩短，连续障碍的间距会决定下一次起跳和躲避的时机。
records.en: The dinosaur runs continuously as you jump past cacti and avoid birds to extend the run. Increasing speed leaves less time to respond, requiring you to judge the spacing of successive obstacles and time movements so that one safe passage leads into the next.

records.zh: 玩家规划道路和城市区域，建设公共服务，并利用预算回应居民的持续需求。新增区域会带来交通和服务压力，需要在扩张后继续调整路网与设施，让城市的发展和日常运作相互匹配。
records.en: Plan roads and districts, provide public services and use the budget to meet residents' needs. New development changes traffic and demand, so revisit the network and facilities as the city grows, keeping expansion compatible with the systems that support everyday urban life.

records.zh: 玩家从早期聚落建立城市，研究科技、探索地图，并以经济、外交或战争扩大文明的影响。每轮发展都会影响后续选择，需要让城市建设、对外关系和军队行动共同服务于长期目标。
records.en: Begin with an early settlement, build cities and research technologies while exploring the map. Expand through economic development, diplomacy and warfare, coordinating what your cities produce with foreign relations and military movement as the civilization develops across successive turns.

records.zh: 玩家经营城市、研究科技和社会政策，在探索与外交中决定文明的发展方向。军队可以保卫领土或参与扩张，但不同胜利条件所需的投入不同，需要让城市生产与选定路线持续配合。
records.en: Develop cities, research technologies and adopt policies while exploring and negotiating with other civilizations. Military forces can defend territory or support expansion, but different victory conditions call for different investments, so align city production and diplomatic choices with the route you want to pursue.

records.zh: 玩家把城市区域安排在合适地形上，发展科技与文化，并与其他文明开展外交或战争。城市布局会影响后续建设，玩家需把地图条件、发展节奏与选定的胜利路线连接起来。
records.en: Place city districts around the terrain, develop science and culture, and manage relations with other civilizations. Your layout shapes later development, so connect local building decisions with diplomacy and military commitments, choosing a victory route that the growing civilization can support.

records.zh: 描述者看到目标词后，必须避开目标本身及一组禁词，用其他表达向伙伴传递意思。猜词者依据描述提出答案，双方需要逐步缩小范围，同时防止关键线索触碰规则限制。
records.en: A describer helps a partner identify a target word without saying the word itself or its forbidden terms. The guesser works from the permitted clues, while the describer adjusts the explanation to narrow the possibilities without crossing the restrictions on what can be said.

records.zh: 线索提供者用一个词把棋盘上的若干目标词联系起来，队友据此选择他们认为对应的词。要尽量让线索覆盖多个己方目标，同时避开对方词语与危险选项，兼顾效率和误解风险。
records.en: Give a single-word clue that links several target words on the board, then let teammates choose the words they believe it describes. Seek useful connections without pointing them toward the opposing words or the dangerous option, balancing broad coverage against ambiguity.

records.zh: 玩家操控角色跨越地形、障碍与敌人，取得关卡末端的金币。起跳位置与落点决定可行路线，需要把连续移动衔接起来，越过最后的阻挡抵达目标。
records.en: Run and jump past terrain and enemies to reach the coin at the end of the level. Takeoff points and landings determine the available route, with the final coin providing the destination for the sequence of movements.

records.zh: 两个角色在由节点和通道组成的地图上移动，合作围堵并捕捉对手。两人的站位共同限制目标的逃跑方向，需要分配追赶和封路位置，让围堵形成完整覆盖。
records.en: Two players move through a graph of connected locations to capture an opponent together. Their positions determine which routes the target can use, making coordinated approaches and coverage of possible escapes central to the chase.

records.zh: 队员探索不同房间，合作启动分散的两个发电机，让出口能够打开。行动中还要避开追捕者，在分头推进、互相支援和前往出口之间安排时机，避免完成机关后仍被困在追逐中。
records.en: Work together across different rooms to activate two separated generators and open the exit. Avoid the pursuer while deciding when to split up or support one another, then connect the completed machinery with a route that actually brings the team to escape.

records.zh: 双方把固定数量的兵力分配到多个战场，各处的相对投入决定该战场归属。目标是赢得更多战场，因此集中优势与分散覆盖之间需要取舍，单个战场投入过多也可能使其他位置失守。
records.en: Distribute a fixed force across several battlefields, with the relative allocations determining who wins each contest. Seek to win more battlefields overall, balancing concentrated strength against wider coverage so that overwhelming one location does not leave too many others undefended.

records.zh: 玩家通过文字命令进入地下洞穴，检查场景、携带与使用物品，并破解阻挡通路的环境谜题。探索中寻找宝藏，新的发现也可能解释先前的障碍，需要把分散线索与随身物品联系起来。
records.en: Explore an underground cave through text commands, examining locations and carrying or using objects to solve obstacles. Search for treasures as new discoveries clarify earlier puzzles, connecting clues across different places with the items available in your inventory to continue the journey.

records.zh: 玩家采集泰伯利亚资源，建设基地、生产设施与科技建筑，再调动阵营单位争夺战场。陆空部队需要经济持续供给，玩家要在扩张生产、保卫基地和发起进攻之间分配资源与注意力。
records.en: Harvest Tiberium, construct a base and develop production and technology facilities before directing faction forces into battle. Coordinate land and air units with the economy that supplies them, dividing resources and attention between expansion, protecting the base and pressing an attack.

records.zh: 出题者不能直接说出答案，而是在图标棋盘上放置标记，组合出目标词或短语的线索。其他玩家要判断图标之间的关系，出题者则通过调整标记澄清含义，让抽象概念逐渐变得可辨认。
records.en: Place markers on an illustrated board to communicate a target word or phrase without stating it directly. Other players interpret the relationships between the selected icons, while changes to the markers help refine the intended meaning and distinguish it from competing guesses.

records.zh: 双方轮流选择一列投入棋子，棋子会落到该列最低的空位。目标是率先在横向、纵向或斜向连成四子，需要同时制造自己的连线机会，并阻止对方下一步直接获胜。
records.en: Take turns dropping a disc into a column, where it settles in the lowest available space. Be first to connect four horizontally, vertically or diagonally, building your own opportunities while watching for an opposing line that could be completed on the next turn.

records.zh: 玩家接受建筑合同，驾驶挖掘机、起重机等设备，按工序完成挖掘、运输、浇筑与吊装。不同设备承担不同环节，需要把材料、位置和作业顺序衔接起来，逐步把工地推进到交付状态。
records.en: Take construction contracts and operate equipment such as excavators and cranes through digging, transport, pouring and lifting. Match each machine to its part of the work, coordinating materials and the order of operations as the site progresses toward a completed job.

records.zh: 玩家把小球射向旋转圆盘，使它们附着在圆周上，同时避开已经插入的小球。圆盘转动不断改变可用空隙，每次发射都要对准早先小球之间经过的间隔。
records.en: Shoot small balls onto a rotating wheel without striking those already attached to it. Rotation continually changes the available gaps, requiring each release to line up with the space between earlier shots.

records.zh: 攻守双方先管理装备经济，再依靠枪械、投掷物和队伍配合争取回合目标。围绕炸弹的安放与拆除，需要控制关键路线、交换敌情并支援队友，让交火结果转化为回合胜利。
records.en: Manage equipment purchases, then use weapons, utility and team coordination to pursue the round objective. In bomb scenarios, control routes and share information to plant the bomb, defend it or make a successful defuse.

records.zh: 双方通过购买装备、配合交火和控制地图争取回合胜利，目标随场景包括安放或拆除炸弹、解救人质。玩家要让位置与投掷物服务于当前任务，同时兼顾队伍资源和队友的行动。
records.en: Buy equipment and coordinate gunfights, utility and map control around the current round objective. Scenarios include bomb planting or defusal and hostage rescue, requiring players to connect their positions and engagements with the task while keeping the team's resources and movement in view.

records.zh: 玩家声称自己拥有某种角色能力，借此取得金币、攻击或阻挡他人，也可以质疑对方的声明。声明是否可信与挑战的代价相互牵制，目标是在保住己方影响力的同时，让对手逐一出局。
records.en: Claim character abilities to gain coins, attack or block other players, and decide when to challenge their claims. Credibility and the cost of being wrong shape each exchange, as you try to preserve your own influence while removing every opponent's remaining influence.

records.zh: 玩家采集资源、合成工具与装备，并在探索中维持生存状态、应对敌人。完整版还把冒险延伸到多层地下城，获得的材料与装备支持继续深入，遭遇和机制也随进程增加。
records.en: Gather resources, craft equipment and keep the character alive while exploring and confronting enemies. The full version extends this loop into multiple dungeon layers, requiring discoveries and upgrades to support deeper travel; the exact range of mechanics depends on the version being played.

records.zh: 玩家在程序化世界中寻找食物和材料，制作工具并应对敌人，以一系列成就推动进程。采集、制作与生存彼此依赖，需要先取得必要资源，再利用新工具开启后续目标。
records.en: Search a procedural world for food and materials, craft tools and deal with enemies while unlocking achievements. Gathering, production and survival depend on one another, so obtain the resources needed for the next tool and use it to open further opportunities.

records.zh: 玩家在基于 Minetest 的三维体素世界中移动、挖掘、采集和制作。平台可配置不同世界规则与任务，让这些交互围绕各场景的目标组合成不同的行动流程。
records.en: Move, dig, gather and craft in a three-dimensional voxel world built on Minetest. Configurable tasks and world rules define the objective and how these interactions fit together within each scenario.

records.zh: 玩家与队友使用武器争夺回合或地图目标，在爆破等模式中分别承担进攻和防守职责。移动、交火与掩护需要围绕目标协同，既要处理可见敌人，也要防止对方利用路线空隙完成任务。
records.en: Use weapons and team coordination to pursue the map or round objective, taking attacking or defending roles in modes such as demolition. Align movement, engagements and cover around that goal while watching for routes the opposing team could exploit to complete its task.

records.zh: 玩家在持续前进的过程中向左右调整方向，穿过由立方体构成的障碍群。随着方块变密，需要提前寻找可用缝隙，把连续转向衔接起来，尽量延长不发生碰撞的行程。
records.en: Steer left and right while moving through a field of cube obstacles. As the gaps become tighter, look ahead for a usable passage and connect successive direction changes, keeping the route open long enough to continue without colliding with a block.

records.zh: 玩家在夜之城接取委托，通过枪械、潜行或黑客手段处理任务，搜集装备并改造义体。不同的角色发展会改变可用办法，需要把战斗与探索中获得的资源投入适合自己的行动方式。
records.en: Take jobs in Night City and approach them through gunplay, stealth or hacking, developing the character with equipment and cyberware. Use resources earned through missions and exploration to support the approach you prefer, adapting your available tools to the situation ahead.

records.zh: 双方在六角棋盘上争取连接各自对边，但对手的完整落子布局被隐藏。玩家只能结合有限的落子反馈推断阻挡和通路，在不确定的棋局中调整连接路线，同时设法破坏对方的潜在线路。
records.en: Try to connect your assigned edges on a hexagonal board while the opponent's full placement remains hidden. Use limited feedback from attempted moves to infer blocked cells and possible routes, adapting your connection plan as each interaction reveals more of the position.

records.zh: 玩家探索互相连通的区域，观察敌人动作并管理耐力，选择进攻、闪避或防御的时机。装备与篝火系统影响旅途准备，需要把每场高风险交战与继续探索所需的状态一起考虑。
records.en: Explore connected areas, study enemy movements and manage stamina when choosing attacks, evasions or defense. Equipment and bonfires shape preparation for the next stretch, so weigh the demands of each risky encounter against the condition needed to keep exploring afterward.

records.zh: 玩家组织冒险小队，选择技能与补给进入危险区域，在战斗中管理角色生命和不断累积的压力。队员能否继续推进不只取决于战斗胜负，还取决于资源与状态，因此需要判断何时冒险、何时保全队伍。
records.en: Assemble an adventuring party, choose skills and supplies, and manage health and stress during dangerous expeditions. Winning a fight is only part of keeping the group functional, so judge further progress against dwindling resources and the condition of the characters who must continue.

records.zh: 玩家通过秘密商谈建立临时联盟，再同时投票决定淘汰谁。投票前要判断盟友是否会按约定行动，并考虑其他人的结盟变化，尽量让自己避开被集体针对的位置，存活到最后。
records.en: Form private alliances before players simultaneously vote on whom to eliminate. Anticipate whether partners will follow through and how other agreements may change the result, trying to keep yourself out of the group being targeted as the remaining field narrows.

records.zh: 玩家扮演弗兰克·韦斯特，在限时事件中救援幸存者，搜集物品组合武器，并用摄影记录遭遇。探索娱乐都市时要安排各项行动的先后，避免为了物资或战斗而错过正在推进的事件。
records.en: Play as Frank West, rescuing survivors during timed events while combining items into weapons and photographing encounters. Explore the dangerous entertainment city while ordering these activities carefully, deciding when to search or fight without losing track of events that continue to unfold.

records.zh: 玩家评估送到店里的物品，与顾客讨价还价，再决定购入、保留或出售库存。每笔交易都影响可用现金和店铺发展，需要在单次利润、物品价值与后续周转之间安排取舍。
records.en: Appraise items and negotiate with customers before buying, holding or selling stock. Each transaction changes the cash and inventory available to the shop, so weigh an attractive individual deal against the resources needed to keep trading and gradually expand the business.

records.zh: 玩家在三维迷宫等场景中导航，寻找并收集目标物品，同时避开危险。不同关卡设置不同目标和奖励，行动要根据当前地图要求调整，在探索新路线时也要记住已见通道与目标位置。
records.en: Navigate three-dimensional mazes and other scenes, collecting target items while avoiding hazards. Objectives and rewards differ between levels, so use the current scenario to guide exploration, keeping track of observed passages and useful locations as you decide where to move next.

records.zh: 玩家选择干员，利用战术装备和队友配合执行作战目标；不同模式可围绕搜集物资后撤离，或载具参与的据点攻防展开。交火之外还要安排路线与支援，使行动符合当前模式的胜利要求。
records.en: Choose an operator and coordinate tactical equipment with teammates around the selected mode's objective. Some modes involve looting and extraction, while others feature vehicles and large-scale control points, requiring movement and support to serve the particular conditions of the match.

records.zh: 玩家先与其他国家商谈联盟和行动，再提交部队命令，利用移动与支援争夺补给中心。承诺未必会兑现，需要把外交沟通和地图上的力量分布一起判断，防范合作破裂或临时背叛。
records.en: Negotiate alliances and plans with other countries before submitting orders to move and support units. Compete for supply centers while judging whether promises will hold, connecting diplomatic discussions with the actual positions on the board and the possibility of a partner changing sides.

records.zh: 玩家结合超自然能力、不同移动路线和环境机关完成暗杀任务，可以潜入、非致命处置或正面交战。先观察守卫与场景再选择办法，探索也会揭示可用通路，让同一目标有不同的接近方式。
records.en: Combine supernatural abilities, routes and environmental mechanisms to complete assassination missions through stealth, nonlethal actions or direct combat. Observe the surroundings before choosing an approach, using exploration to discover ways through the space and decide how to reach the target.

records.zh: 角色借助平台不断向上弹跳，玩家通过左右移动修正落点，争取攀升得更高。平台的位置、敌人与危险区域会限制路线，需要在追求高度时持续寻找下一处可落脚的位置。
records.en: Guide the character left and right as it bounces upward between platforms, aiming to climb higher. Watch the arrangement of platforms alongside enemies and hazards, selecting the next landing before leaving the current route so that upward progress does not end in a fall.

records.zh: 玩家在地牢式地图中移动和射击，寻找武器、补给、通行道具与出口，并应对沿途敌人。相关 ViZDoom 环境支持自定义地图和奖励，以具体场景设置形成不同的交战与导航目标。
records.en: Move and shoot through dungeon-like maps, finding supplies, useful items and exits while confronting enemies. Associated ViZDoom scenarios define their own maps and rewards, ranging in scope according to the configured task.

records.zh: 玩家在 GameSense 接入的 DOOM 场景中导航和射击，寻找推进所需的道具或出口。沿途敌人影响路线和交战选择；该接入版本的具体发行版未注明。
records.en: GameSense's DOOM integration, whose release is unspecified, involves navigation and shooting through enemy-filled scenes. Search for useful items and exits while choosing routes through the encounters that block progress.

records.zh: 玩家在多层地图中探索，搜集钥匙与武器弹药，并寻找通往后续区域的出口。成群恶魔会阻挡路线，需要在移动和射击之间保持配合，把有限补给留给接下来的遭遇。
records.en: Explore multi-level maps, collecting keys, weapons and ammunition while searching for the exit to the next area. Groups of demons obstruct the route, requiring movement and shooting to work together while supplies remain sufficient for the encounters still ahead.

records.zh: 玩家操控拥有不同技能的英雄，通过对线、击杀和资源获取积累等级与装备。队伍需要把个人成长与地图目标连接起来，选择交战和推进时机，最终协作摧毁敌方远古遗迹。
records.en: Control a hero with distinct abilities, gaining levels and equipment through lanes, fights and resource collection. Coordinate that growth with the team's movement and engagements, choosing when to press forward so that local advantages contribute to destroying the opposing Ancient.

records.zh: 一名地主对抗两名农民，玩家轮流打出合法牌型压过上一手，也可以选择不出。既要尽快清空自己的手牌，也要考虑同阵营伙伴的出牌顺序，让己方有人率先出完。
records.en: One landlord faces two farmers, with players beating the previous combination or choosing to pass. Try to empty your hand while considering the order of play and your partner's opportunities, since the aim is for your side to produce the first finisher.

records.zh: 玩家以一名旅人的身份接受村民委托，从山路出发探索周围地点，寻找处理巨龙问题的线索。通过文字指令移动、检查物品并尝试组合和使用道具，逐步解决谜题；故事既提供武力路径，也留下解除魔法的线索。
records.en: A traveler accepts a village quest and sets out from a mountain path to find a way to deal with a dragon. Move between locations, examine objects and use items through text commands to solve connected puzzles. The opening presents both a weapon-based approach and clues to breaking an enchantment.

evidence.locator: Released ROM, SHA256 9f7d54f7c18ce07ec1c6eab7d5c2176f3562d46ffd2357f6d6cfc48a6fa683a8; Release 2 / 040211; live introduction and parser

records.zh: 玩家在厄拉科斯寻找水源和材料，建造据点，并在沙虫和其他玩家的威胁下求生。获取香料需要走出安全位置，玩家要在采集、准备与返回之间安排路线，避免收益被环境或交战风险吞没。
records.en: Search Arrakis for water and materials, build a base and survive threats from sandworms and other players. Securing spice requires leaving safer positions, so connect resource gathering with preparation and a viable route back, weighing potential gains against the hazards of the trip.

records.zh: 玩家扮演具有职业、属性和经历的角色，以叙事选择、规则检定与掷骰处理探索、社交和战斗。队伍通过说明意图并回应行动结果推进冒险，具体可用动作和难度由当前规则与场景决定。
records.en: Play a character with a class and attributes, resolving exploration, social encounters and combat through narrative decisions, rules and dice. Describe intentions and respond to their outcomes as the adventure unfolds, with the current scenario and rules shaping what actions are possible.

records.zh: 玩家在丧尸城市中跑酷穿行、寻找资源并以近战应对威胁，在移动路线与生存需求之间安排选择。任务中的决定还会影响人物关系和城市局势，使自由探索与故事推进不断交织。
records.en: Traverse a zombie-filled city through parkour, scavenge resources and use close combat to survive. Balance the route ahead with immediate needs while making mission choices that affect relationships and the city's situation, linking movement and exploration with the developing story.

records.zh: 玩家控制冲浪者左右移动，在滑行中避开障碍和追赶者，尽量延长行程。不同挑战会改变前进要求，需要持续观察路线空隙，决定何时转向，使一次避让不会把自己带入下一处危险。
records.en: Steer a surfer left and right to avoid obstacles and pursuers while extending the ride. Different challenges change what progress requires, so watch for open routes and time direction changes carefully, ensuring that escaping one hazard does not lead straight into another.

records.zh: 双方依骰点选择可移动的编号棋子，向棋盘对角的目标推进，并可通过吃子改变局面。骰子限制当轮选择，棋子数量又影响后续可用行动，需要把前进路线与将来的掷骰结果一起考虑。
records.en: Use the die to determine which numbered pieces may move toward the opposite corner, capturing along the way. Rolls constrain the current choice while the surviving pieces affect later options, so consider both immediate progress and how a move changes future possibilities.

records.zh: 玩家探索交界地，寻找装备并发展角色，通过近战、法术和闪避应对敌人与首领。探索带来的新工具会改变战斗选择，遇到难以突破的关卡时，也可调整准备和路线再继续挑战。
records.en: Explore the Lands Between, collect equipment and develop a character for encounters using melee, spells and evasions. Discoveries change the tools available for combat, letting you reconsider preparation and travel routes when a difficult enemy or boss blocks further progress.

records.zh: 玩家在逐渐收缩的地图上搜集装备、提升等级，并在昼夜循环中安排探索和交战。前期获得的资源用于应对后续强敌，需要在剩余时间内决定继续搜寻还是为下一场挑战作好准备。
records.en: Gather equipment and gain levels across a contracting map, organizing exploration and combat around a day-and-night cycle. Use what you obtain to prepare for the stronger encounters ahead, deciding when another search is worthwhile and when the remaining time calls for consolidation.

records.zh: 玩家带着装备进入战区，搜集物资、应对交火，并处理负重与受伤带来的行动限制。只有找到出口并成功撤离，才能保住携带的战利品，因此拿取物品的决定要和离开的路线一起考虑。
records.en: Enter a combat zone with equipment, search for supplies and manage both encounters and the effects of weight or injury. Find an exit and extract to retain your loot, weighing what to carry against the route and condition needed to bring it out safely.

records.zh: 玩家确定将牌后，与搭档通过出牌配合争取多数牌墩。J 牌在将牌体系中的特殊顺序会改变牌力判断，需要结合已出的牌选择何时争墩、何时保留较强的牌为之后作准备。
records.en: After trump is determined, work with a partner to win a majority of tricks. The special ranking of jacks changes how strong a hand is, so use previously played cards to judge when to contest a trick and when to preserve a stronger option.

records.zh: 玩家根据饥饿与缺水状态，在两条通往不同资源的路径之间作出选择。取得资源后需求随之更新，需要再次判断哪种资源更紧迫，继续在两条路线间分配行动。
records.en: Choose between two resource paths according to the character's hunger and thirst. After obtaining a resource, the updated condition determines which need is more urgent and which path offers the useful next destination.

records.zh: 玩家为勘探选择车辆和装备，在泥地、坡地与水域之间规划行进路线。驾驶时借助绞盘等工具处理受阻地形，需要把车辆能力与路线条件相匹配，避免只顾直线前进而无法继续作业。
records.en: Select a vehicle and equipment for an expedition, then drive across mud, slopes and water. Plan a route suited to the terrain and use tools such as the winch when the ground obstructs further progress.

records.zh: 玩家开采原料，铺设生产线与物流网络，研究科技并把中间产品送入下一道制造工序。每项产出可能又是其他设备的投入，需要不断调整供应与运力，让相互依赖的流程持续运转。
records.en: Mine raw materials, build production lines and logistics networks, and research technologies that extend what can be manufactured. Products feed into further processes, so keep adjusting supply and transport to prevent one shortage from interrupting the interconnected flow through the factory.

records.zh: 玩家在雅拉开展游击行动，通过攻占据点和完成任务逐步推进目标。武器、载具与伙伴提供不同的应对办法，需要结合地形和敌方部署选择接近路线，让准备与实际交战相互配合。
records.en: Carry out guerrilla operations across Yara, completing missions and attacking occupied positions. Weapons, vehicles and companions provide different options, so choose an approach that suits the terrain and opposition, connecting preparation and movement with the demands of the fight itself.

records.zh: 玩家组队搜集装备，使用枪械、角色技能和移动机制在战场上转移与交战。队员需要决定何时追击、支援或撤离，避免个人行动脱离队伍，争取在连续遭遇中存活并击败敌队。
records.en: Loot equipment with teammates and combine weapons, character abilities and movement during combat. Decide together when to pursue, support or disengage, keeping individual movement connected to the squad so that surviving an encounter also leaves the team ready for the next one.

records.zh: 玩家种植作物、采集浆果和蘑菇，再通过烹饪、出售物品与完成委托获得收入，也可以布置房屋。每天的劳动要在多种活动间分配，逐步积攒资金，最终偿清农场贷款。
records.en: Grow crops, gather berries and mushrooms, cook, decorate the house and earn money through sales and requests. Divide your work among these activities to build up income over time, with repaying the farm loan providing a continuing goal for the routine.

records.zh: 玩家切换或共同控制火娃与水妹，利用两人对不同元素的适应性通过机关和危险区域。部分路段需要一方操作装置，为另一方创造通路，最终让两个角色分别到达各自出口。
records.en: Control or switch between Fireboy and Watergirl, using their different relationships with elemental hazards to cross each room. Coordinate switches and movement so that one character creates a passage for the other, then bring both characters to their respective exits.

records.zh: 玩家通过点击让小鸟短暂上升，再利用下落穿过连续管道之间的空隙。目标是尽可能多地通过障碍，需要把点击节奏与当前高度相配合，避免一次过猛修正导致下一段路线失控。
records.en: Tap to lift the bird and let it descend between taps, guiding it through gaps in successive pipes. Try to pass as many obstacles as possible by matching the rhythm to the current height, avoiding corrections that make the next opening unreachable.

records.zh: 玩家被困在露营主题房间中，通过鼠标点击检查场景和物品，寻找离开的办法。线索与谜题按步骤相互联系，需要先理解发现的信息，再用它解决后续机关，逐步打开逃离房间的通路。
records.en: Search a camping-themed room with mouse clicks, inspecting objects and clues to find a way out. Puzzles build on information discovered along the way, so progress comes from connecting evidence and resolving the intervening steps before the escape route opens.

evidence.locator: Official game_prompt: setting, mouse interaction, sequential clues and escape condition

records.zh: 玩家在校园地点之间行动，安排学习、工作、休息与社交，提升智力和社交属性。时间、精力与金钱相互制约，需要把日常活动带来的成长转化为学期末的考试和社交目标，而不是只重复一种活动。
records.en: Move between campus locations and balance study, work, rest and social activities to improve intelligence and social skills. Time, energy and money constrain the schedule, and progress is reflected in academic and social goals at the end of the semester.

evidence.locator: Official game_prompt: interaction, scenario and player objectives

records.zh: 玩家扮演寻宝者 Dakota Winchester，在不同地点与人物交谈、检查物件，寻找 Hilda's Box 缺失的部分。推进旅程需要把得到的物品与古老谜题联系起来，解决当前地点的问题后再继续追踪线索。
records.en: As treasure hunter Dakota Winchester, visit locations, question characters and inspect objects while searching for missing parts of Hilda's Box. Progress depends on connecting acquired objects with ancient puzzles and resolving local obstacles before following the next lead.

evidence.locator: Official game_prompt: interaction, scenario and player objectives
