records.zh: 在十四至十八世纪的欧洲地图上扩张势力，争夺城市与资源节点。每轮利用领地收入安排国库支出、科技和招募，再通过六角格战斗推进征服，需要把经济准备与前线行动衔接起来。
records.en: Expand across a map of Europe spanning the fourteenth to eighteenth centuries, contesting cities and resource nodes. Each round combines territorial income, treasury spending, technology and recruitment before hex-based battles determine whether the planned conquests can advance.

evidence.locator: Official task README: world rules, mechanics and task setting

records.zh: 管理飞船内部的船员、舱门和氧气，处理火灾与船体破损，同时让武器充能并瞄准敌船舱室。护盾与不同武器改变交火过程，开火后需要重新充能，不能只顾射击而放任内部危机扩大。
records.en: Manage crew, doors and oxygen inside a ship while containing fires and hull breaches. Charge weapons, target enemy rooms and account for shields; firing starts another charging cycle, so the exchange of attacks continues alongside problems within your own ship.

evidence.locator: Official task README: world rules, mechanics and task setting

records.zh: 在回合开始时为队员选择行动和目标，再依次执行攻击、治疗或属性变化。元素相性会改变行动效果，需要结合敌我状态决定先处理谁，以及何时把一个回合用在恢复而不是进攻上。
records.en: Select actions and targets for party members, then execute attacks, healing and stat changes through a turn-based battle. Elemental affinities alter their effects, linking target choice and the current condition of both sides to the value of each action.

evidence.locator: Official task README: world rules, mechanics and task setting

records.zh: 安排工人采集两类资源，建设设施并通过生产队列补充部队，与电脑对手交战。建筑要经历两个施工阶段，远程单位还需维持射程、锁定目标并遵守开火冷却，经济与作战会同时推进。
records.en: Send workers to gather two resources, construct buildings and use production queues to field units against an AI opponent. Construction has two stages, while ranged combat requires target tracking, suitable distance and cooldown timing alongside the ongoing economy.

evidence.locator: Official task README: world rules, mechanics and task setting

records.zh: 在随机星球上开采矿石，用熔炉产生热量，再经管道送到电厂转化为电力。电力支持炮塔、陷阱和粉碎机抵挡怪物波次，粉碎后的尸体还能回收成矿石，接回生产链。
records.en: Mine ore on a random planet, generate heat in smelters and pipe it to power plants for electricity. Turrets, traps and crushers defend against monster waves, while crushed corpses can return ore to the factory’s production chain.

evidence.locator: Official task README: world rules, mechanics and task setting

records.zh: 在由走廊连接的飞船房间中调度船员，修复破损并扑灭火灾。氧气与舱门状态影响安全，房间容量和实际工作位置又限制分配，需要在封舱、通行和维修之间安排合理顺序。
records.en: Move crew through connected ship rooms to repair breaches and fight fires. Oxygen and door states affect safety, while room capacities and docking slots limit assignments, requiring repairs and door sealing to be coordinated with safe access for the crew.

evidence.locator: Official task README: world rules, mechanics and task setting

records.zh: 固定炮塔抵御沿线路前进的敌人，射击同时消耗弹药和金币。重型敌人不受普通炮塔伤害，需要兵工厂串行生产的攻城炮弹；共享资金、生产顺序和弹丸飞行延迟共同限制防线的反应速度。
records.en: Fixed towers defend a lane using ammunition and gold, while heavy enemies require siege shells instead of ordinary tower fire. An arsenal builds orders sequentially from shared funds, and projectile travel time adds another delay between spending resources and stopping a threat.

evidence.locator: Official task README: world rules, mechanics and task setting

records.zh: 两名守卫分守两条通向保护区的走廊，根据视线发现入侵者并逐步升级警戒。追击或搜索会把人带离岗位，因此还要安排轮换，避免两人同时离岗，让另一条路线完全失去看守。
records.en: Two guards cover separate corridors into a protected zone, escalating suspicion and responding to intruders visible around walls. Chasing and searching pull them away from their posts, so rotation must prevent both routes from being left unguarded at once.

evidence.locator: Official task README: world rules, mechanics and task setting

records.zh: 沿分岔地图选择前进路线，用抽取到的卡牌进行回合战斗，并在途中商店调整牌组。生命、格挡、状态效果以及抽牌和洗牌顺序共同影响下一回合；这是独立的卡牌战斗项目框架。
records.en: Choose branches on a map, play drawn cards in turn-based battles and adjust the deck at shops along the route. Health, block and status effects interact with drawing and reshuffling, shaping what can be played on subsequent turns in this project framework.

evidence.locator: Official task README: world rules, mechanics and task setting

records.zh: 在九列二十行的区域中移动、旋转下落方块，用软降或硬降把它们安放到合适位置。旋转时可借助位置修正穿过窄缝，完成消行并构建盒状组合来取得分数。
records.en: Move and rotate falling pieces inside a nine-by-twenty board, using soft or hard drops to place them. Rotation kicks help pieces fit through tight gaps, while line clears and box-building combinations contribute to the score as the stack develops.

evidence.locator: Official task README: world rules, mechanics and task setting

records.zh: 在六角格土地上经营家庭农场，把有限劳动力安排到田地和其他工作区域。每个回合代表一天，结束时结算劳动、资源和土地变化，需要让每日分配衔接起来，维持家庭跨季节生存。
records.en: Run a household on hex-based land, assigning limited labor to fields and other work zones. Each turn represents a day, with resources and land changes resolved at day’s end, linking successive work allocations to the household’s survival across seasons.

evidence.locator: Official task README: world rules, mechanics and task setting

records.zh: 在第二次世界大战背景的区域地图上发展领土、研究科技并招募军队，再按回合推进扩张。交战会进入六角格战术层结算，战略地图上的兵力准备要与局部战斗中的行动相配合。
records.en: Develop territories, research technology and recruit armies on a regional map set during the Second World War. Turn-based expansion leads into hex-based tactical battles, connecting the forces prepared on the strategic map with the outcome of individual conquests.

evidence.locator: Official task README: world rules, mechanics and task setting

records.zh: 建造并培养防御塔，阻止敌人一波波穿过传送门路线。元素与装备会改变塔的表现，攻击还受到射程、冷却和目标选择限制，部分攻击可以多目标或弹射；此处展示的是项目改编机制。
records.en: Build and develop towers to stop waves of enemies moving along portal routes. Elements and items change tower behavior, while range, cooldowns and targeting govern attacks, including multi-target or ricochet effects represented in this adapted project’s mechanics.

evidence.locator: Official task README: world rules, mechanics and task setting

records.zh: 双方轮流把棋子投入竖直棋盘的某一列，棋子会落到该列最低空位。率先横向、纵向或斜向连成四子即可获胜，需要在创造己方连线机会时，阻止对方借下一次落子完成四连。
records.en: Take turns dropping a disc into a column of the vertical board, where it settles into the lowest open space. Win by making four in a row horizontally, vertically or diagonally, while blocking the opponent's immediate opportunities to complete the same pattern.

evidence.locator: families.games entry and family rules; previously verified game-specific introduction

records.zh: 玩家在空格内填数字，使每行每列都不重复，同时满足格子之间给出的大小关系。局部不等式会限制相邻取值，需要把这些限制与整行整列的候选数字结合起来，完成全部网格。
records.en: Fill the grid without repeating a number in any row or column, while obeying the greater-than and less-than signs between cells. Local comparisons restrict neighboring values, and these restrictions must fit together with the possible numbers remaining across the whole board.

evidence.locator: families.games entry and family rules; previously verified game-specific introduction

records.zh: 双方轮流在棋盘交叉点落子，率先沿横向、纵向或斜向排成五子者获胜。需要兼顾延长己方棋形与阻断对方连线；具体禁手或长连处理取决于本实现规则，不能直接套用其他五子棋版本。
records.en: Take turns placing stones on intersections and try to make five in a horizontal, vertical or diagonal line before the opponent does. Extend your own threats while blocking theirs; restrictions such as forbidden moves or overlines depend on the particular implementation's rules.

evidence.locator: families.games entry and family rules; previously verified game-specific introduction

records.zh: 玩家把一叠大小不同的圆盘移到指定柱，每次只能拿起某柱最上面的一枚。大盘不能放在小盘上，需要借助其他柱暂存圆盘，逐步腾出关键位置，再把整叠按大小顺序重新聚齐。
records.en: Move a stack of differently sized discs to the designated peg, taking only the top disc from a peg at each step. A larger disc cannot rest on a smaller one, so intermediate placements must clear the way before the stack can be rebuilt.

evidence.locator: families.games entry and family rules; previously verified game-specific introduction

records.zh: 玩家在数字岛之间画水平或竖直桥，使每座岛连接的桥数等于提示。桥梁不能彼此交叉，全部岛还要连成同一网络，因此满足一处数字时需要给其他岛保留能够接入的通路。
records.en: Draw horizontal or vertical bridges between numbered islands so each island has the required number of connections. Bridges cannot cross, and all islands must form one network, so satisfying a local count must still leave a way for the remaining islands to join.

evidence.locator: families.games entry and family rules; previously verified game-specific introduction

records.zh: 玩家填写数字，使每行每列不出现重复，并满足各个标记区域的运算符和目标值。需要先确定同一区域中可行的数字组合，再结合它们在行列中的位置排除冲突，完成整张棋盘。
records.en: Fill the grid with nonrepeating numbers in each row and column while meeting every marked cage's arithmetic operation and target value. Find combinations that satisfy each calculation, then place them so the same choices remain compatible with the rows and columns they cross.

evidence.locator: families.games entry and family rules; previously verified game-specific introduction

records.zh: 玩家旋转网格中的管线格，使线段的接口相接，最终把所有终端连接到中央节点。一次旋转会同时改变该格各方向的连接关系，需要检查外围线路是否真正接入整体，避免只完成几个孤立片段。
records.en: Rotate the network tiles so their endpoints join and every terminal connects to the central node. Turning one tile changes several potential connections at once, linking each local section to the route that ultimately reaches the central node.

evidence.locator: families.games entry and family rules; previously verified game-specific introduction

records.zh: 玩家根据每行每列的连续黑格长度提示，把网格逐步填成黑白图案。数字按顺序规定各段的位置关系，需要让横向和纵向提示在同一格上取得一致，确定哪些格涂黑、哪些必须留白。
records.en: Use the ordered black-run lengths beside each row and above each column to reconstruct a black-and-white pattern. A cell's color must satisfy both directions, so confirmed runs and spaces in one line help determine the possibilities in the lines crossing it.

evidence.locator: families.games entry and family rules; previously verified game-specific introduction

records.zh: 双方轮流落子，通过沿直线夹住对方棋子，将其中棋子翻为己色。目标是在终局拥有更多棋子，需要兼顾当前翻转数量和后续可落位置，围绕边线、角落以及对方可能的反夹击安排落点。
records.en: Take turns placing discs to bracket opposing discs along a line and flip them to your color. Finish with the larger disc count, considering both immediate gains and future placements around edges and corners, where a move can also create opportunities for an opponent's reply.

evidence.locator: families.games entry and family rules; previously verified game-specific introduction

records.zh: 玩家填写楼高，使每行每列的高度都不重复，并满足棋盘边缘的可见楼数提示。较高建筑会挡住后方矮楼，需要从两端比较视线，逐步确定同一组高度在行列中的排列。
records.en: Arrange building heights without repetition in any row or column, matching the visibility counts around the board. Taller buildings hide shorter ones behind them, so the same set of heights must be ordered to give the correct view from each indicated side.

evidence.locator: families.games entry and family rules; previously verified game-specific introduction

records.zh: 玩家沿网格边画线，组成一条单独的闭合回路，让每个数字周围被选中的边数符合提示。每段线都必须属于同一条回路，局部计数与整体连通需要共同满足，最终让路线首尾相接。
records.en: Draw grid edges to make one closed loop, matching the number of selected edges around each numbered cell. Every selected segment must belong to the same route, connecting the local edge counts into one uninterrupted circuit across the board.

evidence.locator: families.games entry and family rules; previously verified game-specific introduction

records.zh: 玩家在网格仓库中移动，把箱子推到指定目标格。箱子只能推不能拉，推入角落或互相堵住可能无法恢复，需要先安排人物站位与箱子移动次序，再逐步把全部箱子送到目标上。
records.en: Move through the warehouse and push crates onto the marked target squares. Crates can be pushed but not pulled, so corners and blocked routes can create irreversible deadlocks; arrange both the player's access and the order of pushes before committing each crate to a path.

evidence.locator: families.games entry and family rules; previously verified game-specific introduction

records.zh: 玩家把空格填成黑或白，使每行每列两色数量相等，且横竖都没有连续三个同色格。需要结合已给颜色判断必须填哪一色，避免局部连续性正确却让整行或整列的颜色总数失衡。
records.en: Fill cells black or white so both colors occur equally often in every row and column, with no horizontal or vertical run of three matching cells. Use the given colors to constrain each choice while keeping the final color totals possible in both directions.

evidence.locator: families.games entry and family rules; previously verified game-specific introduction

records.zh: 双方在 5×5 棋盘上用王、后、车、象、马和兵展开攻防，以将死对方国王为目标。空间缩小后，棋子更容易直接相遇，需要在每次交换与移动中兼顾自己的威胁和国王安全。
records.en: Play chess with kings, queens, rooks, bishops, knights and pawns on a compact 5×5 board. Aim for checkmate while watching how the reduced space brings pieces into contact, making each exchange or relocation matter for both your attack and the king's safety.

records.zh: 玩家探索架空瑞典，搜集武器与补给，通过观察机器敌人的弱点选择伏击和交火方式。战斗准备与资源管理贯穿探索，需要判断何时主动接敌、何时绕行或补充物资，维持继续行动的条件。
records.en: Explore an alternate Sweden, scavenge equipment and study machines for weaknesses before engaging them. Combine ambushes and combat with resource management, deciding when to attack, avoid an encounter or replenish supplies so that the next stretch of exploration remains possible.

records.zh: 玩家在提瓦特探索、解谜并完成任务，战斗时切换不同角色，让元素技能相互配合。探索所得支持角色发展，新的队伍组合又改变解谜和交战方式，使旅途在发现与培养之间持续推进。
records.en: Explore Teyvat, solve puzzles and complete quests, switching characters during combat to combine elemental effects. Discoveries support character development, while different party combinations change how you approach encounters and environmental obstacles, linking travel and preparation with the next challenge.

records.zh: 玩家按关卡节奏点击，控制角色跳跃或飞行，穿过尖刺、平台和固定排列的障碍。动作窗口往往连续相接，需要记住前方变化并保持节奏，让一次成功躲避为下一段操作留下位置。
records.en: Time taps to control jumps or flight through spikes, platforms and patterned obstacles. Successive control windows follow closely, so learn the arrangement ahead and maintain the rhythm, ensuring that clearing one hazard leaves the character properly positioned for the next section.

records.zh: 双方轮流摸牌、弃牌，把手牌整理成同点数组或同花顺序组，减少无法成组的牌点。取舍一张牌时既要看当前组合，也要考虑它能否补齐后续牌组，逐步改善整手牌的结构。
records.en: Take turns drawing and discarding to organize a hand into matching sets and same-suit runs. Reduce the points left in unmatched cards, judging each draw or discard by both its immediate fit and the combinations it might help complete later.

records.zh: 双方在 9×9 棋盘上轮流落子，通过连接棋群、围空和提子争取更多地盘。每次落子既影响局部棋子的存活，也影响其他区域的边界，需要在扩张与保护已有棋形之间取舍。
records.en: Alternate placing stones on a 9×9 board, connecting groups, enclosing territory and capturing opposing stones. Each placement affects local survival and the boundaries of nearby areas, so balance new expansion with protecting formations that are already part of your position.

records.zh: 玩家扮演误入魔法森林的 Goldilocks，通过文字探索童话场景，与熟悉却反常的人物互动。寻找食物与落脚处时，需要检查并使用物品，把对话和环境中的线索组合起来破解谜题。
records.en: As Goldilocks, explore an enchanted forest through text and meet familiar fairy-tale figures behaving in unfamiliar ways. Search for food and shelter by examining and using objects, connecting what characters say with environmental clues to work through the adventure's inventory puzzles.

records.zh: 双方轮流在棋盘交叉点落子，争取率先横向、纵向或斜向连成五子。每颗新子都可延伸己方威胁或截断对方连线，不同实现也可能设置开局限制和禁手规则。
records.en: Place stones on intersections, trying to be first to make five in a horizontal, vertical or diagonal line. Extend threats and block opposing sequences under the implementation's opening restrictions and forbidden-move rules.

records.zh: 玩家控制不断移动的蛇收集食物，吃到食物后身体增长，留给转向的空间也随之改变。需要一边追逐下一个目标，一边为自己的长身体安排通路，避免撞上障碍或自身。
records.en: Steer a continuously moving snake toward food, which lengthens its body and changes the space available for turning. Pursue the next item while leaving a route for the growing body, avoiding obstacles and the portions of yourself that now occupy the playfield.

records.zh: 玩家在赛道中练习制动点、行车线与车辆控制，通过计时或多人比赛争取更快圈速。一个弯道的出弯速度和位置会影响下一段路，整圈节奏由连续的加速、制动和转向共同构成。
records.en: Practice braking points, racing lines and car control in time trials or multiplayer races. Each corner affects the approach to the next section, so connect the whole lap's rhythm, balancing local speed with the position needed to exit a turn cleanly.

records.zh: 玩家在场景中寻找资源、制作工具，用这些工具清理障碍，逐步打开前往樱桃树的路线。目标不能单靠移动完成，需要先判断通路缺少哪些条件，再把采集、制作和前进衔接起来。
records.en: Gather resources and craft tools to clear a route through the scene toward the cherry tree. Movement alone is insufficient: identify what blocks the next passage, obtain what is needed to remove it, and connect collection and crafting with actual progress toward the destination.

records.zh: 玩家在网格中行走，把箱子逐个推到指定位置，但不能随意把已推走的箱子拉回。需要提前安排推动方向和先后顺序，给人物留下通路，避免箱子卡在角落或互相封堵。
records.en: Walk through the grid and push crates onto their marked destinations, taking care that a push may be irreversible. Plan directions and order in advance, preserving access for the character so that boxes do not trap one another or become stranded in a corner.

records.zh: 玩家在洛圣都切换三位主角，驾驶车辆、参与枪战，推进剧情任务与抢劫行动。自由探索与任务行动交替展开，需要在移动、交战和角色切换之间衔接，完成当前行动所要求的步骤。
records.en: Switch among three protagonists in Los Santos, driving, fighting and carrying out story missions and heists. Move between open exploration and directed operations, connecting travel, combat and changes of character with the steps required by the activity currently underway.

records.zh: 四名玩家分成搭档对抗，组合对子、顺子和炸弹等牌型，按规则压过前一手。既要为自己整理出牌顺序，也要为搭档创造机会，以同队整体的出完顺序取得优势。
records.en: Four players compete in partnerships, forming pairs, sequences, bombs and other legal combinations to beat the previous play. Organize the order of your cards and support your partner to secure a favorable finishing order for the pair.

records.zh: 十名玩家在 0–100 之间选择数字，目标是让自己的选择尽量接近全体平均数的三分之二。重复进行时，可以参考之前的群体选择调整估计，但下一轮的目标仍会随着所有人的决定一起变化。
records.en: Ten players choose numbers between 0 and 100, trying to land near two-thirds of the group's mean. In repeated rounds, use earlier choices to revise your estimate, remembering that the next target changes with everyone else's decisions as well as your own.

records.zh: 控制器只能向左或向右施力移动小车，利用车的位置变化让上方杆保持直立。目标是在轨道边界内持续维持平衡，需要及时修正倾斜，又不能为了扶正杆而把小车推出允许区域。
records.en: Push a cart left or right to balance the pole mounted above it. Keep the pole upright without driving beyond the track bounds, making corrections that address the current tilt while preserving enough space for the adjustments that may be needed next.

records.zh: 玩家能看见伙伴的手牌，却看不到自己的牌，需要用有限提示传递颜色或数字信息。每次选择提示、出牌或弃牌，都要结合已知线索，合作按颜色和顺序构建烟花，避免误打破坏进度。
records.en: See your partners' cards but not your own, exchanging limited hints about colors or numbers. Use those clues when deciding to hint, play or discard, coordinating the order of cards so that the group builds its fireworks without wasting progress through a mistaken play.

records.zh: 玩家通过关键词搜索警方访谈录像，观看被检索出的短片段，再依据新发现继续提问和搜索。故事线并非按顺序呈现，需要把零散陈述、人物关系与时间信息拼合起来，理解案件发生了什么。
records.en: Search police interview recordings by keyword, watch short clips and use each discovery to guide another search. The account arrives out of order, requiring you to connect scattered statements, relationships and timing into an understanding of what happened in the case.

records.zh: 双方在 11×11 六角棋盘上轮流落子，分别争取连接属于自己的两条对边。每颗棋子既可巩固己方连接，也会压缩对手的通路，需要在局部连接与整盘路线之间作出判断。
records.en: Place stones in turn on an 11×11 hexagonal board, aiming to connect the opposite edges assigned to your color. Each stone can reinforce your own route or restrict the opponent's, so weigh local connections against the path needed across the whole board.

records.zh: 玩家旋转中央六边形，让下落彩条落在合适的一侧，再通过连接同色方块进行消除。每次旋转会改变各面的接收位置，需要一边整理已有堆积，一边为随后落下的彩条保留空间。
records.en: Rotate the central hexagon to catch falling colored bars on the side you want, matching colors to clear blocks. Rotation changes the receiving positions, so manage existing stacks while leaving room for incoming pieces before the buildup reaches the boundary.

records.zh: 玩家操控分工不同的英雄，通过对线、获取资源和争夺野区发展等级与装备。团队配合推进和防守，争取把交战优势转为地图进展，最终摧毁敌方水晶。
records.en: Control a hero in a five-player team, gaining resources through lanes and jungle objectives to develop levels and equipment. Coordinate attacks and defense, advancing across the map to destroy the opposing crystal.

records.zh: 玩家探索王者大陆，运用英雄共鸣和技能组合进行战斗，也可组队挑战秘境与首领。旅途之外还有种植、钓鱼等活动，可以在探索、准备和协作挑战之间安排自己的行动节奏。
records.en: Explore the world and combine hero resonance abilities in combat, with opportunities to team up for dungeons and bosses. Activities such as farming and fishing sit alongside those encounters, letting you alternate exploration and preparation with more focused cooperative challenges.

records.zh: 玩家把各种物件放到场景中，组合出能够运动和相互触发的装置，以完成指定目标。需要观察启动后的碰撞与连锁反应，调整位置或组合，让每个环节都能把作用传递到下一处。
records.en: Arrange objects into a device whose movement and chain reactions accomplish the specified goal. Watch what happens when it runs, then adjust placements or combinations so that one interaction triggers the next and the whole construction reaches the intended result.

records.zh: 众人用是非问题逐步猜出目标词，知情的内鬼则在不暴露身份的前提下引导讨论。猜词结束后，大家还要回顾谁提供了异常有效的方向，从参与方式中找出隐藏的内鬼。
records.en: Ask yes-or-no questions to discover a target word while an informed Insider subtly steers the discussion. After solving the word, reconsider who supplied unusually useful direction, separating ordinary participation from guidance that may reveal the person who already knew the answer.

records.zh: 双方每轮选择合作或背叛，两人的联合行动决定各自获得的收益。重复交互允许玩家利用之前的选择调整回应，需要在眼前收益与之后可能维持的合作之间作出取舍。
records.en: Choose cooperation or defection each round, with both players' actions determining their payoffs. Repeated interaction lets you respond to earlier behavior, weighing the immediate result of one choice against the cooperation or retaliation it may encourage in the rounds that follow.

records.zh: 玩家在持续变化的世界中移动，寻找并收集软糖，同时避开不利的洋葱。附近资源逐渐耗尽后，需要继续探索尚未搜集的区域，使眼前采集与寻找下一处资源相互衔接。
records.en: Move through the world collecting jelly beans while avoiding undesirable onions. As nearby resources are depleted, explore new areas to find another supply, connecting immediate collection with a continuing search across the world.

records.zh: 玩家通过文字探索层层深入的危险洞穴，检查、携带与使用物品来破解挡路谜题。旅程以取得古龙守护的知识宝石为目标，需要把途中发现的线索和工具用到后续障碍上。
records.en: Explore successive layers of dangerous caves through text, examining and using objects to solve obstacles. Work toward recovering the Jewel of Knowledge guarded by ancient dragons, carrying discoveries forward so that clues and tools found earlier can help with later parts of the journey.

records.zh: 一方看得到炸弹并负责操作模块，另一方只能阅读手册，双方必须靠语言交换信息。需要把装置外观描述清楚，再将手册步骤转为准确操作，在信息分离的条件下共同完成拆弹。
records.en: One player sees and operates the bomb while the others consult a manual without sharing that view. Describe the modules clearly and translate the manual's instructions into precise actions, using conversation to connect information that neither side can fully resolve alone.

records.zh: 玩家控制场景中的电机与推进器，让指定物体发生接触，同时避免规则禁止的碰撞。装置运动会互相影响，需要观察受力后的轨迹，调整控制方式，使整体运动满足当前任务的接触条件。
records.en: Drive motors and thrusters in a two-dimensional rigid-body scene to create required contacts while avoiding forbidden collisions. Watch how the connected objects move under those controls, adjusting the resulting trajectories until the arrangement satisfies the contact conditions of the current task.

records.zh: 玩家控制卡比漂浮穿越平台，吸入敌人后再把它们吐出作为攻击，沿关卡向前推进。移动和攻击需要配合，既要越过障碍，也要应对阻挡路线的敌人与最后的首领。
records.en: Float across platforms as Kirby, inhaling enemies and spitting them back out as projectiles. Link movement with attacks while progressing through the stages, finding a way past obstacles and the enemies that obstruct the route before facing the bosses ahead.

records.zh: 玩家持有隐藏手牌，通过下注、跟注或弃牌争夺底池，并从对方行动推测牌力。Kuhn 使用简化牌组与有限的下注选择，少量信息下的下注和诈唬构成对局核心。
records.en: Play the simplified Kuhn poker variant, using a hidden hand and a limited set of betting decisions to contest the pot. Judge what the opponent's actions suggest about their card, balancing a possible gain against the cost of calling or continuing a bluff.

records.zh: 玩家根据自己的底牌、公共牌和下注过程决定继续投入或弃牌，争取赢得底池。Leduc 采用简化牌组，公共牌揭示后会改变牌力比较和后续下注选择。
records.en: Use your private card, the public card and the betting history to decide whether to continue or fold in simplified Leduc hold'em. Reassess hand strength as visible information changes, weighing the potential pot against further investment under this variant's own rules.

records.zh: 多个角色在地图中移动到食物旁，共同执行装载；只有参与者等级之和达到食物要求，才能成功取得。需要协调谁靠近哪一份食物以及何时同时行动，避免单独尝试不足以搬运的目标。
records.en: Move agents next to food and load it together when their combined levels meet the food's requirement. Coordinate who approaches each item and when they act, avoiding isolated attempts on a target that cannot be collected by that agent alone.

records.zh: 玩家只看得到自己的骰子，轮流声明全场某个点数至少出现多少次，并选择继续加码或质疑上一声明。判断要结合自身信息与他人的叫价，既不能过早放弃，也要提防不可信的数量。
records.en: See only your own dice while bidding on how many dice of a chosen face exist across all players. Raise the claim or challenge the previous one, using your private information and the sequence of bids to judge whether the total remains plausible.

records.zh: 玩家根据底牌、公共牌与下注历史，选择跟注、按规定额度加注或弃牌，争取赢取底池。固定加注规则限制每轮投入的变化，需要在信息尚不完整时决定继续争取牌局还是及时止损。
records.en: Use private cards, community cards and betting history to call, raise within fixed limits or fold. The prescribed bet sizes constrain how investment changes during a hand, leaving you to judge whether incomplete information justifies continuing to contest the pot.

records.zh: 玩家在 Game Boy Color 版本的可湖霖岛上探索，取得新道具并破解地牢谜题，寻找唤醒风之鱼的乐器。新道具会改变能够通过的障碍，需要在地牢挑战与岛屿探索之间连接后续路线。
records.en: Explore Koholint in the Game Boy Color version, collecting items and solving dungeons to find instruments that can awaken the Wind Fish. New equipment changes which obstacles can be crossed, connecting progress inside dungeons with further routes around the island.

records.zh: 伙伴之间通过规则允许的提示传递手牌信息，协作按颜色与数字顺序打出烟花。玩家需要把提示与自己已知信息结合起来，选择安全的后续行动；本条限于 LLMArena 的小型规则配置。
records.en: Exchange the permitted hints with partners and cooperate to build fireworks in color and number order. Combine those messages with what is already known before choosing the next play, keeping decisions within the small Hanabi configuration used by this particular environment.

records.zh: 玩家通过文字命令调查 Ludicorp 办公楼，逐个检查房间、物品和线索。不同地点的信息共同指向公司迟迟未发布新游戏的原因，需要在调查中将这些发现连接起来。
records.en: Investigate Ludicorp's office through text commands, examining rooms and objects for clues. Connect information from different parts of the building to discover why the company's new game has not been released.

records.zh: 玩家按掷骰结果选择棋子前进，让各棋子绕过棋盘并进入己方终点区。途中可以击回对手，也可能暴露自己的棋子，需要在推进进度与保护已有位置之间取舍，争取率先全员到达。
records.en: Use dice results to choose which piece advances around the board toward your home area. Send opposing pieces back when possible while protecting your own progress, balancing a faster move with the risk of losing position before all of your pieces reach the finish.

records.zh: 玩家扮演被谋杀狼神的最后化身，通过文字选项与神祇及其代理人交涉，追查神明死亡的原因。残存的神力让角色成为各方关注的对象，复活狼神、为其复仇或改变神祇秩序构成不同的行动方向。
records.en: Play the murdered Wolf god's last avatar and choose how to deal with other deities and their agents. Your remaining divine power attracts competing interests, with paths involving revival, revenge or an attempt to overturn the pantheon's established order.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家从见习骑士的处境出发，通过文字选择修习邮授魔法，在元素、幻术、治疗与死灵等方向发展。参赛、战场表现和宫廷关系提供不同机会，但使用力量也要面对奥术腐化的代价，以及效忠王室或争取自身权力的选择。
records.en: Begin as a squire secretly studying magic by correspondence, choosing among elemental, illusion, healing and necromantic arts. Tournaments, warfare and court relationships offer different opportunities, while arcane corruption creates costs alongside decisions about loyalty and personal power.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家扮演复古未来主义世界中的冒险家 Challenger，通过文字选择追查导师被害与自己遭陷害的真相。故事穿梭于三十年代风格的都市、追逐和冒险场景，交涉、行动方式与结盟对象共同决定如何面对阴谋。
records.en: Play Challenger in a retro-futuristic 1930s world, choosing responses after a mentor's murder and an accusation against you. Travel, pursuit and encounters with conspirators turn methods, alliances and personal choices into the means of advancing the adventure.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家作为死亡故事收集者，接触将死之人并获取他们的经历，通过文字选择决定如何使用这些记忆。职业带来的知识可以服务公众，也可以换取名利或权势；故事围绕个人目标、机构要求与历史解释权之间的冲突展开。
records.en: As a Death Collector, acquire the stories of the dying and choose how their memories will be used. Knowledge can serve the public or advance personal ambition, placing professional obligations, institutional power and control over history in conflict.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家扮演掌管天气的 Weather Builder，运用风、火、土地等自然力量，应对下层人类世界失控的气候。文字选择既涉及如何处置灾害与敌人，也涉及是否修复天气魔法，或利用混乱追求自己的目的。
records.en: As a Weather Builder, wield natural forces while confronting chaotic weather affecting the human world below. Text choices concern disasters, opponents and the use of atmospheric power, including whether to repair the broken magic or exploit its instability.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家以初出茅庐的冒险者身份进入受邪恶巫师威胁的 Kendrickstone，通过战斗、魔法、潜行或交涉解决问题。名声、伙伴关系与日常开销同时影响旅程，需要在成长、谋生和拯救城市之间安排自己的选择。
records.en: Enter Kendrickstone as a novice adventurer and confront its threats through combat, magic, stealth or diplomacy. Reputation, allies and living expenses all matter, so choices link personal development and making a living with the effort to save the city.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家参加超级英雄真人秀，通过竞赛表现、结盟与公众形象选择争取影响力。随着威胁世界的阴谋显现，节目中的关系与利益又与更大的危机相连，需要决定如何使用能力，以及为谁承担风险。
records.en: Compete in a superhero reality show through performance, alliances and decisions affecting public perception. A wider conspiracy connects the competition to a threat against the world, making the use of powers and obligations toward others part of the story.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家参加超级英雄竞赛，利用每天变化的动物特征争取观众支持，并设法帮助自己的妹妹。通过文字选项安排表现与关系，在竞争目标、个人诉求和对其他超能力者的责任之间作出取舍。
records.en: Compete with changing animal traits to gain audience support while pursuing a personal goal involving your sister. Text choices shape performances and relationships, placing competitive success alongside individual needs and responsibilities toward other Powered people.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家扮演曾用幻术伪造救世预言的成名英雄，却发现当年的假预言开始真正应验。需要通过文字选择重新联系伙伴、应对新威胁，并决定继续掩盖秘密，还是尝试成为众人相信的那种英雄。
records.en: Play a celebrated hero whose earlier victory was fabricated with illusions, only to see the false prophecy begin coming true. Choices involve former companions, emerging threats and whether to protect the deception or become the hero others believe you are.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家经营二十世纪五十年代的电影事业，通过文字选择决定影片方向、演员、合作人员与宣传安排。创作抱负与片厂资源、行业关系和私人生活彼此牵动，可以追求奖项、商业成功或具有个人风格的作品。
records.en: Run a movie career in 1950s Hollywood, choosing a production's genre, cast, collaborators and publicity. Creative ambitions interact with resources, industry relationships and personal life, allowing different priorities such as awards, commercial success or a distinctive film.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家扮演星际亡命之徒的赛博格复制体，在遭到追捕的同时寻找修复衰退电子大脑的稀有部件。文字选择涵盖逃亡、交涉、能力升级与劫案准备，需要在危险旅程中判断能依赖哪些人和哪些自身能力。
records.en: Play a cyborg copy of an interstellar outlaw seeking a rare part to repair a failing brain while enemies pursue you. Choices connect travel, encounters, upgrades and heist plans, with survival depending on how abilities and relationships are used.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家扮演生日当天被囚禁的王室继承人，不能只等待营救，而要通过文字选择带领并应对前来救援的队伍。逃离高塔、识破夺位阴谋与恢复继承权彼此相连，战斗、魔法、机智与关系选择都能参与解决困境。
records.en: Play a royal heir imprisoned on a birthday and take an active role in directing an imperfect rescue party. Escaping the tower, uncovering the succession plot and reclaiming status involve choices using force, magic, wit and relationships.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家通过文字选择修炼武学与内在力量，在比试、对手和人际关系中塑造自己的道路。成为帝国冠军可带来向百年才开口一次的神龙圣者求问的机会，故事也允许在功名、政治立场与个人觉悟之间作出不同选择。
records.en: Develop martial skill and inner power through choices involving contests, rivals and relationships. Becoming Imperial Champion offers a chance to question the Dragon Sage, while the story also presents different priorities involving political allegiance, personal achievement and enlightenment.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家经营一支灵异清除小队，接受闹鬼地铁的工作，用文字选择安排队员、装备与事件处理。竞争公司、资金和市政要求使行动不只涉及驱散怪物，也涉及团队合作、雇佣关系以及如何维持自己的事业。
records.en: Run a spirit-extermination team taking a contract in a haunted subway, choosing how to manage people, equipment and encounters. Rival firms and civic demands complicate the work, linking supernatural threats with teamwork and the practical pressures of running a business.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家作为出售超能力公司的负责人，通过文字选择招聘科学家或术士、研发产品，并应对股东与竞争者。魔法、未来技术和商业手段共同构成经营工具，企业收益、个人权力与公司造成的社会后果之间可能发生冲突。
records.en: Lead a corporation selling superpowers, choosing staff, research and responses to shareholders or rivals. Magic, advanced technology and business tactics provide different tools, while profit, personal power and the consequences of the company's actions can pull in different directions.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家为逃离被安排的婚姻而伪装进入魔法森林，遇到身份错置、仙灵和不同的感情纠葛。通过文字对话与行动选择应对追踪和误解，决定信任谁、如何保持伪装，以及要追寻怎样的生活。
records.en: Flee an arranged marriage in disguise and enter an enchanted forest of mistaken identities, fairies and romantic complications. Conversations and choices concern pursuit, trust and maintaining the disguise while determining which relationships and future to pursue.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家被疯狂科学从死亡中唤回，却发现复活效果正在逆转，需要在有限生命中追查凶手并保护重要之人。文字选择围绕复仇、正义、关系与禁忌力量展开，调查将角色带往 Baroque 城市的不同阶层与阴暗角落。
records.en: Return from death through mad science, only to learn that the restoration is reversing. Choices guide the search for the killers through Baroque's social layers, linking justice or revenge with relationships, forbidden power and the need to remain alive.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家作为 Pendragon 的非婚生后代，率领不列颠军队对抗敌人与黑暗魔法，并争取自己的王位。通过文字选项决定正面作战还是谋略取胜，同时建立盟友、处理亲密关系，影响人民与自身的未来。
records.en: As Pendragon's illegitimate child, lead Britons against enemies and dark magic while pursuing a claim to the throne. Choices guide direct combat or deception, alliances and personal relationships, connecting the campaign to the future of both ruler and people.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家扮演 2061 年配有义眼摄像机的记者，在 New Angeles 一边追查案件，一边记录并争取报道机会。文字选择涉及新闻事实、个人名声、媒体要求与竞争者，揭露阴谋不一定意味着素材就能顺利播出。
records.en: Report from New Angeles in 2061 using cybernetic camera eyes, investigating cases while competing for coverage and influence. Choices place evidence, fame, newsroom demands and rivals in tension; discovering a story and getting it broadcast are separate challenges.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家进入水下的玻璃城，在看似永生的社会中接触人鱼、秘密与相互冲突的诉求。通过文字选择决定如何面对永生遭到威胁后的局势，并在爱情、记忆、自由与自身愿望之间衡量代价。
records.en: Explore the underwater City of Glass, meeting merfolk whose apparent immortality hides conflicts and secrets. When that gift is threatened, choices concern how to respond and what costs in love, memory or freedom are acceptable for personal desires.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家通过文字选项参与海上冒险，与伙伴共同面对威胁，在行动与交涉中争取营救朋友的机会。故事围绕自由与不公展开，需要决定为伙伴承担哪些风险，以及为了坚持自己的立场愿意付出什么代价。
records.en: Take part in a sea adventure through text choices, working with companions against threats while attempting to rescue friends. The story centers on freedom and injustice, asking which risks to accept for others and what to sacrifice for personal convictions.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家从追求成名的职业摔跤手起步，通过文字选择发展力量、技巧、空中动作或赛前演说能力。赛场剧本与真实冲突相互交错，观众期待、管理层要求和伙伴关系共同影响职业道路，有时体面的失败也可能服务于更大的目标。
records.en: Build a professional-wrestling career through choices developing power, technique, aerial skills or promos. Scripted performances overlap with real conflicts, and audience expectations, management and relationships complicate success, which does not always mean winning the next match.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家作为物理学生将车辆改装为时光机，前往恐龙时代探索、拍摄，并证明自己的研究成果。文字选择要同时处理古生物带来的求生危险和竞争者的威胁，在收集记录与设法安全返回之间安排冒险。
records.en: Travel to the age of dinosaurs as a physics student using a converted vehicle to document discoveries and defend a research claim. Choices balance observation and filming against dangerous wildlife, a rival's interference and the need to return safely.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家扮演准备飞升不朽的大法师，在天象交会前利用自己的高塔、力量和人际网络完成准备。诸神与宿敌同时介入，文字选择需要决定如何应对要求、保护追随者，并在不朽与毁灭之间寻找道路。
records.en: Prepare for immortality as an archmage before a rare celestial conjunction, using a tower, magical power and relationships. Gods and enemies intervene, turning choices about their demands and the safety of followers into part of the path toward ascension or destruction.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家在 1729 年的伦敦充当受雇捕盗者，追索财物、搜寻罪犯，并通过文字选择决定如何处理目标。可以借助武力、诡计或关系推进工作，也要在赏金、宽恕和逐渐卷入犯罪势力的机会之间取舍。
records.en: Work as a hired thief-taker in 1729 London, recovering property and pursuing suspects through text choices. Force, cunning and connections provide different methods, while rewards, mercy and opportunities to enter the criminal world create competing priorities.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家以企业助理身份潜伏，调查秘密制造的致命生物武器，却发现对方已开始搜寻内鬼。通过文字选择安排窃听、黑客入侵、伪装与脱身，需要在保护身份、处理卧底关系和完成任务之间持续应变。
records.en: Work undercover as a business assistant searching for a deadly biological weapon while a mole hunt begins. Text choices include surveillance, hacking, deception and escape, linking the mission to maintaining cover and deciding how to treat relationships formed during the infiltration.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家作为吸血鬼卷入渥太华亲王失踪后的权力争夺，通过文字选择调查、结盟或利用局势挑战上位者。古老氏族的利益与自身创造者的要求彼此交错，政治谋略、忠诚与暴力都可能改变在宫廷中的位置。
records.en: Enter Ottawa's vampire power struggle after its Prince disappears, choosing investigation, alliances or attempts to challenge superiors. Clan interests and obligations to a sire intersect, with political tactics, loyalty and violence offering different routes through the undead court.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家与盟友在 Versus 星球出现新威胁后进入危险的 Deathscapes，通过文字选择寻找生存与揭开秘密的机会。旅程连接不同世界、势力政治和人物关系，需要在记忆、战斗与个人目标之间决定下一步行动。
records.en: Enter the Deathscapes with allies after a new threat appears on Versus, making choices to survive and uncover its secrets. Journeys connect different worlds, political powers and relationships, linking memories, conflict and personal goals to the next action.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家被带到陌生的 Versus 星球，可以夺取他人的能力并吸收记忆，以应对竞技、生存和派系冲突。文字选择不仅决定战斗方式，也影响与其他囚徒的关系，以及是否能利用获得的知识与力量逃离困境。
records.en: Stranded on Versus, steal powers and absorb memories to face combat, survival pressures and factional conflict. Text choices determine how those abilities are used and how other captives are treated, connecting new knowledge and relationships to hopes of escape.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家扮演在收容营中长大的狼人，在一次越界探索后卷入军方与激进族人的冲突。通过文字选择决定战斗、交涉和结盟方式，在争取族群自由、保护伙伴与面对暴力升级之间寻找自己的立场。
records.en: Play a werewolf raised in an internment camp whose expedition brings conflict with the military and radical pack members. Choices guide combat, negotiations and alliances while placing the search for freedom alongside loyalty to companions and responses to escalating violence.

evidence.locator: Publisher description: player role, narrative choices, objectives and conflicts

records.zh: 玩家先构筑牌组，再以地牌提供法术力，施放生物、法术和其他卡牌参与攻防。每回合都要安排资源与出牌顺序，利用卡牌之间的配合建立优势，同时应对对手不断改变的场面。
records.en: Build a deck, use lands to supply mana and cast creatures, spells and other cards during play. Order your resource use and actions to create useful combinations, developing an advantage while responding to the changing board and the options the opponent presents.

records.zh: 玩家通过摸牌和弃牌整理手牌，结合牌河及其他可见信息判断成型机会与风险。推进牌型和防范对手之间需要不断取舍，不同规则对可用牌型、计分与结束条件有不同规定。
records.en: Draw and discard tiles to develop a hand, using the discards and other visible information to judge both opportunity and risk. Balance improvement of your own shape against helping opponents, following the selected ruleset for legal hands, scoring and how a round ends.

records.zh: 船员在场景中完成任务，并通过讨论和投票寻找、驱逐内鬼；内鬼则隐藏身份，利用击杀阻止船员达成目标。行动与发言要相互对应，既要处理眼前任务，也要解释自己在地图上的行为。
records.en: Crewmates complete tasks and use discussion and votes to find impostors, while impostors hide their identities and kill to prevent a crew victory. Connect movement with what you say about it, managing immediate objectives alongside the suspicions created by observed behavior.

records.zh: 狼人隐藏身份并争取形成数量优势，好人则需要辨别阵营并淘汰全部狼人。玩家围绕已有信息展开讨论和投票，既判断他人说法，也决定如何披露自己的信息，以推动本阵营接近胜利。
records.en: Werewolves conceal their identities while seeking numerical dominance, and villagers try to eliminate every werewolf. Discuss the available information and vote on suspects, weighing other players' accounts against what you reveal about yourself to move your side toward its victory condition.

records.zh: 玩家在地形、生存规则和任务依赖发生变化的世界中，采集材料、制作物品并解锁成就。熟悉的行动未必仍有相同前提，需要查看当前世界的资源关系，再安排获取工具与维持生存的步骤。
records.en: Gather materials, craft items and unlock achievements in worlds whose terrain, survival rules and task dependencies can change. Check the current relationships between resources and tools before acting, since a familiar action may require different preparation in this particular world.

records.zh: 玩家看得到伙伴的牌，却看不到自己的手牌，依靠受限提示判断何时出牌。MARSHAL 的 Mini Hanabi 配置提供特定牌组与提示限制，大家在这些条件下协作构建有序烟花。
records.en: See your partners' cards while relying on limited hints about your own hidden hand. Work together to build ordered fireworks using the deck and hint restrictions of MARSHAL's Mini Hanabi configuration.

records.zh: 玩家通过有限提示交换信息，在看不到自己手牌的情况下协作打出有序烟花。MARSHAL 的 Simple Hanabi 配置规定可用出牌、弃牌和提示动作，各次选择与队友已掌握的信息相互关联。
records.en: Coordinate ordered fireworks through limited hints while your own hand remains hidden. MARSHAL's Simple Hanabi configuration sets the available plays, discards and clues, with each action shaped by what teammates have already learned.

records.zh: 玩家在两位蜘蛛侠之间切换，摆荡穿越纽约、处理犯罪事件并推进剧情任务。两人不同的能力用于移动和战斗，需要把快速接近目标与现场应对衔接起来，在城市探索和连续任务之间安排节奏。
records.en: Switch between two Spider-Men, swing across New York and respond to crimes and story missions. Use their distinct abilities in movement and combat, connecting rapid travel with the demands of each encounter as exploration and directed tasks alternate throughout the city.

records.zh: 多台摄像机共同跟踪移动目标，通过调整覆盖方向尽量让目标持续处于视野内。彼此重叠过多会浪费可用覆盖范围，需要根据目标移动和其他摄像机的位置分配观察区域，减少遗漏与重复。
records.en: Coordinate several cameras to keep moving targets within their combined fields of view. Excessive overlap wastes coverage, so adjust the areas watched in response to target movement and the other cameras, balancing continued tracking of known targets against gaps elsewhere.

records.zh: 玩家在采集可获得收益的资源与清理公共河流之间分配行动，两者共同影响场景的持续运作。需要观察伙伴是否承担清理工作，再调整自己的投入，使眼前收集与公共环境维护能够衔接。
records.en: Divide actions between harvesting resources and cleaning a shared river, whose upkeep supports the ongoing activity. Observe how co-players distribute that work and adjust your own contribution, balancing immediate collection with the maintenance needed to keep the common environment useful.

records.zh: 这些环境包含观察指令序列并按顺序重演等任务，序列可能不断变长。先前出现的内容决定之后的操作，不同场景分别用各自的显示与控制方式组织记忆挑战。
records.en: These environments include observing a sequence of instructions and replaying it in order as the sequence grows. Earlier observations determine later actions, with distinct tasks providing their own controls, displays and memory requirements.

records.zh: 玩家在迷宫中重复寻找目标，逐渐记住通道、障碍和目标所在位置，再利用这些信息导航。新一轮寻找时，需要把当前看到的局部环境与之前的路线联系起来，减少无目的地重复探索。
records.en: Search repeatedly for targets in a maze, remembering corridors, obstacles and useful locations from earlier visits. Link the current local view with those stored routes when choosing a direction, using familiarity with the layout to avoid unnecessarily exploring the same passages again.

records.zh: 玩家先在网格中取得信件，再把它送到正确的目标位置，同时避开沿途敌人。场景里的文字说明帮助辨认对象与角色关系，需要把描述对应到当前布局，安排先取信、后送达的路线。
records.en: Collect a message in the grid and deliver it to the correct destination while avoiding enemies. Use the accompanying textual descriptions to identify the relevant objects and roles, connecting that information with the layout to plan collection first and a safe delivery afterward.

records.zh: 玩家安排工人采集资源，建立生产条件并制造部队，再指挥军队攻击敌方基地。采集与战斗会同时争夺单位和资源，需要让后方供应跟上前线行动，逐步把经济投入转化为地图优势。
records.en: Assign workers to gather resources, establish production and create units before directing forces against the opposing base. Gathering and combat compete for attention and resources, so keep the supply behind the front aligned with the units and pressure needed on the map.

records.zh: 玩家探索由方块组成的世界，采集材料、合成工具并搭建建筑，逐步改变周围环境。生存模式加入生命、饥饿和资源约束，创造模式则提供自由建造空间，支持不同节奏的探索与搭建。
records.en: Explore a block-built world, collect materials, craft tools and build structures that reshape the surroundings. Survival mode adds health, hunger and resource constraints, while Creative supports free construction, so the activities and preparation needed depend on the mode in use.

records.zh: 玩家翻开格子，依据数字提示推断周围地雷位置，标记危险并继续寻找安全落点。每次揭示都会带来新的邻接信息，需要把多个数字的约束合在一起判断，最终翻开全部非雷格。
records.en: Reveal squares and use their numbers to infer nearby mines, marking hazards while looking for another safe choice. Each reveal adds information about adjacent cells, so combine the constraints from several clues to uncover every non-mine square without triggering a mine.

records.zh: 队员合作对抗黑暗暴君，利用各自行动持续造成伤害，并应对它随机释放的技能。需要根据当前技能和队友状态调整接近、攻击与支援的时机，使队伍在变化的交战过程中保持输出。
records.en: Work together to damage the Dark Dragon while responding to its randomly selected skills. Adjust the timing of approaches, attacks and support to the ability currently being used and teammates' positions, keeping the group effective as the encounter changes around them.

records.zh: 玩家为不断扩张的城市连接车站，安排线路和列车，把乘客送到需要的地点。新站点与乘客增长会改变原有路网的负担，需要重新分配有限运力，避免部分车站长期积压。
records.en: Connect stations and assign routes and trains to transport passengers as a city expands. New stations and growing demand change the load on the network, requiring you to redistribute limited capacity and revise connections before crowded locations overwhelm the service.

records.zh: 玩家采集资源、建造设施并生产部队，最终摧毁对手基地。这里的对局分别面对 SIMPLE 与 HIT N RUN 规则对手，需要观察其行动方式，在基地发展和部队调遣之间安排相应的攻防节奏。
records.en: Gather resources, construct facilities and produce units to destroy the opposing base. Matches use the SIMPLE and HIT N RUN rule-based opponents, requiring you to observe their behavior and connect base development with the timing and positioning of your own forces.

records.zh: 角色在由钥匙、门、物体和障碍组成的网格中移动、转向、拾取与交互，完成当前关卡目标。行动前要辨认对象和通路，必要时先取得钥匙或处理阻挡，再继续推进到目标位置。
records.en: Move, turn, pick up objects and interact with doors in a grid containing keys, obstacles and goals. Identify the relevant objects and route for the current level, obtaining a key or handling an obstruction when required before continuing toward the destination.

records.zh: 这些小型地牢把迷宫、河流、巨石、怪物与物品组合成不同挑战，玩家通过移动和物体使用抵达目标。可用工具与障碍的相互作用决定通路，探索和处理阻挡共同推进任务。
records.en: Navigate small dungeons assembled from mazes, rivers, boulders, monsters and items, using movement and object interactions to reach the goal. Some routes require dealing with an obstacle first, so identify the tools available in the current task before simply advancing toward the destination.

records.zh: 玩家种植和收获商品，把货物补到货架上，再收银并使用收入购买升级。经营规模扩大后，不同工序对行动的需求也会增长，需要在生产、补货和服务之间循环，保持商店持续运转。
records.en: Grow and harvest goods, restock the shelves, serve customers and spend the income on upgrades. As the shop expands, different stages demand more work, requiring you to circulate between production, stocking and service so that growth does not interrupt the flow of business.

records.zh: 玩家通过文字探索月光中的高塔，检查面具等物品，并尝试找出它们的用途。环境和物品谜题逐渐揭示角色的身份与记忆，需要把新发现带回先前未解的细节，推进对整座塔的理解。
records.en: Explore a moonlit tower through text, examining masks and other objects to discover their uses. Environmental and inventory puzzles gradually reveal the protagonist's identity and memories, asking you to connect new findings with details that were difficult to interpret earlier.

records.zh: 玩家在一对一交战中利用普通攻击、特殊招式、跳跃和防御削减对手生命，争取赢得回合。距离与出招时机决定攻守转换，取得胜利后还可以按相应条件施展终结技。
records.en: Fight one-on-one using normal attacks, special moves, jumps and blocks to take the round. Manage distance and timing as offense changes into defense, responding to the opponent's openings before victory creates the opportunity to perform the game's finishing moves.

records.zh: 三个角色需要移动到三个地标附近，同时避免彼此碰撞。共享空间把各人的路线联系在一起，队伍通过分配不同目的地，使地标获得完整覆盖。
records.en: Move three agents to cover three landmarks while avoiding collisions with one another. Shared space connects their routes, and distributing the agents across different destinations determines how well the whole scene is covered.

records.zh: 机器人需要找到指定货架，将其运到工作站，再把货架送回仓储区。多台机器人共用狭窄通道，取送任务会相互影响，需要协调路线和通行顺序，避免堵住彼此的后续工作。
records.en: Fetch requested shelves, deliver them to workstations and return them to storage. Multiple robots share the same aisles, so coordinate routes and passage order as tasks overlap, preventing one delivery from blocking the access another robot needs for its own work.

records.zh: 玩家在真实地理地图上铺设铁路线和车站，安排班次并运行列车，把客流连接到目的地。线路扩张带来新的服务需求，需要调整时刻与覆盖范围，让列车运力与客流相匹配。
records.en: Lay railway tracks and stations on a map based on real geography, then schedule trains to carry passengers. As the network expands, adjust services and timetables to connect passengers with the places they need to reach.

records.zh: 双方先将九枚棋子放上棋盘，再移动它们组成三子连线，借此移除对方棋子。随着空位与剩子减少，需要在制造新连线和阻断对手之间取舍，最终让对方无法行动或剩子不足。
records.en: Place nine pieces and then move them to form three-piece mills that remove opposing pieces. As the available spaces and pieces change, balance creating a new mill against blocking the opponent, aiming to leave them unable to move or with too few pieces remaining.

records.zh: 玩家根据底牌、公共牌与对方下注判断局势，选择跟注、加注或弃牌以争夺底池。无限注规则允许更大幅度地改变投入，需要把下注金额与剩余筹码、可见信息和对手可能的回应一起考虑。
records.en: Use private cards, community cards and betting behavior to decide whether to call, raise or fold. No-limit betting allows large changes in investment, so connect the amount you wager with the chips remaining, available information and the response you expect from the opponent.

records.zh: 玩家控制角色在不断滚动的平台间向下移动，寻找安全落点并避开尖刺和危险地板。下降过慢会被带出画面，走得过急又可能错过平台，需要持续比较下方路线与当前滚动节奏。
records.en: Descend between platforms in a scrolling playfield, choosing safe landings while avoiding spikes and dangerous floors. Moving too slowly can carry you out of view, while a rushed drop may miss the next foothold, requiring continual adjustment to the pace of the screen.

records.zh: 玩家穿越程序生成的塔楼，寻找通路、解锁门和谜题，并避开沿途障碍。目标是在死亡或时间耗尽前完成尽可能多的楼层，探索陌生房间的速度也影响最终攀登高度。
records.en: Climb through procedurally generated floors, opening doors, solving puzzles and avoiding hazards along the way. Complete as many floors as possible before death or the timer ends, maintaining progress while giving each unfamiliar room enough attention to locate a workable route onward.

records.zh: 双方从各自基地出发，以第一人称发射棒球，争取先摧毁对方水晶。铁门会挡住弹丸且无法被击坏，玩家阵亡可无限重生，因此需要绕过掩护寻找水晶射线，同时保住己方核心。
records.en: Fire baseball projectiles in a first-person attack on the opposing crystal while defending your own. Indestructible iron gates block shots, and defeated players can respawn without limit, leaving the crystals as the decisive targets that each side must reach through the defended arena.

evidence.locator: Public task implementation prompt: objective, What you see on screen, Rules

records.zh: 当前公开实现中，玩家依据 NPC 外观与位置提示寻找交易对象，用手中物品完成一串交换任务。只有走到交互范围内才能交换，每次正确交易推进下一环，需要在倒计时内完成整条任务链。
records.en: In the public implementation, follow NPC appearance and location hints to complete a chain of item exchanges. Approach the correct character until interaction becomes available, trade the required held item and continue to the next exchange before the countdown expires.

evidence.locator: Public task implementation prompt: objective, What you see on screen, Rules

records.reason: 介绍限定为当前公开实现；逐游戏官方 prompt 比论文旧版表格更具体，不将当前规则反向视为旧版统一协议。

records.zh: 两名玩家在分工区域内收取、升级并提交食品订单，通过中转点传递物品。每人和每个中转点都只能容纳一件物品，高级订单还要求先加工升级，需要协调交接顺序，在限时内提高团队总分。
records.en: Work with a partner to collect, upgrade and deliver food orders across connected work areas. Each player and transfer point holds only one item, and high-grade orders require upgraded goods, so handoffs must be coordinated to keep deliveries moving before the timer expires.

evidence.locator: Public task implementation prompt: objective, What you see on screen, Rules

records.zh: 玩家控制角色留在一片悬空方格平台上，争取活到倒计时结束。地格会逐渐脱落形成缺口，掉下平台或踩进空洞便失败，需要持续观察剩余落脚点，随着地面缩减调整行进路线。
records.en: Stay alive on a floating platform until the countdown ends. Tiles gradually fall away and leave gaps that are fatal to enter, continually changing which sections of solid ground remain available to move across as the platform breaks apart.

evidence.locator: Public task implementation prompt: objective, What you see on screen, Rules

records.zh: 双方各自收取武器物品、按需升级，再抢先向共享订单列表交货得分。每人只能拿一件，先完成的订单会从列表移除；这里的武器不能用来攻击，需要根据对手进度及时调整下一次交付。
records.en: Race an opponent to collect weapon items, upgrade them when required and submit them against a shared order list. Weapons cannot be used to attack; each player carries one, and a completed order disappears, changing which delivery is still worth pursuing.

evidence.locator: Public task implementation prompt: objective, What you see on screen, Rules

records.reason: 按当前公开任务规则，武器是订单交付品，不能用来攻击；不改变现有能力映射或评测协议。

records.zh: 玩家以第一人称瞄准怪物连续射击，在限时内尽量削减敌人生命并完成击杀。怪物贴身会自爆伤害玩家，而且自爆不计得分，因此需要保持距离持续命中，不能靠诱使敌人撞上自己来清场。
records.en: Aim and fire repeatedly at monsters to score damage and eliminations before time runs out. Monsters require multiple hits; touching one triggers an explosion that damages the player and removes the monster without awarding any points for its destruction.

evidence.locator: Public task implementation prompt: objective, What you see on screen, Rules

records.zh: 玩家控制角色在横向悬空平台间向右前进，跳过间隙并抵达终点。掉进缺口会直接失败，整条路线还有三分钟时限，需要判断平台边缘和起跳距离，连续完成跨越而不在空中失去落脚点。
records.en: Run right across floating platforms and jump the gaps to reach the finish line. Falling into a gap fails the attempt, and a three-minute countdown limits the course, so each jump must connect to a safe landing while maintaining progress toward the end.

evidence.locator: Public task implementation prompt: objective, What you see on screen, Rules

records.zh: 玩家从第三人称视角控制角色穿越悬空平台，可转动视角、调整前后左右移动并跳跃。平台大小、高度和横向偏移各不相同，需要在三分钟内判断落脚点并抵达终点，跌落虚空即失败。
records.en: Move and jump across floating platforms from a third-person view, rotating the camera to judge each landing. Platforms vary in size, height and lateral offset; reach the finish within three minutes without falling into the surrounding void or a gap between surfaces.

evidence.locator: Public task implementation prompt: objective, What you see on screen, Rules

records.zh: 当前公开实现中，玩家在室内寻找与屏幕任务相符的可交互物体，按次序完成任务链。靠近目标后出现黄色交互提示，正确操作才会推进下一项，需要跟踪当前要求并在倒计时结束前完成全部任务。
records.en: In the public implementation, search an indoor scene for the object required by the current task and interact with it to advance the chain. Interaction is available only nearby, indicated by a yellow prompt, and the full sequence must finish before the countdown.

evidence.locator: Public task implementation prompt: objective, What you see on screen, Rules

records.reason: 介绍限定为当前公开实现；逐游戏官方 prompt 比论文旧版表格更具体，不将当前规则反向视为旧版统一协议。

records.zh: 两名玩家共用场地和订单列表，收取零件，必要时在工作台升级后交货。每人同时只能携带一个零件，高级订单不接受普通件，需要分担取料、加工与交付，避免重复处理已由搭档完成的订单。
records.en: Share an arena and order list with a partner, collecting parts and upgrading them at the workbench when needed before delivery. Each player carries only one part, and high-grade orders reject normal versions, making division of collection, preparation and submission central to team scoring.

evidence.locator: Public task implementation prompt: objective, What you see on screen, Rules

records.zh: 双方在高空方形平台上近身决斗，玩家要靠近并面朝对手才能有效攻击。每次命中削减对方生命，跌出平台则立即落败，因此追击时必须兼顾朝向与边缘距离，避免为了补上一击先失足。
records.en: Fight an opponent in melee on a square platform suspended in the sky. Attacks connect only when the enemy is close and in front, while falling off means immediate defeat, so closing distance and facing the opponent must not carry you over an edge.

evidence.locator: Public task implementation prompt: objective, What you see on screen, Rules

records.zh: 玩家按订单在场地收取零件，必要时到工作台升级，再送到交付柜台得分。一次只能携带一个零件，拿错可到回收处丢弃；高级订单只收升级件，需要安排取料、加工和交货的往返次序。
records.en: Collect parts for the active orders, upgrade them at the workbench when required and deliver them to the order counter. You can carry only one part, and high-grade orders accept only upgraded versions, so each trip must connect the appropriate pickup, preparation and submission.

evidence.locator: Public task implementation prompt: objective, What you see on screen, Rules

records.zh: 玩家在夜间角色行动之后，通过白天的一轮讨论比较各自掌握的信息，再投票决定怀疑对象。隐藏身份与可能变化的角色信息会造成相互矛盾的说法，需要围绕最终阵营目标判断该信谁、该投谁。
records.en: After the nighttime role actions, compare accounts during a single discussion and vote on a suspect. Hidden identities and potentially changed roles can produce conflicting information, requiring you to judge whom to trust and how the final vote serves your side's objective.

records.zh: 双方暗中用有限筹码同时出价，较高出价的一方把相扑手向对手方向推进。每次争夺都会消耗后续可用筹码，需要在当前推力与之后的竞价能力之间取舍，争取把相扑手推出对方边界。
records.en: Bid secretly and simultaneously with a limited supply of coins, pushing the wrestler toward the opponent when your bid wins. Spending changes what remains for later contests, so balance the current push against future bidding power as you work toward the opposing edge.

records.zh: 玩家在厨房中分工处理食材、烹饪和上菜，在限时内完成连续到来的订单。狭窄通路、共用设备和厨房变化会打乱流程，需要及时交接或调整站位，避免同伴互相阻挡而耽误出餐。
records.en: Divide ingredient preparation, cooking and serving among players to complete orders before time runs out. Crowded paths, shared equipment and changing kitchen layouts require handoffs and revised positions to keep meals moving through the kitchen.

records.zh: 玩家选择坦克、输出或支援英雄，利用各自武器和技能围绕地图目标交战。队伍通过协调站位、进攻与支援，争夺控制点，或推进、守护地图中的载具。
records.en: Choose a tank, damage or support hero and combine weapons and abilities around the map objective. Coordinate positioning, attacks and support to secure control points or advance and defend a payload.

records.zh: 玩家通过奔跑、滑铲和跳跃穿过平台关卡，避开机关并前往旗帜。不同动作可以衔接成连续移动，需要根据障碍位置选择组合，确保越过当前关口后仍有合适的落点与继续前进的空间。
records.en: Run, slide and jump through platform levels toward the flag, avoiding the mechanisms along the route. Combine movements to handle the arrangement of obstacles, making sure that clearing one section also leaves a suitable landing and enough space to continue through the next.

records.zh: 玩家取起一坑中的种子，沿后续各坑依次播撒，并在符合数量条件时捕获种子。每步都会改变多个坑的分布，需要判断最后落点及随后可能的捕获，逐步积累比对手更多的种子。
records.en: Pick up the seeds in a pit and sow them one by one into the following pits, capturing seeds when the count conditions are met. Each turn changes several locations, so consider the final landing and the opportunities it leaves for the next player.

records.zh: 玩家在浏览器迷宫中清理豆子，绕开追逐的幽灵，并利用能量豆暂时反击。每次转弯都要兼顾剩余豆子与追逐路线，避免为了局部得分被堵住；本条不对应 Atari 版本的具体实现。
records.en: Clear pellets from a browser maze while evading ghosts and using power pellets to reverse the chase. Choose turns with both remaining pellets and pursuit routes in mind, avoiding a trap while working toward a cleared maze; this entry is distinct from the Atari implementation.

records.zh: 玩家探索岛屿、捕捉帕鲁，让它们参与战斗，也可安排在基地采集与生产。搜集材料、建造设施和组织伙伴劳动相互依赖，需要让外出探索的所得不断支持基地扩展与后续旅程。
records.en: Explore islands and capture Pals to assist in combat or work at the base. Gathering materials, constructing facilities and assigning production tasks support one another, linking what you bring back from exploration with the base's development and preparation for another trip.

records.zh: 玩家扮演在 Bostwin 休假的连队指挥官，通过文字命令探索城镇、检查环境并与人物交谈。休假中遇到的事件需要依靠发现的信息和互动推进，把各处见闻转化为可以继续采取的行动。
records.en: Play a company commander on leave in Bostwin, exploring the town and speaking with its inhabitants through text commands. Respond to the encounters that interrupt the holiday, using information gathered from places and conversations to work out how to proceed.

records.zh: 玩家根据距离、地形和风向选择球杆与击球方式，再通过挥杆控制把球送向球洞。前一杆的落点会改变下一杆的条件，需要兼顾距离与位置，争取用更少杆数完成整段球场。
records.en: Choose a club and shot based on distance, terrain and wind, then control the swing to send the ball toward the hole. Each landing determines the next approach, so weigh position as well as distance while trying to finish the course in fewer strokes.

records.zh: 玩家在看不到对方完整布局的围棋棋盘上尝试落子，利用行动反馈推断隐藏棋子。新的反馈不断修正对局面的理解，影响棋群连接、围空和后续可用路线。
records.en: Attempt moves on a Go board without seeing the opponent's complete arrangement, using feedback to infer hidden stones. Combine new information with earlier deductions when deciding where to connect or surround space, adapting to a position that cannot be judged from visible stones alone.

records.zh: 玩家收集阳光，沿多条进攻路线种植功能不同的植物，阻止僵尸走到房屋。植物需要相互配合，资源又限制布置速度，因此要根据各路压力决定先补哪里、何时强化已有防线。
records.en: Collect sunlight and place plants with different functions across the lanes to stop zombies from reaching the house. Coordinate plant roles under limited resources, deciding which route most needs attention and when reinforcing an existing defense matters more than starting another placement.

records.zh: 玩家通过跳跃跨越平台，在合适位置放置炸弹，消灭敌人并处理阻挡路线的障碍。需要让炸弹位置与后续移动相互配合，清理当前区域后逐层向前推进，避免攻击行动把自己困在危险位置。
records.en: Jump between platforms and place bombs to defeat enemies and clear obstacles from the route. Coordinate where a bomb is set with where you move afterward, clearing each area to advance through the stages without letting the attack leave you trapped in danger.

records.zh: 玩家在城都探索、捕捉并培养宝可梦，通过队伍搭配和属性相克处理回合制战斗。旅途中获得的新伙伴与招式会改变可用战术，需要在继续探索和调整队伍之间循环，应对接下来的挑战。
records.en: Travel through Johto, catch and train Pokémon, and use team composition and type matchups in turn-based battles. New partners and moves change the options available, linking exploration with adjustments to the team as you prepare for the encounters further along the journey.

records.zh: 玩家在丰缘地区探索，捕捉并培养宝可梦，以回合制战斗挑战道馆和联盟。根据对手属性调整队伍与招式，把旅途中的收集转化为战斗准备，再利用逐步成长的队伍推进冒险。
records.en: Explore Hoenn, catch and train Pokémon, and challenge gyms and the League through turn-based battles. Adapt the team and its moves to opposing types, using discoveries during travel to prepare for encounters and the resulting growth to continue the adventure.

records.zh: 玩家在密阿雷市探索和捕捉宝可梦，战斗中训练家与宝可梦会同时移动。招式范围、释放时机与替换都影响交战，需要边调整位置边选择动作，不能把战斗简单理解为原地依次交换招式。
records.en: Explore Lumiose City and catch Pokémon, then battle while trainers and Pokémon move around together. Move range, timing, switches and positioning all affect which attacks connect and how the fight unfolds.

records.zh: 玩家在关都旅行，捕捉宝可梦并组建队伍，通过回合制战斗挑战道馆和宝可梦联盟。新的伙伴与成长改变可用的招式组合，需要根据接下来的对手调整队伍，让探索和培养支持后续挑战。
records.en: Travel across Kanto, catching Pokémon and building a team to challenge gyms and the Pokémon League. Turn-based battles test the matchups you have prepared, while newly found partners and continued training provide different options for the opponents encountered later in the journey.

records.zh: 玩家先组建队伍，再在回合中选择招式或替换宝可梦，利用属性相克、状态与队伍配合击败对方。对手可能的回应影响攻击和换人的价值，保留哪些成员也会改变之后的对局空间。
records.en: Build a team and choose moves or switches during turn-based Pokémon battles. Use type matchups, status effects and team interactions while anticipating the opponent's response, balancing an immediate attack against preserving the teammates and options needed to win the rest of the match.

records.zh: 玩家打出宝可梦、附加能量并组织进化，借助训练家卡准备攻击与后续回合。目标包括通过击倒对方取得奖励卡，需要把资源投入和可用招式连接起来，避免只铺出场面却无法持续行动。
records.en: Play Pokémon, attach Energy and develop evolutions, using Trainer cards to prepare attacks and future turns. Take Prize cards by defeating opposing Pokémon, connecting resource use with available attacks so that building the board also leaves a way to keep making progress.

records.zh: 玩家在隐藏手牌与公开信息之间判断局势，通过跟注、加注或弃牌争夺底池。对手的下注历史也是线索，需要权衡继续投入的成本与可能收益；牌组、下注结构和获胜牌型则随扑克变体而异。
records.en: Use hidden cards, public information and betting history to decide whether to call, raise or fold while contesting the pot. Weigh another investment against the possible gain and the opponent's behavior, checking the chosen variant for its deck, betting structure and hand rankings.

records.zh: 玩家翻开牌面，依据点数或颜色寻找匹配，并记住已经看过的位置。牌面随后重新隐藏，先前的观察帮助定位剩余组合，逐步完成全部配对。
records.en: Reveal cards and match them by the required rank or color, remembering the positions seen earlier. When those faces become hidden again, their known locations guide the selection of the remaining matching pairs.

records.zh: 双方反复选择合作或背叛，并可围绕互动进行交流，各轮联合选择决定相应收益。玩家需要结合之前的承诺和实际行动调整回应，在追求当前收益与维持之后的互惠关系之间判断。
records.en: Repeatedly choose cooperation or defection, with opportunities for communication around the interaction and payoffs determined by joint choices. Compare earlier promises with actual behavior when deciding how to respond, balancing a current gain against the reciprocal relationship that may continue afterward.

records.zh: 玩家控制小鱼捕食宽度比自己小的鱼，逐渐增大体型，并避开更大的鱼。碰到大鱼会被吃掉；成长到比场中所有鱼都大即可完成，因此需要随身体变化重新判断当前可捕食的对象。
records.en: Eat fish narrower than your own to grow, while avoiding contact with any larger fish. A collision with a bigger fish ends the run; becoming larger than every other fish completes the level, changing which nearby creatures are safe targets as you grow.

records.zh: 玩家驾驶小型飞船迎战首领，躲开多种弹幕，也可借陨石掩护。首领护盾会阶段性关闭，只有此时攻击才能造成伤害；需要反复等待和抓住破防窗口，直到累计伤害将其击毁。
records.en: Pilot a small starship against a larger boss, dodging its attacks and using scattered meteors as cover. The boss periodically lowers its shield and becomes vulnerable, so destroying it requires surviving between openings and landing repeated hits when the shield is down.
records.reason: 按官方 README 更正旧简介中的炮台阶段说法；核心机制为首领护盾关闭后的伤害窗口。

records.zh: 玩家转向并沿飞船当前朝向前进或后退，穿过洞穴网络寻找出口。途中可用激光摧毁目标得分，但固定和移动障碍都可能致命，需要控制惯性与航向，避免为了射击偏离安全通道。
records.en: Rotate a ship and move forward or backward along its current axis to navigate a cave network and reach the exit. Lasers can destroy targets for additional reward, while stationary and moving hazards shape the safe passages available through the caves.

records.zh: 玩家穿过迷宫收集全部绿色球体，同时避开追逐的敌人。吃到星星后敌人会暂时变得可被吞食，但被吃掉的敌人会以蛋的形式重新孵化，因此强化只能打开短时通路，不能永久清空追兵。
records.en: Collect all the green orbs in a maze while avoiding pursuing enemies. Stars temporarily make enemies vulnerable, but eating one creates an egg that later hatches a replacement, restoring the chasing force after the temporary opening provided by the power-up.

records.zh: 玩家沿一连串平台向上攀登，收集分布在不同落点的星星。取到全部星星才结束关卡，不只是到达最高处；飞行怪物散布在路线中，需要在选择下一次跳跃时同时考虑收集目标和安全落脚点。
records.en: Climb a sequence of platforms and collect the stars scattered along them while avoiding lethal flying monsters. The level finishes when every star is collected, making the route depend on remaining pickups rather than simply reaching the highest visible point of the course.

records.zh: 玩家从关卡最左侧出发，穿越平台地形并取得最右侧的金币。途中有静止锯片、来回移动的敌人和致命深坑，起跳时机和落地位置决定能否安全接上下一段道路。
records.en: Start at the far left and cross the platform course to collect the coin at the far right. Stationary saws, enemies pacing back and forth and deadly chasms interrupt the route, making jump timing and safe landings part of each crossing on the route to the coin.

records.zh: 玩家在随机墙体和敌人组成的房间中移动，只能朝角色面向投球。需要躲避敌人的投球且不能碰墙；击中全部敌人后，出口平台才会解锁，最后还要走到平台才能完成关卡。
records.en: Move through a room of enemies and walls, throwing balls only in the direction you face. Avoid enemy projectiles and wall contact, which is fatal; after hitting every enemy, reach the newly unlocked exit platform to finish the room and collect the completion reward.

records.zh: 玩家控制机器人穿过滚动场景中的墙体缺口，沿途收集水果，并避开混入的非水果物品。误收会受到比单次收果更大的扣分，部分门还需要钥匙，必须兼顾辨别物品和保持通行路线。
records.en: Guide a robot through gaps in scrolling walls, collecting fruit and avoiding non-fruit objects. Mistaken pickups incur a penalty larger than a fruit's reward, and some gates need keys, so reaching the end requires both selective collection and navigating the openings ahead.

records.zh: 玩家在十六款不同游戏中跳跃、射击、搜集或穿过迷宫，按各自规则取得金币、宝石或其他目标。每款游戏会生成不同地形和物体布局，相同操作并不对应同一目标，需要随作品切换玩法与完成条件。
records.en: Play sixteen games with their own movement, shooting, collection and navigation objectives, from reaching a coin to recovering a gem. Each game generates varying layouts and object placements, so the route changes between levels while its particular rules and completion target remain distinct.

evidence.locator: Official README: Environments, sixteen games and generated layouts

records.zh: 玩家在迷宫中寻找被多重彩色门锁挡住的宝石，收集相同颜色的钥匙才能通过对应门。钥匙分散在地图各处，需要先判断哪些区域可达，再依次打开后续通路，最后取得宝石。
records.en: Find a gem hidden behind colored locks in a maze, collecting keys that open the matching doors. Keys are scattered through the level, so the route must account for which areas are currently reachable and which key is needed to open the next passage.

records.zh: 玩家控制兔子在开放式平台关卡中寻找胡萝卜，可用二段跳到达较高位置。指南针显示目标方向和距离，尖刺碰到即死，需要根据提示决定上行或下行路线，取得胡萝卜后才完成关卡。
records.en: Guide a bunny through an open platform layout to find a carrot, using double jumps to reach difficult ledges. A compass shows the target's direction and distance, while spikes are lethal, and the route can involve climbing or descending as you follow that guidance through the platforms.

records.zh: 玩家先穿过需要避让汽车的车道，再借助河面浮木抵达对岸终点。汽车碰撞和落水都会失败，需要分别判断道路上的间隙与浮木的移动位置，把连续几次跨越接成一条安全路线。
records.en: Cross lanes of traffic and then a river to reach the finish line. Avoid cars on the road and hop between moving logs on the water; falling into the river ends the run, so a safe crossing depends on the timing of both sections.

records.zh: 玩家控制老鼠向上下左右移动，在随机生成的迷宫里寻找唯一一块奶酪。迷宫大小和通道会变化，需要根据当前布局识别连通路线，绕开走不通的分支，最终到达奶酪位置完成关卡。
records.en: Move a mouse up, down, left or right through a generated maze to find its single piece of cheese. Maze size and corridors vary between levels, so reaching the reward requires following the current layout and finding a connected route to the target.

records.zh: 玩家操控机器人挖开泥土并收集全部钻石，随后进入出口。泥土支撑着岩石和钻石，挖掉后它们会下落或滚动；任何落物砸中都会失败，因此开路和取宝必须同时考虑上方物体的变化。
records.en: Dig through dirt as a robot, collect every diamond and then enter the exit. Dirt supports boulders and diamonds, which fall or roll when space opens beneath them; either can crush the player, making excavation change the hazards as well as the available paths.

records.zh: 玩家控制忍者在狭窄落脚点间跳跃，可通过持续蓄力增加跳跃幅度，并向多个角度投掷飞镖清除炸弹。目标是取得关卡末端的蘑菇，需要根据平台间距控制蓄力，避免落地时碰到炸弹。
records.en: Charge a ninja's jumps to cross narrow ledges and throw stars at different angles to clear bomb obstacles. Collect the mushroom at the end to finish, judging the charge needed for each gap while keeping the chosen landing spot clear of remaining bombs.

records.zh: 玩家在画面底部操纵船只，用炮弹击毁指定颜色的敌船，不能误伤友船。每次开火都会额外消耗倒计时，击中友船的时间惩罚更大，因此需要先确认目标颜色，再选择值得发射的一炮。
records.en: Fire cannonballs from your ship at the bottom of the screen to destroy vessels of the designated enemy color. Every shot consumes extra time, and hitting a friendly ship brings a larger timer penalty, making target identification and conserving shots part of staying in play.

records.zh: 玩家驾驶横向飞行的战机射击敌舰，并躲避会直接瞄准自己的弹丸。敌人包括快慢不同的飞船和耐久较高的炮台，云层会遮挡视野，陨石则无法穿越，需要在攻击时持续调整安全飞行路线。
records.en: Pilot a side-scrolling fighter and destroy enemy ships while dodging projectiles aimed directly at you. Fast and slow enemies, durable turrets, obscuring clouds and impassable meteors create different problems along the route, requiring continued movement to keep a safe path through incoming fire.

records.zh: 玩家搜集武器、弹药与补给，在逐渐缩小的安全区内转移，争取成为最后存活的个人或队伍。每次交战都可能影响后续补给与位置，需要比较主动进攻、隐藏和提前移动的价值。
records.en: Scavenge weapons and supplies while moving within a shrinking safe zone, aiming to be the last player or team alive. Each engagement changes your position and resources for what follows, so weigh attacking, staying concealed and relocating before the next area closes.

records.zh: 玩家搜集装备并利用载具在地图上转移，与队友一起应对交火和不断缩小的安全区。需要让物资搜寻与行进时间相配合，避免停留过久而失去路线，争取让队伍存活到最后。
records.en: Loot equipment and use vehicles to move across the map with teammates, handling opponents and the contracting safe zone. Balance time spent searching against the route still available, keeping the squad prepared for combat without lingering until a safe departure is lost.

records.zh: 玩家决定把多少点数投入公共池，同时保留其余点数以影响个人收益。公共贡献与私人留存的结果需要一起考虑，既观察群体投入，也判断自己的选择能否在当前规则下带来较高的最终回报。
records.en: Choose how many points to contribute to a shared pool and how many to retain privately. Consider the consequences of both parts of the allocation, observing the group's contributions while deciding how your own investment affects the final payoff under the current rules.

records.zh: 玩家轮流移动棋子或放置有限的墙体，争取先到达棋盘对侧。墙体可以延长对方通路，也会改变自己的可行路线，需要比较绕路成本与阻挡收益，保持己方仍有办法抵达终点。
records.en: Move a pawn or place one of a limited number of walls, trying to reach the opposite side first. A wall can lengthen the opponent's route while changing your own options, so compare the delay it creates with the path you still need to travel.

records.zh: 玩家每轮先侦察棋盘的一小块区域，再尝试走子，通过侦察与行动反馈推断隐藏的对手布局。需要随新信息修正判断，既安排攻击，也避免把基于过时推测的走法当成确定可行。
records.en: Sense a small region of the board before attempting a chess move, using observations and action feedback to infer the hidden opposing position. Update that picture as information changes, planning attacks without treating a move based on an earlier assumption as certainly valid now.

records.zh: 玩家骑马探索西部地区，与人物互动、狩猎和交战，随着剧情任务推进旅程。自由探索与定向任务交替展开，补给、行进路线和沿途遭遇共同构成日常活动。
records.en: Travel on horseback through a Western world, speaking with characters, hunting and fighting as story missions develop. Manage supplies and travel while moving between free exploration and the encounters that advance the story.

records.zh: 玩家提名行动队伍并投票决定是否接受，队员随后秘密选择让任务成功或遭到破坏。抵抗军要找出可信的搭档，间谍则隐藏身份影响组队，讨论、表决和任务结果不断改变彼此判断。
records.en: Nominate and approve mission teams before members secretly choose whether the mission succeeds or is sabotaged. Resistance players seek trustworthy partners while spies influence selections without exposing themselves, with discussion, votes and outcomes continually changing how players interpret one another.

records.zh: 玩家扮演一只会定时自动拍翼的鸽子，观察拍翼计量条安排移动与起落。屋顶缺口和尖刺限制通路，抵达面包需要让路线与不断重复的拍翼节奏相配合。
records.en: Control a pigeon whose wings flap automatically, watching the meter to time movement around that cycle. Cross rooftop gaps and spikes to reach bread, coordinating takeoffs and landings with the recurring flaps.

records.zh: 玩家扮演卷入犯罪事件的披萨外送员，通过文字探索、对话和使用物品应对不断升级的处境。需要利用发现的线索阻止罪犯并躲避追杀，让各处互动支持继续推进剧情和摆脱危险。
records.en: Play a pizza courier drawn into a crime plot, using text-based exploration, conversations and objects to respond to escalating events. Connect the clues and interactions you find with attempts to foil criminals and evade pursuit, progressing through the story while avoiding the dangers around you.

records.zh: 玩家把棋子落在能够夹住对方棋子的位置，将夹在中间的棋子翻为己方颜色。落子会改变后续合法位置，需要兼顾当前翻转数量、边角控制和终局布局，最终争取保有更多棋子。
records.en: Place a disc to outflank opposing discs and flip them to your color. Each move changes the placements available afterward, so weigh immediate conversions against control of edges and corners and the position that will determine the final disc count.

records.zh: 玩家通过摸牌和弃牌整理手牌，结合可见牌与对手行为判断进攻机会和放铳风险。立直等日式规则影响牌型与计分，玩家在推进和牌和收缩防守之间不断转换。
records.en: Draw and discard to develop a hand while using visible tiles and opponents' behavior to judge opportunity and risk. Japanese rules, including riichi, shape those choices, requiring a balance between pursuing a winning hand and defending according to the applicable scoring and legal-hand conditions.

records.zh: 玩家只能观察迷宫当前位置的局部画面，需要通过移动把分散视图连接成对通路的理解。目标是抵达指定位置，途中要记住转弯与已走路线，避免每次看到新画面都重新从零搜索。
records.en: Navigate to the maze goal using only local visual views. Connect the passages through movement, remembering turns and traveled routes to build a usable picture of where the destination lies.

records.zh: 玩家翻开卡牌观察其内容，记住它们的位置，再选择两张同类卡牌完成配对。牌面重新隐藏后，要利用之前的观察继续寻找剩余组合，减少无效尝试，直到全部卡牌都被匹配。
records.en: Reveal cards, remember their contents and positions, and select matching pairs. When the faces are hidden again, use what earlier reveals established to locate the remaining combinations, reducing unnecessary trials as you work toward matching every card on the board.

records.zh: 球员在二维足球仿真中跑位、传球、防守与射门，争取进球并限制对方机会。持球者和无球队员的位置相互配合，球队随着球权变化在进攻组织与球门保护之间切换。
records.en: Position simulated players, pass, defend and shoot in a two-dimensional football match. Coordinate the ball carrier with teammates' movement, switching between creating scoring opportunities and protecting the goal as possession changes.

records.zh: 双方同时选择石头、剪刀或布，三种动作循环克制，每轮结果由两人的联合选择决定。重复对局时，可以参考之前的出招改变选择，既尝试捕捉对手习惯，也避免自己的顺序过于容易预测。
records.en: Choose rock, paper or scissors simultaneously, with the three actions beating one another in a cycle. Across repeated rounds, adapt to the opponent's earlier selections while varying your own choices, seeking useful patterns without becoming predictable through an easily recognized sequence.

records.zh: 玩家驾驶车辆追逐足球，通过碰撞、加速和跳跃改变球的运动，把它送入对方球门。需要让车辆位置与触球时机配合，既安排下一次进攻，也避免冲过球后留下难以及时回防的空隙。
records.en: Drive a vehicle into the ball, using acceleration and jumps to send it toward the opposing goal. Coordinate your approach with the moment of contact, preparing another attack while avoiding an overshoot that leaves too much space to recover and defend.

records.zh: 玩家探索开放地图，捕捉与培养精灵，搭配队伍和技能展开对战。孵蛋、采集与社交等活动穿插在冒险之中，可以让收集与养成支持后续挑战，再通过探索寻找新的伙伴和资源。
records.en: Explore the map, capture and develop creatures, and combine team members and skills in battles. Hatching, gathering and social activities accompany the journey, linking collection and preparation with later challenges while further exploration offers new companions and resources to work with.

records.zh: 玩家阅读当前规则，判断哪件道具能够克制指定怪物，再移动取得道具并交战。文字中定义的物品与怪物关系决定各对象在本轮的作用，观察、取物和战斗按这一对应关系衔接。
records.en: Read the current rules to determine which item can defeat the specified monster, then collect it and enter combat. Connect the textual relationships to the objects on the map, whose roles depend on the instructions for that round.

records.zh: 玩家在悬空隧道中奔跑和跳跃，跨过缺口，并利用侧壁改变脚下的行走平面。需要提前选择下一段可落脚的表面，让转向和起跳连续衔接，避免越过一个缺口后又掉入下一个空洞。
records.en: Run and jump through a suspended tunnel, crossing gaps and using the side walls to change the walking surface. Choose the next viable landing ahead of time, connecting turns and jumps so that clearing one opening does not send you into the next.

records.zh: 玩家进入案件现场，观察摆设、检查物品与文字线索，再联系不同证据推断发生过什么。场景不会直接给出完整解释，需要比较细节、形成事件经过，并用这些推断回答案件提出的问题。
records.en: Inspect a crime scene, examining objects and written clues before linking the evidence into an account of events. The scene does not provide a complete explanation, so compare details and build deductions that allow you to answer the questions posed about the case.
