records.zh: 玩家通过讨论和投票选出政府，再秘密处理政策卡，让本阵营的政策或特殊胜利条件得到推进。公开的提名与表决、私下的政策选择可能互相矛盾，需要据此判断身份并决定是否信任下一届政府。
records.en: Discuss and elect a government, then process policy cards privately to advance your side's policy track or special victory condition. Compare public nominations and votes with the resulting legislation, judging conflicting accounts when deciding which players to trust with the next government.

records.zh: 玩家选择职业深入随机地牢，与敌人交战、辨识物品，并管理饥饿、药水与其他补给。每层探索所得会影响后续准备，需要在继续深入和维持生存之间取舍，逐步寻找地牢中的护符。
records.en: Choose a class and descend through a changing dungeon, fighting enemies, identifying items and managing hunger and supplies. Each floor alters the options available for the next, requiring you to balance further exploration against survival while working toward the amulet below.

records.zh: 商人秘密把货物装袋并申报，警长判断是否检查，也可以围绕贿赂展开商谈。玩家需要比较合法货物的稳定收益与走私风险，观察他人的申报和态度，在查验与放行之间争取更多得分。
records.en: Merchants secretly pack goods and make a declaration, while the sheriff decides whether to inspect and negotiates over bribes. Weigh lawful sales against smuggling risk, using the declarations and conversation to decide when inspection or passage is likely to produce a better result.

records.zh: 这套合集包含数独、桥梁、数织、回路等多种单人谜题，每款都有各自的提示与合法操作。玩家将局部约束组合成完整布局，或寻找满足规则的操作序列，完成各自不同的解题目标。
records.en: Solve a collection of single-player puzzles, including number grids, bridges, nonograms and loops. Each game supplies its own clues and legal operations, with local constraints combining into a completed layout or sequence.

records.zh: 玩家通过叫牌确定庄家，由一人对抗另外两人，再依据所选定约争取足够的牌点。将牌和出牌顺序决定哪些牌能拿到关键牌墩，需要结合搭档关系与已出牌面安排后续争夺。
records.en: Bid to determine a declarer who then plays against the other two participants under the chosen contract. Use trump and the order of play to contest valuable tricks, judging the exposed cards and partnership situation when deciding how to win the points required.

records.zh: 玩家轮流暗放花朵或骷髅，再通过竞价声明自己能够安全翻开多少张牌。叫价需要结合已知信息与对他人的判断，既可能用花朵建立可信度，也可能用骷髅诱使对手承担失败风险。
records.en: Place flowers or skulls face down, then bid on how many cards you can reveal safely. Base the claim on what you know and what others may have placed, balancing a credible bid against the chance that a hidden skull makes the attempt fail.

records.zh: 玩家用牌组进行回合制战斗，沿途选择新卡、遗物与路线，逐渐形成适合当前旅程的组合。每次选择都会改变后续抽牌和资源状况，需要把单场胜利与整段攀塔所需的准备联系起来。
records.en: Fight turn-based battles with a deck that changes as you choose cards, relics and routes along the climb. Each addition affects later draws and resources, so connect the needs of the current fight with the combinations and preparation required for the remaining journey.

records.zh: 玩家在攀塔途中进行回合制卡牌战斗，选择路线、获得卡牌和遗物，并据此调整牌组。需要让新选内容与已有组合相配合，同时顾及连续战斗的消耗，使眼前优势能够延续到下一段旅程。
records.en: Climb through turn-based card battles, choosing routes and acquiring cards and relics that reshape the deck. Match new additions to existing combinations while accounting for the cost of successive encounters, aiming to carry the advantage from one fight into the next part of the run.

records.zh: 虚拟角色在小镇不同地点活动，安排个人计划、与其他角色交流，并根据经历调整后续行为。互动影响日程和人际关系，许多相互连接的日常活动共同构成不断展开的小镇生活。
records.en: Virtual residents move between locations, follow personal plans and talk with one another, adjusting later behavior in light of their experiences. These interactions shape schedules and relationships, producing a continuing network of daily activities around the town.

records.zh: 玩家操纵蛇寻找食物，吃到后身体不断变长，既要避开障碍，也不能撞上自身。随着可用空间缩小，需要提前安排转弯和回绕路线，让下一个食物的位置不会把自己引进死路。
records.en: Steer a snake toward food, which makes its body longer, while avoiding obstacles and itself. As the available space shrinks, plan turns and loops ahead of time so that reaching the next item does not leave the growing body without a route onward.

records.zh: 玩家通过讨论与结盟争取在多轮淘汰投票中存活，持续判断谁会支持或针对自己。进入最后三人后，目标转为说服已淘汰玩家组成的陪审团，因此早期关系也会影响终局能否获胜。
records.en: Discuss and form alliances to survive successive elimination votes. Reaching the final three leads to a jury vote by eliminated players, making earlier relationships and their view of your conduct part of deciding the winner.

records.zh: 玩家在狭窄网格中把箱子推到指定位置，但错误推动可能把箱子永远卡住。需要为角色保留移动通道，先判断箱子该从哪一侧接近，再安排整个推动顺序，让所有目标都能完成。
records.en: Push crates onto their target squares in a confined grid, where a bad move can leave a box permanently stuck. Preserve routes for the character and identify which side each crate must be approached from before committing to the sequence needed to place them all.

records.zh: 玩家位于矩形房间中，用武器击中对面墙边随机出现的敌人。每次目标换位后重新寻找位置并调整瞄准，持续完成这个基础场景中的定位与射击循环。
records.en: Shoot enemies that appear at random positions near the opposite wall of a rectangular room. Locate each target and adjust aim as its position changes, repeating the aiming-and-shooting loop within this basic scenario.

records.zh: 玩家通过文字命令探索奇幻场景，寻找物品和法术，再用合适的咒语处理障碍。物品与魔法的组合会打开新线索和路线，需要回顾先前遇到的问题，让探索所得转化为后续解法。
records.en: Explore a fantasy world through text, collecting objects and spells to deal with obstacles. Combine magical effects with inventory clues to reveal routes or information, revisiting earlier problems when a new discovery supplies a different way to approach the next puzzle.

records.zh: 多数玩家知道同一个地点，通过互相提问寻找不知道地点的间谍；间谍则从回答中寻找线索并掩饰自己的无知。提问要足够区分身份，又不能直接泄露地点，让推理与信息保护同时进行。
records.en: Most players know a shared location and question one another to identify the uninformed spy. The spy listens for clues while hiding that lack of knowledge, so questions must distinguish genuine familiarity without revealing enough for the outsider to infer the location too easily.

records.zh: 玩家选择时机让移动中的方块落下，尽量使它与下层边缘对齐，逐步把塔堆高。伸出的部分会被切掉，失误因此缩小后续的可用面积，需要在越来越窄的平台上保持连续精确落位。
records.en: Stop each moving block so that it lands aligned with the layer below. Overhanging sections are cut away, narrowing the surface for later blocks as the tower grows taller.

records.zh: 玩家在 STAG 与 HARE 之间选择，前者的团队收益取决于是否达到规则设定的参与阈值。需要判断其他成员是否会共同选择，在可能的集体高收益与另一种行动的回报之间作出取舍。
records.en: Choose STAG or HARE under rules where the team benefit from STAG depends on meeting a participation threshold. Estimate whether enough others will join that choice, weighing the possible collective reward against what the alternative action offers in the current configuration.

records.zh: 玩家采集矿物与瓦斯、建设基地并研发科技，持续生产军队，在侦察后安排攻防。经济发展与实时交战同时进行，需要把资源投入、部队位置和对手动向联系起来，避免一端的操作中断另一端。
records.en: Gather minerals and gas, construct a base, research technologies and produce an army while scouting the opponent. Economic development continues during real-time engagements, requiring resource choices and unit positioning to remain connected as attention shifts between the base and the battlefield.

records.zh: 玩家种植作物、养殖动物，并通过采矿、钓鱼和社区活动获得资源与新机会。每天可用时间有限，需要安排农场维护与外出活动，让收获支持后续投入，同时逐步经营与镇上居民的关系。
records.en: Grow crops and care for animals while mining, fishing and taking part in the community. Divide each day's limited time between maintaining the farm and traveling elsewhere, using the resulting resources for further development while gradually building relationships with the town's residents.

records.zh: 玩家耕种、照料动物，也可采矿和钓鱼，以每日劳动逐步发展农场。镇上的活动与赠礼影响人际关系，需要在照顾农场和走访矿石镇之间分配时间，让经营与社区生活共同推进。
records.en: Cultivate crops, care for animals, mine and fish as daily work develops the farm. Activities and gifts also shape relationships in Mineral Town, requiring time to be shared between farm responsibilities and visiting residents so that both business and community life continue to grow.

records.zh: 双方先将身份隐藏的棋子布阵，再移动和交战，通过比较等级逐步揭示对手力量。目标是夺取敌方军旗，需要用侦察和试探判断隐藏布局，同时保护己方关键位置，避免只按已见棋子作出判断。
records.en: Arrange pieces with hidden identities, then move and fight to reveal information through rank comparisons. Use scouting and probing encounters to locate the opposing flag while protecting your own position from threats in the partly hidden layout.

records.zh: 玩家利用走位、普通攻击、投技与特殊招式削减对手生命，在有限时间内争取回合胜利。不同动作的距离与出招时机相互牵制，需要观察对手选择，在主动进攻和防守反击之间转换。
records.en: Use movement, normal attacks, throws and special moves to reduce the opponent's health and win within the round's time limit. Judge the reach and timing of both players' options, shifting between pressure and defense as an opening appears or disappears.

records.zh: 玩家在回合交战中控制距离，衔接普通技与特殊技，并利用格挡系统处理对方攻击。进攻组合与防守时机彼此影响，需要根据对手节奏调整出招，寻找能安全转入反击的机会。
records.en: Manage distance and connect attacks during round-based fights, using special moves and the parry system to answer incoming pressure. Offensive combinations and defensive timing interact, requiring you to adapt to the opponent's rhythm and recognize when a safe opening allows a counterattack.

records.zh: 玩家根据已给数字填满网格，使每行、每列和指定区域都满足数字不重复的约束。一次填写会改变相关位置的候选值，需要把多个区域的提示联系起来，逐步排除不可能的选择。
records.en: Fill empty cells using the given digits so that rows, columns and designated regions satisfy the non-repetition rules. Each placement changes the candidates elsewhere, allowing clues from several parts of the grid to combine into further deductions.

records.zh: 玩家控制马力欧奔跑、跳跃并获取强化，跨越平台、敌人与障碍，向每关终点前进。移动速度与起跳位置共同决定落点，强化带来的能力变化也影响后续路段的通过方式。
records.en: Run and jump as Mario, collect power-ups and pass enemies and obstacles on the way to the level's end. Match movement speed to takeoff positions and use the available abilities to handle later sections, linking each landing to the route still ahead.

records.zh: 玩家控制马力欧穿越平台与敌人，搜集强化并推进各个关卡，部分路段转为驾驶载具进行射击。需要根据场景切换移动和攻击方式，既安排安全落点，也处理挡在前进路线上的目标。
records.en: Guide Mario across platforms and enemies, collecting power-ups as the journey alternates with vehicle-based shooting sections. Adapt movement and attacks to the current scene, choosing safe landings or handling targets along the route so that each section leads into the next.

records.zh: 玩家在 Orak 接入的马力欧版本中奔跑、跳跃，穿过敌人与机关以推进关卡。前方地形决定起跳和落脚位置，连续动作需要衔接成一条抵达终点的可行路线。
records.en: Run and jump as Mario through enemies and mechanisms to advance across the level. Within the version integrated by Orak, the terrain determines the takeoff points and landings needed to keep a route open toward the end.

records.zh: 玩家通过移动、攻击与防御累积对手伤害，再把对方击出场地边界。场地位置同时影响进攻和生存，追击时还要保留回到平台的机会，以应对随时反转的交战。
records.en: Move, attack and defend to build the opponent's damage and launch them beyond the stage boundaries. Position matters for both pressure and survival, requiring you to weigh a pursuit against retaining a route back to the stage if the exchange turns against you.

records.zh: 玩家驾驶卡丁车沿赛道竞速，利用漂移、加速与道具争夺位置。弯道路线和其他车手会影响可用空间，需要把行车控制与道具时机配合起来，让一次超车转化为持续的领先。
records.en: Race a kart around the track, using drifting, boosts and items to gain positions. Corners and nearby drivers change the space available, so connect vehicle control with the timing of item use, aiming to turn one successful overtake into an advantage that lasts.

records.zh: 穿过花园与铸造场，跳越缺口、收集金币，并用远程攻击应对敌人。沿途寻找传送装置，在最后一段迎战眼睛首领，完成后可查看各段用时、收集与击杀记录。
records.en: Cross the garden and foundry, jumping gaps, collecting coins and using ranged attacks against enemies. Seek the teleporters along the route, then confront the Eye boss; the ending records stage times, coins collected and enemies defeated.

evidence.locator: reference_observations R001, R006, R030, R041, R073, R094 and R098

records.zh: 与四辆对手赛车竞速，每场完成三圈，进弯时选择刹车时机，出弯再加速争取位置。沥青、沙地和路沿带来不同路面条件，部分弯角还有可利用的捷径。
records.en: Race four opponents over three laps, braking into corners and accelerating out to gain places. Asphalt, sand and kerbs create different driving conditions, while selected corners offer shortcuts that alter the line through the circuit.

evidence.locator: reference_observations R001, R003, R025, R035, R043 and R088; GAMES.md racing section

records.zh: 驾驶飞船移动射击，避开敌方弹幕，完成三段战斗并击败最终首领。武器升级会增加子弹列数，部分敌人和首领会在护甲、暴露及不同射击状态之间切换，需要抓住能造成伤害的时机。
records.en: Steer and fire through three combat stages, avoiding enemy barrages and defeating the final boss. Weapon upgrades add bullet columns, while armored enemies and the boss switch between protected, exposed and firing states that change the available attack windows.

evidence.locator: reference_observations R023, R027, R035–R037, R046–R047, R099–R116 and R117–R119

records.zh: 用吊车抓起、搬运和放下箱子，填平缺口或压住机关，为滚动的球接通出口路线。后续场景加入玻璃、传送带、定时闸门与爆炸箱，物体运动遵循固定的网格规则。
records.en: Use a crane to lift, move and drop crates, filling gaps or pressing switches to open a rolling ball’s route to the exit. Later scenes combine glass, conveyors, timed shutters and explosive crates within a deterministic grid simulation.

evidence.locator: reference_observations R001, R004, R011–R026, R041–R054 and R063–R096

records.zh: 控制指挥官带领部队，花费金币和木材建设、训练单位，再向敌方建筑发起进攻。不同地图要求占领神殿、插下旗帜或攻破红色要塞，同时还要应对来袭波次与补给容量限制。
records.en: Lead troops with a commander, spending gold and wood on construction and unit training before attacking enemy buildings. Maps introduce shrine control, banner placement and an assault on the red keep, alongside incoming waves and limits on army supply.

evidence.locator: reference_observations R001, R005, R017, R058, shrine capture, banner placement and keep victory

records.zh: 把不稳定能量电池带过浮空岛，在倒计时结束前送入信标，完成三关共十一枚电池的接力。途中可二段跳和下砸，踩中敌人会反弹并补充运送时间，但接触危险或坠落会扣除护盾。
records.en: Carry unstable cells across floating islands and deposit all eleven across three levels before their fuses expire. Jump, air-jump and stomp through moving hazards; stomping enemies adds delivery time, while collisions or falls cost shields.

evidence.locator: Appendix B.2, Beacon Relay task GDD: scope, controls, core mechanics and progression

records.zh: 驾驶飞机从跑道起飞，管理油门、姿态与燃油，寻找远处的检查点。抵达后需要降低速度并安全落地，再重新起飞返回起点；单纯飞过标记并不能完成这趟往返。
records.en: Take off from the airfield, managing throttle, attitude and fuel while searching for a distant checkpoint. Slow down for a safe landing there, then take off again and return to land at the starting field to complete the round trip.

evidence.locator: reference_observations R001–R008, R010–R060, R063–R117; GAMES.md bush_522 section

records.zh: 在三条林间桥道上奔跑，用换道、跳跃、滑行和路口转向避开箱子、栅栏等障碍。途中收集种子，并可取得磁吸或加速效果；碰撞会引来追击压力，需要撑过追逐继续前进。
records.en: Run along three woodland lanes, switching lanes, jumping, sliding and turning at junctions to avoid obstacles. Collect seeds and temporary magnet or boost effects; collisions trigger pursuit pressure, requiring continued movement until the threat subsides.

evidence.locator: reference_observations R001–R003, R030–R033, R051–R054, R060, RD024–RD040; GAMES.md canopy_dash section

records.zh: 根据标记寻找乘客，接上车后赶在车费计时结束前送到目的地。小地图显示街道连接，交通车辆会妨碍行驶；后续关卡扩大区域并提高送客数量，完成后结算车费与总接送次数。
records.en: Find marked passengers, pick them up and deliver them before the fare timer expires. A minimap shows connected streets while traffic obstructs the route; later levels expand the area and delivery quota before the shift totals fares and completed trips.

evidence.locator: reference_observations R001, R010, R012, R017–R032, R060–R104 and R119; GAMES.md citycab_rush section

records.zh: 深入六层自动化地下库，与把你视为入侵物的维护机器交战。沿途寻找两张门卡，打开服务通道和核心库区，最终击败监管者并操作出口联锁，逃离这座从内部封闭的设施。
records.en: Descend six floors of an automated data vault whose maintenance machines treat you as contamination. Find two keycards to open the service spine and core vault, defeat the Overseer, then operate the exit interlock to escape the sealed facility.

evidence.locator: GAMES.md deepgrid section; reference_observations opening objective and floor progression

records.zh: 在雪地空地寻找五件装饰，逐件搬回去装点雪人，再带同伴回到雪人旁完成差事。牵绳另一端的同伴会自主行动，绳子还会绕树缠结，需要在探索和搬运途中一起处理。
records.en: Search the snowy clearing for five decorations, carry them back to the snowman, then return with your companion to finish the errand. The leashed companion acts autonomously, and the rope can wrap around trees during exploration and carrying.

evidence.locator: reference_observations search/carry/return stages, Decorations 5/5, R114–R119; GAMES.md dogwalk section

records.zh: 从城镇补给区进入科幻战场，一边移动射击，一边收集敌人留下的金币。交战中要关注生命与弹药，升级后可分配强化；完成这一轮战斗目标后进入任务结算。
records.en: Enter the science-fiction battlefield from a town supply area, moving and shooting while collecting coins from defeated enemies. Watch health and ammunition, allocate upgrades after leveling up, and complete the combat objective to reach the mission results.

evidence.locator: reference_observations R002–R003, R008–R016, R030–R031 and R052–R059

records.zh: 在按节拍切换状态的世界里移动，收集水果并打开通往终点的门。状态变化会改变平台的实体性与火盆等危险，还可利用自己创建的地形安排路线，在切换窗口内完成通过。
records.en: Collect fruit to activate the goal while moving through a world that changes state on a beat. Platforms become solid or translucent and hazards change with the phase; player-created terrain provides additional ways to connect the route through those timed windows.

evidence.locator: reference_observations Grove AMBER/STEEL states, fruit quota and GATE ONLINE; GAMES.md pixel_platformer section

records.zh: 一人用两套按键控制火、水两名角色，穿过十个单屏房间，操作机关并安排彼此路线。角色能安全进入自己的元素，却会被另一种元素和腐蚀液杀死；两人必须同时站到各自出口才算完成。
records.en: Control both elemental characters with separate keys through ten puzzle chambers, using mechanisms to connect their routes. Each survives its own element but dies in the other’s or in corrosive fluid; both must stand at their own exits simultaneously.

evidence.locator: GAMES.md ember_and_tide section; reference_observations R001, R005–R006, R020, R023–R046 and R118–R119

records.zh: 穿过相连房间清除敌人，花金币购买枪械，并管理弹药和治疗物品。每层击败首领后进入传送门，向后续楼层推进；首领会切换战斗阶段，生命归零则清除本局临时进度。
records.en: Clear connected rooms, spend coins on weapons and manage ammunition and healing items. Defeat each floor’s boss and enter its portal to advance; bosses change combat phases, while losing all health ends the run and clears its temporary progress.

evidence.locator: GAMES.md gunfire_dungeon section; reference_observations R001–R017, R036–R065

records.zh: 购买种子、翻整土地并种植浇水，成熟后收获作物，再送到农场仓库出售。玉米与番茄等作物有不同的种植成本和照料时间，需要在限定天数内同时完成收入与作物销售目标。
records.en: Buy seeds, prepare plots, plant and water crops, then harvest and sell them at the farm depot. Crops such as corn and tomatoes differ in cost and care time, while each scenario sets revenue and crop-sales goals within a limited number of days.

evidence.locator: reference_observations R001–R010, R023–R024, R073, R104 and R116–R119

records.zh: 跑跳穿过八段障碍路线，利用检查点逐步抵达各段出口。后续区域加入冰面、贴墙、滑铲、水池、锯片与钥匙门，最后还要启动断路器；机关按固定规则运行，可根据周期安排通过时机。
records.en: Run and jump through eight hazard courses, using checkpoints to reach each exit. Later acts add ice, wall movement, slides, water, saws and key gates before a final circuit-breaker objective, with deterministic hazards allowing their cycles to be anticipated.

evidence.locator: reference_observations R001, R028–R043, R057–R060, R084–R106 and R118–R119; Table 6 deterministic course description

records.zh: 穿过林地接近蜂巢，惊动蜂群后向安全点逃跑，跳越路上的缺口。三段路线逐渐加长、坑隙也变宽，需要在追逐中维持距离，抵达各段安全点并最终回到安全处。
records.en: Run through the forest toward a hive, then escape the disturbed swarm by jumping gaps on the way to safety. Three stages lengthen the route and widen its pits, with each ending at a marked safe point.

evidence.locator: reference_observations R001–R009, R013–R015, R018–R049 and R030–R059

records.zh: 在 Junior Kitchen 中取用食材，准备沙拉、煎制牛排等餐食，再端盘送到客人身边。参考关卡要求在倒计时内上齐三道菜，得分和已交付数量随取料、烹饪与送餐过程变化。
records.en: Take ingredients, prepare dishes such as salad and steak, and carry the plates to customers in Junior Kitchen. The reference scenario requires three dishes before time runs out, tracking the score and delivered meals throughout preparation and service.

evidence.locator: reference_observations R001, R011, R018, R044, R056–R060, R081, R108 and RD046–RD060; GAMES.md hurry_curry section

records.zh: 扮演最后一位点灯人，提着逐渐衰弱的灯探索球形星球，寻找六座熄灭的信标。通过呼唤回应辨认路径，沿海岸、谷地和峰顶接近并点燃它们，全部完成后让世界迎来日出。
records.en: Carry a fading lantern as the last lamplighter on a spherical planet, searching for six dark beacons. Use calls and their responses to find paths through the coast, valley and summit; lighting the full set restores sunrise.

evidence.locator: GAMES.md kindle_relay section; reference_observations R001–R002, R010–R015, R038–R039 and R060–R074

records.zh: 控制忍者在明暗交替的场景中战斗，清除敌人并收集卷轴，连续通过三处殿堂。每个区域都有自己的敌人与收集目标，过关时还可选择赐福，为接下来的战斗提供不同强化。
records.en: Fight as a ninja through three chambers whose lighting alternates between lit and dark states, clearing enemies and collecting scrolls. Each chamber introduces its own opponents and collection target, with a choice of boons offering different benefits before continuing.

evidence.locator: reference_observations OUTER CLOISTER, DARK/WANE states, SCROLL 3/3, PILLAR HALL, TAKE A BOON and INNER SANCTUM

records.zh: 操控猫射击来敌，花金币部署、升级炮塔并修复路障，守住两条进攻路线。清完区块的敌人后道路开放，需要亲自穿过带火焰等危险的路段，到达旗帜再进入下一处防守。
records.en: Shoot approaching enemies, spend coins to deploy or upgrade turrets, and repair the barricade across two lanes. Clearing a sector opens the road, after which the cat must traverse hazards such as fire and reach the flag for the next defense.

evidence.locator: reference_observations R001–R017, R022–R031 and R043–R105; GAMES.md cat_defense section

records.zh: 驾驶货车同时处理多笔订单，在重叠的时间窗口内决定先取哪件、先送哪处。货物可能融化、易碎或过重，交通碰撞还会损伤车体；速度、刹车与路线安排都会影响准时送达。
records.en: Drive a delivery van while scheduling multiple orders with overlapping time windows. Cargo can melt, break under late braking or add heavy weight, while traffic collisions damage the van, linking the next delivery choice with speed, braking and route planning.

evidence.locator: GAMES.md city_delivery section; reference_observations R001–R007, R021–R022, R032–R082 and R114–R116

records.zh: 驾驶机体进入敌对设施，射击敌人、补充弹药并利用护盾抵挡伤害。三个区域各有需要取得的节点钥匙，完成节点上传后开启升降撤离通道，最终集齐三把钥匙离开设施。
records.en: Pilot a machine through a hostile facility, shooting enemies and managing ammunition, hull health and shields. Secure node keys across three sectors and complete uploads to activate their lifts, then extract after collecting all three keys.

evidence.locator: reference_observations R001, R007–R033, R060, R067 and R109–R118

records.zh: 依次穿过庭院、管道、工业区与农场四个房间，找到钥匙、开门并抵达旗帜。路线包含尖刺、蝙蝠、传送带和升降结构，金币与宝石分布在途中，需要在跳跃与机关移动间选择落点。
records.en: Find keys, open doors and reach flags across four rooms themed around a yard, pipeworks, ironworks and a farm. Spikes, bats, conveyors and lifting structures interrupt the route, with coins and gems placed along the platforming paths.

evidence.locator: reference_observations R001–R004, R010–R017, R020–R026 and RD030–RD038

records.zh: 潜入警卫把守的设施，寻找装有病毒的存储器和门卡，逐步接近主服务器。可蹲下减少噪音、利用箱子遮掩并等待守卫经过，最后对服务器实施破坏；被警卫发现会面临枪击。
records.en: Infiltrate a guarded facility, find a virus drive and keycard, and work toward the main server. Crouch to reduce noise, shelter behind crates and wait for guards to pass before sabotaging the server; being spotted exposes the intruder to gunfire.

evidence.locator: reference_observations welcome-wall objective, virus pickup, guard warning, keycard pickup, crate concealment and facility-breach ending

records.zh: 按 D、F、J、K 对应的四条轨道击中下落音符，并处理需要持续按住的长音。三首关卡逐步增加音符数量与组合，失误会消耗生命，结算同时记录得分、准确率和漏击数。
records.en: Hit falling notes on four lanes using D, F, J and K, including long notes that require sustained inputs. Three stages expand the note patterns; misses cost life, while the results record score, accuracy and missed notes.

evidence.locator: reference_observations FIRST LIGHT, CROSSWIND sustain notes, LATTICE, LIFE/MISS changes and three-stage results

records.zh: 在三层地牢清除怪物、寻找钥匙并开箱，把每层遗物搬到对应祭坛。角色手中会显示当前携带的钥匙或遗物，后续楼层要求更多钥匙，搬运途中还要躲开会损耗生命的战斗。
records.en: Clear monsters, find keys and open chests across three dungeon levels, carrying each relic to its altar. The carried key or relic is shown above the character, and later floors require more keys while enemies threaten health during the deliveries.

evidence.locator: reference_observations R001–R009, Carrying Relic, Level 2, Level 3, Key-C and Run Complete

records.zh: 以第一人称在沙地与室内区域抵挡亡灵波次，射击、装填并购买战斗升级。清除一段攻势后通路开启，继续进入下一处场景；弹药和生命会持续受到来敌压力，需要设法撑到胜利。
records.en: Fight waves of undead across outdoor sand and indoor spaces, reloading weapons and buying combat upgrades. Clearing the first area opens the way onward, while later waves continue to pressure health and ammunition until the run is won.

evidence.locator: reference_observations outdoor WAVE 1–3, purchase currency changes, reloads, THE WAY IS OPEN, indoor waves and SUCCESS

records.zh: 在废料竞技场中移动射击，切换不同武器并管理弹药与武器热量。清除进攻波次后到撤离垫上坚守，敌人仍会来袭，需要在交火中维持撤离进度，最终离开三处场地。
records.en: Move and shoot through scrapyard arenas, switching between repeater and breacher weapons while managing ammunition and heat. After clearing the initial pushes, hold the extraction pad under continuing attacks, maintaining evacuation progress to complete the three-arena run.

evidence.locator: reference_observations R001–R018, HOLD THE PAD FOR 12S, R047–R112 and EXTRACTION COMPLETE

records.zh: 操控没有武器的潜入者避开守卫视野，取走宝箱后再前往出口。三个场景从单守卫庭院扩展到多守卫的墙隙和柱廊，需要借助遮挡与等待穿过巡逻路线，无法通过战斗清除守卫。
records.en: Move an unarmed infiltrator past guards, take the treasure chest and then reach the exit. Three scenes expand from a single-guard courtyard to wall gaps and pillared corridors with several patrols, using cover and waiting without a combat option.

evidence.locator: reference_observations three-level routes, chest/exit transition, waiting for patrol and spatial progression; GAMES.md shadow_walker section

records.zh: 控制法国队的一名场上球员，抢断、传球并射门，把球送进实际球门区域得分。参考内容包含八支国家队和三轮淘汰赛，每场限时两分钟；进球后重新开球，比赛结束保留最终比分。
records.en: Control one French outfield player, tackling, passing and shooting into the goal to score. The reference content includes eight national teams and a three-round knockout tournament with two-minute matches; goals trigger a restart before play continues toward the final score.

evidence.locator: GAMES.md soccer_course section; reference_observations opening match, goals, kickoffs and final victory

records.zh: 在田地与商店之间生产、搬运和出售货物，及时为排队顾客服务。八个营业班次各有收入目标，顾客久等会离开；班次之间可花金币购买升级，扩大经营并控制累计流失人数。
records.en: Produce goods, carry them between field and shop, and serve waiting customers before they walk out. Eight shifts set increasing revenue quotas, with a build phase between shifts for spending coins on upgrades and a limit on accumulated customer departures.

evidence.locator: reference_observations SHIFT 1/8, WALKOUTS 0/12, BUILD PHASE upgrades, quotas, customer queue and MARKET THRIVING

records.zh: 扮演骑士在未知地牢中寻找出口，用剑对付怪物，拾取金币、战利品与恢复物品。连续深入四层时生命会随交战减少，需要在探索宝物和保留生存余量之间取舍，最终带着战利品通关。
records.en: Guide a knight through an unfamiliar dungeon, using a sword against monsters and collecting coins, loot and restorative items. Find exits through four floors while health is depleted by combat, balancing further exploration against reaching the end alive with the treasure.

evidence.locator: GAMES.md super_dungeon_delve section; reference_observations floor depths, sword attacks, loot, health changes and Dungeon Cleared

records.zh: 破坏和放置体素方块，先伐木制作木板、木杆与工作台，再开采矿脉组装神器。指定种子的制作路线共有七步，最终把神器安放到基座；探索地下时还要留意光照与潜伏生物。
records.en: Break and place voxel blocks, cutting wood for planks, rods and a forge bench before mining ore to assemble an artifact. The seeded objective has seven steps ending at its pedestal, with light and lurking creatures affecting underground exploration.

evidence.locator: reference_observations STEP 1–7, crafting prompts, DARK warning, artifact pedestal and ARTIFACT FORGED

records.zh: 在三层地牢寻找钥匙、打开封闭通道，并用战斗清出通往楼梯的路线。途中可收集余烬碎片和恢复生命的物品，从蓄水池逐步进入档案室与圣所，最终经楼梯逃离。
records.en: Find keys, unlock passages and fight toward the stairs across three dungeon floors. Collect ember shards and health pickups while moving from the cistern through the flooded archive and sanctum, then escape through the final stairway.

evidence.locator: reference_observations FLOOR 1–3, ward keys, hearts, ember shards, stair shrine and ESCAPED ending

records.zh: 在六角格地图上建设矿场、伐木场与水井，逐回合获得金币、木材和食物，对抗按脚本行动的敌方势力。不同关卡可要求达到产出目标或攻下城堡，人口、粮食消耗与回合上限共同限制扩张。
records.en: Build mines, lumbermills and wells on a hex map to generate gold, wood and food each turn against a scripted rival. Scenario goals include production targets or capturing a castle, with population, food upkeep and round limits constraining expansion.

evidence.locator: reference_observations starting resources, opponent Mine, Lumbermill/Well construction, food upkeep and Level 1–3 goals

records.zh: 利用助跑、跳跃、贴墙、滑铲和下砸穿过十四段平台路线，衔接弹跳垫与移动平台。尖刺等机关按固定规则运行；死亡后立即回到检查点，但整趟流程共用三十次死亡预算。
records.en: Use run-ups, jumps, wall movement, slides and stomps across fourteen platforming sections, linking springboards and moving platforms. Hazards follow fixed rules; death respawns the character at the last checkpoint while consuming a shared allowance of thirty deaths for the run.

evidence.locator: GAMES.md vaultline section; reference_observations FOOTING–VAULTLINE, death 1/30, springboard, stomp and moving platform

records.zh: 操控底部球拍与上方对手回球，击碎中间的砖墙并设法让球越过对手得分。可选择回球方向和扣杀时机，挥空会短暂锁定；三盘采用不同砖墙，后续还会落下碎片和金币。
records.en: Return the ball with a paddle, break the wall between opponents and score by sending the ball past the rival. Aim returns and time spikes while avoiding a whiff lockout; three sets change the bricks and add falling shards and coins.

evidence.locator: reference_observations SET 1–3, SERVE/AIM, SPIKE, WHIFFED-LOCKED, SHARD FALL and run results

records.zh: 用手电探索地下墓穴，在有限时间内依次启动两台发电机、解开控制台谜题，再寻找两把钥匙。钥匙收齐后出口才会启用，玩家需要穿过原场景中的走廊和装置区前往撤离点。
records.en: Explore the catacombs with a flashlight, activating two generators, solving a control-panel puzzle and finding two keys before time expires. Collecting both keys arms the exit, opening the final objective of navigating back through the corridors to escape.

evidence.locator: reference_observations INTRO timer, GENERATORS, PUZZLE, KEYS, EXIT_ARMED and EXIT REACHED; catalog.json catacombs slice scope

records.zh: 操控法师在五张越来越危险的迷宫中收集金币，收齐当前房间的金币才会打开出口。四类敌人和两类定时机关阻挡路线，法师有一种防御法术可用，连续通过五个房间即可获胜。
records.en: Guide a wizard through five increasingly hostile mazes, collecting every coin in a room to open its exit. Four enemy types and two timed-hazard families obstruct the route, with one defensive spell available; clearing all five rooms wins the run.

evidence.locator: GAMES.md wizard_chase section; reference_observations coin depletion, room transitions and DUNGEON CLEARED

records.zh: 玩家扮演王子 Theo，在固定场景之间移动，通过观察、打开和敲击等命令调查物品与环境。冒险同时包含武器和法术战斗，需要把探索所得用于破解障碍，逐步寻找解救王国的道路。
records.en: As Prince Theo, move between fixed scenes and investigate with commands such as look, open and hit. Fight using weapons and magic while putting discoveries to use against environmental obstacles, connecting investigation with the journey to find a way to save the kingdom.

records.zh: 玩家扮演 Theo 寻回失窃的希望之剑，探索各地并招募同伴，组成三人队伍。冒险中需要协调各成员的行动应对战斗，同时继续寻找推进旅程的道路与线索，让队伍成长支持后续挑战。
records.en: Play Theo on a journey to recover the stolen Sword of Hope, exploring places and recruiting companions for a three-person party. Coordinate the group's actions in combat while continuing to find routes and clues that move the adventure toward its objective.

records.zh: 玩家从棋盘边缘发射激光，根据光束被吸收、反射或从另一位置射出的结果，推断隐藏球的位置。球会按相邻关系改变光路，需要把多次探测的反馈合并起来，再提交整组位置猜测。
records.en: Fire lasers from the edges of a hidden arena and infer where balls are placed. Beams may be absorbed, reflected or deflected to another exit, so locating the whole set requires combining several entry-and-exit observations before submitting a proposed arrangement.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家在带数字的岛之间画水平或竖直桥梁，使每座岛接到的桥数等于标记。默认同一对岛最多连接两座平行桥，桥梁不能交叉，所有岛还必须属于同一连通网络，不能各自成组。
records.en: Draw horizontal or vertical bridges between numbered islands, matching the number at every island. Under the default rules, at most two parallel bridges join a pair; bridges cannot cross, and every island must belong to the same connected network when the puzzle is complete.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家让立方体滚到相邻格子，每次接触时，底面与地格会交换颜色。目标是把六个蓝色地格转移到立方体六个面上，已染蓝的面也可能把颜色放回地面，因此路线需要兼顾位置和朝向。
records.en: Roll a cube between neighboring squares, swapping the colors of its contacting face and the ground at each move. Collect all six blue squares onto the cube's faces at once, remembering that a blue face can also deposit its color back onto the board.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家把相邻的两格数字划成一枚骨牌，重建覆盖整张网格的骨牌排列。每一种无序数字组合只能使用一次，需要让所有格子成对，并让整套骨牌中的数字组合各出现一次。
records.en: Pair adjacent numbered cells into dominoes to reconstruct a covering of the entire grid. Every unordered number pair must occur exactly once, so choosing a local pair also affects which combinations remain available for completing the uncovered cells elsewhere on the board.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家利用唯一空格滑动相邻数字块，在默认 4×4 棋盘上恢复从一到十五的顺序，并让空格留在右下角。每次只能借空位调换相邻位置，整理局部时还要避免破坏已经排好的行列。
records.en: Slide numbered tiles into the single empty space to restore numerical order, leaving the gap at the bottom right. On the default four-by-four board, moving one tile also relocates the gap, so arranging a row changes the moves available to organize the others.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家为网格空白处填数字，使相同数字按上下左右连接成区域，区域格数恰好等于该数字。对角接触不算相连，两个同数区域一旦相接就会合并，因此填数时需要同时控制区域大小与边界。
records.en: Fill empty cells with digits so each orthogonally connected region of equal digits has exactly that many cells. Diagonal contact does not join regions, while touching matching digits do merge, so every placement affects both a region's size and where its boundary can lie.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家点击格子，使它和图示指定的邻格同时在明暗之间翻转，目标是让全部格子同时亮起。不同格子的联动范围由小图标说明，需要安排一组互相配合的翻转，避免修好一处又熄灭其他格。
records.en: Click a square to toggle it together with the neighboring squares indicated by its small diagram. Light every square simultaneously, combining the different toggle patterns into a sequence whose effects leave the whole grid in the lit state.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家反复为左上角连通区域选择新颜色，把同色相邻格逐步并入这一区域。目标是在规定步数内让整张棋盘成为同一颜色，需要比较不同换色能接入的区域，避免把步数浪费在狭小分支。
records.en: Change the color of the region connected to the top-left square, absorbing adjacent areas of the chosen color. Make the whole board one color within the move limit, comparing which choices expand the connected area before spending another of the available moves.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家沿格边画线，把整张棋盘划成若干连通区域，每区恰好包含一个给定圆点。区域必须以该圆点为中心旋转一百八十度后保持一致，需要把中心两侧的格子成对安排，并让所有区域共同铺满棋盘。
records.en: Draw boundaries along cell edges to divide the board into connected regions, each containing exactly one marked dot. Every region must have half-turn symmetry around its dot, so adding cells on one side also constrains the matching cells required on the other.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家提交一组有顺序的彩色棋子，猜测电脑隐藏的颜色密码。反馈分别标出颜色和位置都正确、以及颜色正确但位置错误的数量，需要在限定猜测次数内利用这些信息缩小可能排列。
records.en: Submit ordered sequences of colored pegs to discover a hidden code within a limited number of guesses. Feedback separates colors in the correct positions from correct colors placed elsewhere, allowing each attempt to narrow the remaining combinations before the next sequence is chosen.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家选择方向让小球直线滑行，直到碰到墙壁或停止格，沿途收集宝石。宝石不会让球停下，地雷则会直接结束游戏，即使同一步已取得最后一颗宝石也不能获胜，必须先判断整段滑行轨迹。
records.en: Send a ball sliding in an orthogonal or diagonal direction until a wall or stopping square halts it. Collect every gem without touching mines; gems do not stop motion, and even collecting the last one does not save a move that ends in a mine.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家在方格内填入数字，使每行每列都不重复，并让每个标记区域满足给定算式。加减乘除提示限制同区数字的组合，既要核对运算结果，也要检查这些数字放入行列后是否造成重复。
records.en: Fill a grid with digits that appear only once in each row and column while satisfying the arithmetic clue in every cage. Addition, subtraction, multiplication or division restricts each group, so valid totals must also fit the row-and-column arrangement around them.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家在白格放灯泡，让光线沿横竖方向传播，直到被黑格阻挡，最终照亮全部白格。带数字黑格周围的灯泡数必须吻合提示，且任何两盏灯不能相互照射，需要同时满足照明和相邻计数。
records.en: Place bulbs to illuminate every white cell along horizontal and vertical lines, with black cells blocking the light. Numbered black cells require an exact count of adjacent bulbs, and no bulb may shine on another, linking full coverage with local placement constraints.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家沿允许连接的网格边画线，把它们组成一条连续闭合回路。数字表示围绕该区域的边中有多少条属于回路，所有提示必须同时满足；线不能分裂成多个独立小圈来分别完成局部要求。
records.en: Select grid edges to form one continuous closed loop. A number specifies how many of the edges surrounding its area belong to that loop, linking each local count to the shape of the single complete route that satisfies all the clues together.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家在双格骨牌位置放置正负磁极，或把整枚骨牌留为空白，满足行列的正负极数量提示。相同磁极不能上下左右相邻，空白端不受此限，因此要同时安排磁铁朝向与哪些位置不放磁铁。
records.en: Assign positive and negative ends to domino-shaped magnets, or leave a domino neutral, to match the row and column counts. Like poles cannot touch orthogonally, while neutral ends can, so solving the board requires choosing both magnet positions and their orientations.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家用四种颜色给地图区域着色，使共享一段边界的相邻区域颜色不同。部分颜色已经给定且不能修改，只在一个点上接触的区域可以同色，需要依据真正的边界关系完成其余区域。
records.en: Color map regions with four colors so any two sharing a length of boundary have different colors. Some regions are fixed clues that cannot be changed, while regions touching at only one point may match, making border relationships the basis for the remaining choices.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家依据已翻开格子的周边雷数标记危险位置，并翻开所有不含地雷的格子，点到地雷便失败。此版本默认生成可由逻辑推断完成的棋盘，目标是结合重叠数字信息逐步确定安全格，而非依赖最后猜测。
records.en: Use the adjacent mine counts revealed by opened cells to identify hazards and uncover every safe square. Opening a mine loses the game; by default, this version generates boards that can be solved through deduction rather than forcing a final guess between indistinguishable cells.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家把格子涂成黑色或白色，使每个数字等于其周围 3×3 范围内的黑格总数，数字所在格也计入。相邻提示的统计区域会重叠，同一格可能被多条提示计数，玩家据此共同确定各格颜色。
records.en: Color cells black or white so each clue equals the black-cell count in its surrounding three-by-three area, including the clue's own cell. Neighboring clue areas overlap, with shared cells contributing to several counts that must all hold at once.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家旋转各格里的线段，让打乱的管网重新接通。完成时所有格子必须接入同一个没有闭环的网络，与中央格连通的部分会高亮显示；旋转某一格也会改变其周围线段能否继续相接。
records.en: Rotate tiles to restore a scrambled network, joining every tile into one connected structure without closed loops. Tiles linked to the central tile are highlighted, helping track connectivity while each rotation changes how that tile can connect to the pieces beside it.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家通过整体滑动一行或一列来恢复被打乱的管网，越过边缘的格子会从另一侧回到该行或列。与直接旋转单格不同，一次操作会同时移动多个线段，需要协调各行列的位移才能重新接通网络。
records.en: Slide complete rows or columns to restore a scrambled network, with tiles wrapping from one edge to the other. Unlike rotating an individual tile, each move relocates several pieces together, so reconnecting one part of the network can alter alignments elsewhere on the board.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家沿格边画围栏，把棋盘分成面积相等的连通区域。数字提示规定该格周围必须有多少条边界，棋盘外边缘也计入；需要让局部围栏数量与整片区域的面积限制同时成立。
records.en: Draw fences along cell edges to divide the board into connected regions of the same specified size. Numbered cells require an exact count of bordering edges, including the outer boundary, so local fence placements must still allow every completed region to have the right area.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家依据每行每列给出的黑格连续段长度，把全部格子确定为黑或白。提示的顺序决定各段排列，需要让横向和纵向约束相互吻合；此版本自动生成图案，完成后不一定呈现可辨认的物体。
records.en: Fill every cell black or white using the ordered run lengths beside each row and above each column. Horizontal and vertical clues must agree on shared cells; because this version generates puzzles automatically, a completed pattern need not depict a recognizable picture.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家画一条经过全部黑白圆点的闭合回路。黑点处必须转弯且前后相邻路径都直行；白点处必须直行，但前后至少一处要转弯，需要同时处理圆点所在格与其连接方向上的邻格。
records.en: Draw a single closed loop through the black and white pearls. Turn at a black pearl but go straight immediately before and after it; pass straight through a white pearl while turning on at least one neighboring square along the loop.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家让棋子横向或纵向跳过相邻棋子，落入其后的空洞，并移除被跳过的一枚。目标是最后只剩一枚棋子，每次消除也会改变可跳的组合，需要保留后续能继续相互跨越的位置。
records.en: Jump a peg horizontally or vertically over an adjacent peg into an empty hole, removing the jumped piece. Finish with just one peg, choosing jumps that leave usable arrangements for later removals as each removal changes which neighboring pegs can still jump into an empty hole.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家把部分格子涂黑，使每个数字沿横竖方向能看到的白格总数与提示一致，数字格本身也计入。数字不能涂黑，黑格不能直接相邻，所有白格还须连通，因此遮挡视线不能把白色区域切断。
records.en: Shade cells so each number sees the required total of white cells along straight horizontal and vertical lines, counting itself once. Numbered cells remain white, black cells cannot touch orthogonally, and all white cells must stay connected while these sight-line counts are satisfied.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家把网格划分成互不重叠的矩形，每个矩形恰好包含一个数字，面积等于该数字。需要根据数字的位置选择矩形的长宽，让所有矩形共同铺满棋盘，不能留下空格或把两条提示圈进同一区域。
records.en: Partition the whole grid into rectangles, each containing exactly one numbered cell and having an area equal to that number. Choose the dimensions around each clue so the pieces cover the board without overlap, gaps or a rectangle containing more than one clue.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家点击相连的同色方块群将其移除，剩余方块会下落，空出的列也会合拢。目标是尽量清空棋盘，需要考虑消除后颜色如何重新相邻，避免最后留下无法组成可消除群组的零散方块。
records.en: Remove connected groups of matching blocks, letting the remaining blocks fall and empty columns close up. Aim to clear the board by considering how each removal rearranges later groups, and whether the new arrangement contains another removable cluster.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家按各格箭头指向建立连接，把全部格子串成从一到终点的连续数字序列。下一格可以位于箭头方向上的远处，而不一定紧邻，需要结合已给数字确定连接次序，确保整条序列没有遗漏或分支。
records.en: Link cells in the directions shown by their arrows to form one consecutive sequence through the entire grid. A successor can lie at any distance along the indicated line, so fixed numbers help determine which links make a complete uninterrupted chain.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家涂黑部分数字，让每行每列剩下的数字都不重复。黑格不能上下左右相邻，所有白格必须连成一片，因此删除重复值时不能一味多涂，还要为棋盘其他位置保留连通路径。
records.en: Shade selected numbers so no unshaded value repeats in any row or column. Black cells cannot touch horizontally or vertically, and all remaining white cells must form one connected region, so removing duplicates must also preserve a route through the unshaded board.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家整体推动数字棋盘的一行或一列，移出边缘的方块从另一端返回。目标是把数字恢复为规定顺序；棋盘没有空格，一次调整会影响整行或整列，需要通过多次循环位移协调位置。
records.en: Shift an entire row or column, wrapping the tile pushed off one edge back onto the other. Restore the numbers to their target order on a board with no empty square, coordinating several shifts because every move changes more than one tile's position.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家为每格选择一条左斜或右斜对角线，让带数字顶点连接的线数恰好符合提示。所有线段都不能形成闭环，需要在满足局部计数的同时检查远处已连起的路径，避免最终围成一圈。
records.en: Place one of two diagonal orientations in every cell, matching the number of lines meeting each numbered vertex. The lines must never form a cycle, so a locally valid diagonal still needs to fit the wider network without closing a loop.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家根据预填数字补全方格，使每行、每列和每个指定宫格中的数字都不重复。默认是九宫格数独，也可配置不同宫形或附加规则；填写时需要同时核对所在行、列与区域的可用数字。
records.en: Complete the grid from its given digits so each row, column and designated block contains every required value once. The default is a nine-by-nine Sudoku, while configurable layouts and variants alter the regions or add constraints that each placement must also respect.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家在每棵树的上下左右安排一顶对应帐篷，使行列中的帐篷数量符合边缘提示。任意两顶帐篷连对角也不能接触，需要在树木配对、计数和间隔限制之间找到同一套放置方案。
records.en: Place one tent for each tree on an orthogonally adjacent square, matching the tent counts for every row and column. No two tents may touch, even diagonally, so each tree's pairing must fit both the spacing restrictions and the counts around the board.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家在每格填楼高，使每行每列包含全部高度且不重复。边缘数字表示从该方向能看到几栋楼，矮楼会被前方高楼遮住，需要结合不同视线的可见数量确定同一行列中的排列。
records.en: Fill each row and column with every tower height once, then satisfy the visibility clues around the edges. Taller towers hide shorter ones behind them, so a valid arrangement must produce the correct number of visible buildings from each indicated direction.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家把已有轨道补成从 A 到 B 的一条铁路，并满足每行每列规定的轨道格数。轨道只有直行与直角转弯，不能自交，需要在确定走向时兼顾计数，避免走出一条无法接到终点的路线。
records.en: Complete a railway from A to B while matching the required number of track cells in every row and column. Only straight and right-angle pieces are available, and the route cannot cross itself, so each turn must fit both the counts and a continuous path.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家旋转选中的小方块区域，带动其中所有数字同时换位，逐步恢复升序排列。基本模式每次旋转 2×2 四格，也可选择更大的区域；整理一格会连带移动周围数字，需要安排一系列旋转。
records.en: Rotate a square group of tiles to restore the board's numbers to ascending order. The basic move turns a two-by-two block, with larger blocks available in other settings, so positioning one number also rearranges its neighbors and affects the next rotation.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家在镜面之间放置幽灵、吸血鬼和僵尸，满足边缘视线所见的怪物数量及各类总数。幽灵只在镜中可见，吸血鬼只可直接看见，僵尸两种情况下都可见，需要沿折射视线逐段核对。
records.en: Place ghosts, vampires and zombies among mirrors to satisfy the edge sight-line counts and each monster's total. Ghosts are visible only in reflections, vampires only directly, and zombies both ways, so following a line around mirrors changes which occupied cells are counted.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家填入每行每列不重复的数字，并满足相邻格之间标出的大小关系。默认模式使用大于号提示，还可切换到相邻数模式；格间比较与行列取值共同限制每个空格中的数字。
records.en: Fill each row and column without repeating a digit, satisfying the signs between neighboring cells. The default mode uses greater-than clues, while an alternative marks consecutive values, so each local relation must also fit the complete row-and-column arrangement being constructed.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家把未定格子填为黑或白，使每行每列两种颜色数量相等，并且横竖都不能出现连续三个同色格。部分颜色已作为线索给出，需要在这些固定位置之间完成其余格子，兼顾数量和连续性。
records.en: Fill the remaining cells black or white so each row and column contains equal numbers of both colors. No row or column may contain three consecutive cells of one color, so the supplied clues constrain both the totals and the patterns between them.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家拖动图中的顶点，改变与之相连的线段位置，目标是让所有连线互不交叉。顶点之间的连接关系保持不变，只能重新安排布局；移动一处可能同时解除或制造多条交叉，需要逐步整理整张图。
records.en: Drag the graph's vertices to new positions until none of its connecting lines cross. Connections stay attached to their original vertices, so moving a point changes several edges at once and can remove one crossing while creating another elsewhere in the layout.

evidence.locator: Official puzzle manual: chapter introduction, rules and controls

records.zh: 玩家从九种职业中选择角色，与队友完成夺旗、控制点或护送载具等地图目标。不同职业承担的作用互补，需要让火力、移动和支援围绕当前目标配合，随战线变化调整自己的位置。
records.en: Choose from nine classes and work with teammates on flag capture, control points or payload escort. Combine the classes' roles around the current map objective, adjusting position, firepower and support as the front line moves.

records.zh: 角色会自动向前奔跑，玩家负责转弯、跳跃、滑行和切换路线，避开陷阱并收集沿途金币。连续障碍要求提前观察，把当前操作与下一次反应衔接起来，尽量让奔跑持续下去。
records.en: The character runs forward automatically while you turn, jump, slide and change lanes to avoid traps and collect coins. Successive obstacles require linked responses that keep the character on a usable route through the run.

records.zh: 玩家旋转和摆放不同形状的下落方块，填满水平行使其消除，并避免堆到顶部。每次放置都会改变后续空隙，需要在当前得分与保持可整理的堆叠之间取舍，为接下来的方块留下空间。
records.en: Rotate and place falling shapes to complete horizontal lines and clear them before the stack reaches the top. Each placement changes the gaps available later, so balance an immediate clear against preserving a manageable surface and space for the pieces that follow.

records.zh: 玩家结合两张底牌与逐步公开的公共牌，选择过牌、下注、跟注、加注或弃牌以争夺底池。随着牌面和下注变化，需要重新估计自己与对手的牌力；具体下注额度遵循所用的德州扑克规则。
records.en: Combine two private cards with the community cards, choosing checks, bets, calls, raises or folds to contest the pot. Reassess your hand and the opponent's possible holdings as cards and wagers appear, following the selected hold'em rules for the amounts that can be bet.

records.zh: 玩家阅读房间和物品描述，通过文字命令探索、拾取物品、操作开关或组合对象。可配置目标将这些交互连成不同任务，部分目标需要先完成若干前置步骤，再执行最终操作。
records.en: Read descriptions of rooms and objects, then explore, collect items and interact through text commands. Configured goals connect the available objects and actions into tasks that can require several steps in a particular order.

records.zh: 玩家利用房间之间的连接信息寻找目标位置，并按要求完成物品取放。需要把地图关系与实际移动相对应，判断接下来该进入哪个房间，再让找到路线与完成目标操作衔接起来。
records.en: Use the connections between rooms to reach a target location and carry out the required object pickup or placement. Match the map relationships to actual movement, selecting the next room while ensuring that finding the route also leads to completing the requested interaction.

records.zh: 玩家查看三到五个物体的量值，并按指定升序或降序将它们放入盒子。需要先比较大小、确定整组顺序，再依次执行取放，避免只处理眼前一个物体却打乱已经形成的排列。
records.en: Inspect the quantities attached to three to five objects and place them in boxes in the requested order. Compare the values to establish the sequence, then carry out the pickups and placements that produce the required arrangement.

records.zh: 玩家在房间中寻找散放物品，将它们收集起来并送回通常存放的位置。物品用途提示可能的目的地，搜索与搬运把发现地点和归属位置连接起来，逐步完成整理。
records.en: Search for scattered objects, collect them and return each to its usual location. The objects' uses help identify their destinations, with exploration and transport linking the places where they are found to where they belong.

records.zh: 玩家在巨型都市中执行任务，用枪械、掩体和增强技能应对不同敌人，并收集战利品升级装备。前进时需要让站位与攻击方式相配合，再用新获得的资源调整准备，继续处理后续遭遇。
records.en: Carry out missions in a vast city, combining guns, cover and augmentations to deal with enemies. Collect loot and upgrade equipment between encounters, connecting positioning and attacks with the resources gained so that preparation continues to evolve as the journey moves onward.

records.zh: 玩家在暴风雨中的墓穴醒来，通过文字探索墓地与废弃教堂，检查物品和线索。目标是弄清自己的处境并脱离危险，需要把不同场景中的发现联系起来，为后续行动找到可行的办法。
records.en: Awaken in a tomb during a storm and explore the graveyard and abandoned church through text. Examine objects and clues to understand the situation, connecting discoveries across locations to find actions that can move you toward escape from the surrounding danger.

records.zh: 玩家轮流落子，争取形成规定连线，并阻止对方完成自己的连线。不同变体的棋盘大小、连线要求和落子限制，会改变进攻威胁与防守回应的组合方式。
records.en: Take turns placing marks to complete the required line while blocking the opponent. The current variant defines the board, line length and placement restrictions, which shape how attacking threats and defensive replies fit together.

records.zh: 玩家把圆盘从一根柱子移到目标柱，每次只能拿走最上面的一片，并且大盘不能放在小盘上。需要借助其余柱子临时周转，让局部移动服从整叠迁移的顺序，避免为了空出一盘而堵住后续步骤。
records.en: Move a stack of discs to the target peg, taking only the uppermost disc and never placing a larger one on a smaller one. Use the other pegs for temporary arrangements, ordering local moves so that they support transferring the entire stack.

records.zh: 玩家建造、升级防御设施，并调遣单位阻止敌人沿路线抵达基地。敌方推进压力决定防线何处需要补强，建设投入与现场调遣一起延缓或消灭正在接近的威胁。
records.en: Build and upgrade defenses and direct units to stop enemies from reaching the base. The route and pressure on the defensive line shape where reinforcements are needed, connecting construction spending with the threats currently advancing.

records.zh: 玩家在设计精确的赛道上控制转向、加速和漂移，以尽可能短的时间完成路线。反复尝试中可以比较入弯位置和速度衔接，逐段修正操作，让局部改进真正转化为更快的完整成绩。
records.en: Steer, accelerate and drift through precisely designed tracks to complete the route as quickly as possible. Repeated attempts let you compare corner entries and the flow between sections, refining local choices so that they improve the time of the complete run.

records.zh: 双方放置柱子，并在骑士步距离的己方柱子之间搭桥，争取连接属于自己的两条对边。桥不能与既有连线交叉，需要预留可继续延伸的位置，在构建通路时也阻断对手的连接机会。
records.en: Place posts and link your own posts at knight-move distances, trying to connect your assigned opposite edges. Bridges cannot cross existing links, so preserve useful extensions while building the route and considering where a placement can obstruct the opponent's connection.

records.zh: 玩家反复从两个选项中选择，观察获得的回报，逐步了解各选项的收益情况。尝试较少使用的选项可能补充信息，继续选择已知较好的选项则争取眼前收益，需要随新反馈调整分配。
records.en: Repeatedly choose between two options and observe the rewards to learn about their returns. Trying a less-used option may provide useful information, while selecting the currently better one pursues an immediate payoff, requiring the balance to change as new outcomes arrive.

records.zh: 九个小棋盘组成一个大棋盘，玩家在小棋盘内落子，而落子位置会指定对手下一步进入哪一盘。赢下小盘后还要争取大盘连线，需要把局部攻防与送给对手的下一处机会一起考虑。
records.en: Play within nine small boards arranged as one larger board, with each move determining the small board the opponent must enter next. Win local boards to pursue a line on the larger one, weighing a local threat against the destination your move gives away.

records.zh: 多数玩家持有相同词语，少数人拿到近义词或空白身份，通过轮流描述和投票寻找异类。描述需要说明自己理解的词，又不能过于直接泄露答案；玩家再根据差异判断谁可能不在同一阵营。
records.en: Most players receive the same word, while others hold a related word or a blank identity, and everyone describes it before voting. Explain enough to appear consistent without giving the answer away, then compare differences to judge who may be working from another word.

records.zh: 玩家根据隐藏手牌、公开牌面和下注历史选择跟注、加注或弃牌，目标是在具体规则下赢取底池。Universal Poker 用可配置规则表达不同牌局，因此牌组、回合和下注范围需要按当前配置理解，不能假定固定变体。
records.en: Use private cards, public information and betting history to call, raise or fold while seeking the pot. Universal Poker expresses configurable poker rules, with the chosen deck, rounds and betting limits defining the play of each setup.

records.zh: 玩家按颜色或数字匹配上一张牌，借助功能牌改变出牌节奏，争取率先清空手牌。需要根据手中可用牌决定保留和打出的顺序，既推进自己的出牌，也应对其他玩家造成的行动变化。
records.en: Match the previous card by color or number and use action cards to change the flow of play. Try to empty your hand first, choosing what to keep and what to play while responding to the changes other players introduce into the sequence.

records.zh: 玩家采集材料、制作工具并建造营地，航海探索不同生态区，寻找更进一步的资源。挑战首领会推动装备与资源获取，需要把外出探索、基地准备和战斗安排连接起来，逐步拓展能够应对的区域。
records.en: Gather materials, craft tools and build a camp before sailing to explore different biomes. Boss challenges advance access to equipment and resources, connecting expeditions and preparation at the base with the fights that allow the journey to extend into new areas.

records.zh: 攻守双方安排回合经济，利用枪械和角色技能争夺爆能器的安放与拆除目标。队伍协调路线、敌情和技能时机，为进入场地、守住安放点或夺回控制创造交战窗口。
records.en: Manage the team's round economy and combine gunplay with character abilities to plant or defuse the spike. Coordinate routes, information and ability timing to create openings, hold the site or recover control for the objective.

records.zh: 玩家控制角色奔跑、跳跃并攀越障碍，穿过尖刺等机关，到达检查点和关卡终点。需要观察连续障碍的排列，把当前动作与下一次落脚连接起来，在失败后利用检查点继续修正路线。
records.en: Run, jump and climb through obstacle courses, passing spikes and other hazards to reach checkpoints and the finish. Read how the obstacles are arranged in sequence, connecting movements and landings while using checkpoints as a basis for correcting the remaining route.

records.zh: 多个角色需要到达各自指定的目标点，同时避免彼此碰撞。目标虽然分别属于个人，移动空间却相互共享，需要依据其他成员的路线调整速度和方向，让每个角色都能完成自己的导航任务。
records.en: Guide multiple agents to their respective targets without colliding. Although the destinations are individual, the movement space is shared, requiring direction and timing to account for other agents so that one successful route does not prevent the others from reaching their own goals.

records.zh: 二传角色先触球，将球送给攻击者，再由攻击者向下扣入目标区域。两个阶段通过位置和时机相接，传球的轨迹会决定攻击者下一次触球的条件。
records.en: A setter contacts the ball and passes it to an attacker, who spikes downward into the target area. Positions and timing connect the two stages, with the pass shaping the trajectory available for the attacker's next contact.

records.zh: 玩家操纵联网设施、无人机与车辆，先侦察环境，再用潜行或战斗完成任务。不同设备能改变接近目标的方式，需要把远程观察得到的信息用于现场行动，让移动、入侵和交互形成可行路线。
records.en: Manipulate connected infrastructure, drones and vehicles to scout an area before completing tasks through stealth or combat. Different devices change how a target can be approached, requiring information gathered remotely to guide movement, hacking and interactions at the location itself.

records.zh: 狼人隐藏身份并在夜间行动，其他玩家白天通过发言、质询与投票淘汰嫌疑人。各阵营要把不完整信息转化为行动，既判断他人是否可信，也选择何时透露线索，争取达成自己的胜利条件。
records.en: Werewolves act at night while players discuss, question and vote on suspects during the day. Pursue your side's victory condition through incomplete information, judging whom to trust and deciding when to reveal clues while hidden identities shape how each account is interpreted.

records.zh: 玩家扮演猎魔人杰洛特，调查委托、追踪怪物，并用剑术、法印和炼金准备应对交战。先搜集线索再选择装备与行动方式，让调查结果帮助处理目标，探索和人物互动也推动旅途中的选择。
records.en: As Geralt, investigate contracts and track monsters before using swordplay, signs and alchemical preparation in combat. Turn clues into choices about equipment and approach, connecting the investigation with the encounter while exploration and conversations shape the decisions made along the journey.

records.zh: 玩家在第一人称迷宫中寻找钥匙和出口，沿途搜集弹药并射击守卫。探索路线与战斗互相影响，需要在打开新通道前留意补给与敌情，逐步把当前区域连接到能够继续前进的位置。
records.en: Search a first-person maze for keys and the exit, collecting ammunition and shooting guards encountered along the route. Connect exploration with the demands of combat, watching supplies and threats as new passages open and lead toward the next part of the area.

records.zh: 玩家输入猜测，根据字母是否出现以及位置是否正确的反馈，逐次缩小候选单词。次数有限，需要让每次猜测既有机会命中答案，也能验证仍不确定的字母组合，避免忽略之前已经得到的限制。
records.en: Enter guesses and use feedback about letter presence and position to narrow the possible word. With only a limited number of attempts, choose each guess to test remaining uncertainties or identify the answer while respecting the constraints established by earlier feedback.

records.zh: 玩家移动红色方块，躲开持续运动的蓝色障碍，收集黄色目标后抵达安全终点。需要观察障碍周期，选择何时穿过通路；一次移动的终点也要足够安全，才能等待下一次前进机会。
records.en: Move a red square around moving blue obstacles, collecting yellow targets before reaching the safe finish. Watch the timing of the hazards and choose when to cross, ensuring that the next stopping place is safe enough to wait for another opening.

records.zh: 玩家控制红色方块穿过复杂的移动障碍，收集目标，并在安全区之间逐步推进。需要把障碍的运动节奏与自身路线对应起来，先确定可等待的位置，再选择一段段穿越的时机。
records.en: Guide a red square through complex moving obstacles, collecting targets and progressing between safe zones. Relate the rhythm of the hazards to the route you intend to take, finding places where you can wait before committing to the next timed passage.

records.zh: 玩家探索场景、解开环境谜题并收集声骸，在实时战斗中利用闪避、反击与角色切换应对敌人。探索获得的资源支持队伍发展，新组合又改变战斗办法，需要让准备与现场操作持续衔接。
records.en: Explore, solve environmental puzzles and collect Echoes while using dodges, counters and character switches in real-time combat. Resources from exploration support the team's development, while new combinations change the tools available when deciding how to handle the next enemy encounter.

records.zh: 这些程序生成的三维世界要求玩家导航、操作物体并触发当前场景定义的规则，以满足目标条件。布局和要求可以变化，需要先观察对象关系，再尝试行动，把反馈用于修正接下来处理物体的方式。
records.en: Navigate procedurally generated three-dimensional worlds and manipulate objects to trigger the rules associated with the current goal. Layouts and conditions vary, requiring you to observe relationships, try actions and use their outcomes to revise how you interact with the scene.

records.zh: 玩家在带可变规则的网格中移动，与物体交互并观察转换结果，发现当前环境的规律。各回合目标在这些规则下完成，先前尝试得到的信息不断改变后续行动的选择。
records.en: Move and interact with objects in a grid whose transformation rules can vary. Use the observed changes to discover the current rules and complete each round's goal, carrying information from an earlier attempt into the next action.

records.zh: 玩家掷出五颗骰子，在有限次数内选择保留哪些骰子、重掷哪些，再把最终结果填入某个组合计分栏。每栏的使用会影响后续选择，需要比较当前分数与未来机会，逐步完成整张计分表。
records.en: Roll five dice, keep selected dice and reroll the rest within the allowed attempts before assigning the result to a scoring category. Each category choice affects later options, so compare the current score with future opportunities while working through the score sheet.

records.zh: 玩家探索霍洛德拉姆，使用四季之杖改变季节，让道路和场景呈现不同状态。需要比较季节变化后的可行通路，利用新状态解开环境与地牢谜题，把探索获得的能力带回先前受阻的地方。
records.en: Explore Holodrum and use the Rod of Seasons to change the season and the state of the landscape. Compare the resulting routes, using those changes to solve environmental and dungeon puzzles and revisit places where an earlier condition prevented further progress.

records.zh: 玩家通过文字命令探索地下帝国，检查场景、搜集宝物并管理随身物品，破解阻挡探索的谜题。物品的用途未必立即可见，需要把不同地点的线索相互联系，让发现转化为下一步可执行的行动。
records.en: Explore an underground empire through text commands, collecting treasures and managing inventory while solving environmental puzzles. Connect clues from different locations to discover uses for objects and open routes through the adventure.

records.zh: 玩家继续深入地下帝国，寻找并使用物品破解谜题，同时应对巫师带来的干扰。需要把各处发现与当前障碍联系起来，在计划被扰动后重新安排物品和行动顺序，逐步打开后续区域。
records.en: Travel deeper into the underground empire, collecting and using objects to solve puzzles while coping with interference from a wizard. Relate discoveries to current obstacles and reconsider the order of actions when plans are disrupted, gradually opening a way into further areas.

records.zh: 玩家通过文字探索地下城主的领域，破解相互关联的环境与物品谜题，走向最终考验。一个地点的发现可能解释另一个遭遇，分散线索逐渐组成穿越领域的完整路线。
records.en: Explore the Dungeon Master's domain through text commands, solving interconnected environmental and object puzzles before the final test. Discoveries in one location help explain encounters elsewhere, gradually revealing a way through the domain.
